FalseAppearance.name: False Appearance
FalseAppearance.description: If the animated coffin is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the coffin move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the coffin is animate.

SpiderClimb.name: Spider Climb
SpiderClimb.description: The animated coffin can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The animated coffin makes two Slam attacks.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

Entrap.name: Entrap
Entrap.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. on hit: The target has the grappled condition (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, if the target is not an Undead, the target has the restrained condition and takes 14 (4d6) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. The animated coffin can grapple only one creature at a time.

AuraofDeath.name: Aura of Death
AuraofDeath.description: Creatures within 30 feet of Skall have disadvantage on death saving throws.

CosmicAnnihilation.name: Cosmic Annihilation
CosmicAnnihilation.description: A creature killed by Skall can be restored to life only by means of a true resurrection or wish spell.

LegendaryResistance(4/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(4/Day).description: If Skall fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

Rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description: If Skall dies, he turns to dust. If his orrery of souls hasn't been destroyed, Skall re-forms within the Mortuary in 1d10 days. He appears within 5 feet of the orrery.

TurnResistance.name: Turn Resistance
TurnResistance.description: Skall has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns Undead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Skall makes one Withering Touch attack or uses Spellcasting. He also uses Death Knell twice.

WitheringTouch.name: WitheringTouch
WitheringTouch.description: ms 11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 32 (6d8 + 5) cold damage plus 31 (7d8) necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, it can't regain hit points until the start of Skall's next turn.

DeathKnell.name: DeathKnell
DeathKnell.description: Skall points his finger at a creature he can see within 120 feet of himself, filling the target's mind with visions of death and the plangent toll of an iron bell. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or take 14 (4d6) psychic damage and have the frightened condition until the start of Skall's next turn.

FogofDeath(1/Day).name: FogofDeath(1/Day)
FogofDeath(1/Day).description:
Skall exudes a killing fog in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on himself. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. The fog lasts until the start of Skall's next turn, and it can't be dispersed by wind. It does not move with him.
Each creature that enters the fog for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) necrotic damage and 28 (8d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A Medium or smaller Humanoid killed by this damage becomes a zombie under Skall's control. The zombie acts on Skall's initiative but immediately after his turn. Absent any other command, the zombie tries to kill any non-Undead creature it encounters.

IncorruptibleVessel.name: Incorruptible Vessel
IncorruptibleVessel.description: The exorcist can't be possessed by Celestials, Fiends, or Undead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The exorcist makes two Grave Burst attacks.

GraveBurst.name: GraveBurst
GraveBurst.description: ms,rs 6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 19 (3d10 + 3) necrotic or radiant damage (exorcist's choice).

AdmitEntity{@recharge5}.name: AdmitEntity{@recharge5}
AdmitEntity{@recharge5}.description: The exorcist thins the veil of death for a creature it can see within 60 feet of itself, exposing the target to malevolent entities. The target must make a DC 14 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 36 (8d8) psychic damage and has the incapacitated condition for 1 minute, during which time it retches and babbles incoherently in a voice that is not its own. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only. An incapacitated target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The icon has Advantage|XPHB on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The icon makes two Slam attacks and uses Fiery Eruption.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: m 4, reach 5 ft. on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

FieryEruption.name: FieryEruption
FieryEruption.description: dex DC 11, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation originating from the icon. {@actSaveFail} 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

DiabolicWard.name: Diabolic Ward
DiabolicWard.description: Attack rolls against the devil have Disadvantage|XPHB. If the devil makes an attack roll, this trait is suppressed until the start of its next turn.

DiabolicalRestoration.name: Diabolical Restoration
DiabolicalRestoration.description: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points|XPHB somewhere in the Nine Hells.

MagicResistance.description: The devil has Advantage|XPHB on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The devil makes two attacks, using Infernal Blade or Confounding Ray in any combination.

InfernalBlade.name: InfernalBlade
InfernalBlade.description: m 5, reach 5 ft. on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage and 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

ConfoundingRay.name: ConfoundingRay
ConfoundingRay.description: r 5, range 120 ft. on hit: 13 (2d12) Psychic damage. If the target is a creature, it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of the devil's next turn.

CompellingContract(1/Day).name: CompellingContract(1/Day)
CompellingContract(1/Day).description: cha DC 14, one creature within 30 feet of the devil. {@actSaveFail} The target has the Charmed|XPHB condition. While it is Charmed|XPHB, it has the Stunned|XPHB condition, except the target can speak. If the target agrees to the devil's contract, the effect ends. Otherwise, the target repeats the save whenever it takes damage and at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day,or4/DayinLair).name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
LegendaryResistance(3/Day,or4/DayinLair).description: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

MistyEscape.name: Misty Escape
MistyEscape.description:
If the vampire drops to 0 Hit Points|XPHB outside its resting place, the vampire uses Shape-Shift to become mist (no action required). If it can't use Shape-Shift, it is destroyed.
While it has 0 Hit Points|XPHB in mist form, it can't return to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it returns to its vampire form and has the Paralyzed|XPHB condition until it regains any Hit Points|XPHB, and it regains 1 Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point after spending 1 hour there.

Multiattack(VampireFormOnly).name: Multiattack(VampireFormOnly)
Multiattack(VampireFormOnly).description: The vampire makes two Hellfire Claw attacks and uses Bite.

HellfireClaw(VampireFormOnly).name: HellfireClaw(VampireFormOnly)
HellfireClaw(VampireFormOnly).description: m 9, reach 5 ft. on hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled|XPHB condition (escape DC 17) from one of two claws.

Bite(ImporVampireFormOnly).name: Bite(ImporVampireFormOnly)
Bite(ImporVampireFormOnly).description: con DC 18, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or that has the Grappled|XPHB, Incapacitated|XPHB, or Restrained|XPHB condition. {@actSaveFail} 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage plus 16 (3d10) Necrotic damage and the creature loses its highest-level available spell slot (if any). The target's Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains Hit Points|XPHB equal to that amount. A Humanoid reduced to 0 Hit Points|XPHB by this damage and then buried rises the following sunset as a Vampire Spawn under the vampire's control.

MagicResistance.description: The vampire has Advantage|XPHB on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.description: The vampire makes two Claw attacks and uses Bite or Guardian's Command.

Claw.name: Claw

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: con DC 16, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or that has the Grappled|XPHB, Incapacitated|XPHB, or Restrained|XPHB condition. {@actSaveFail} 7 (1d4 + 5) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains Hit Points|XPHB equal to that amount.

MagicResistance.description: The ancient deep crow has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

ShadowStealth.name: Shadow Stealth
ShadowStealth.description: While in dim light or darkness, the ancient deep crow can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The ancient deep crow makes three attacks: one with its mandibles and two with its claws.

Mandibles.name: Mandibles
Mandibles.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 19). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the ancient deep crow can't use its mandibles on another target.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.

ShadowCaw.name: ShadowCaw
ShadowCaw.description: The ancient deep crow releases an ear-splitting caw. Each creature within 60 feet of the crow and able to hear it must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Auspicia makes two attacks.

Longsword.name: Longsword
Longsword.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

LightCrossbow.description: rw 4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

FeyAncestry.name: Fey Ancestry
FeyAncestry.description: Brahma has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put her to sleep.

Taunt(2/Day).name: Taunt
Taunt(2/Day).description: Brahma can use a bonus action to target one creature she can see within 30 feet of her. If the target can hear Brahma, it must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or have disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the start of Brahma's next turn.

WarLute.name: WarLute
WarLute.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

SongofDomination(3/Day).name: SongofDomination(3/Day)
SongofDomination(3/Day).description: Brahma targets one creature that can see or hear her, which must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by her for 1 minute. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. It has disadvantage on these saves if being charmed by Brahma is something the target openly or secretly desires. For 1 hour after the charm effect ends, the target has disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma checks made as part of a contest with Brahma.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The chaos quadrapod has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The chaos quadrapod makes up to two tentacle attacks.

Tentacle.name: Tentacle
Tentacle.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The chaos quadrapod can grapple no more than two targets at a time.

ChaosCloud(RechargesafteraShortorLongRes.description: The chaos quadrapod shoots forth a knot of roiling ethereal light that explodes at a point it can see within 60 feet of it. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

ChampionChallenge(RechargesafteraShortor.description: As a bonus action, Donaar causes each creature of his choice that he can see within 30 feet of him to make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature can't willingly move more than 30 feet away from Donaar. This effect ends on the creature if Donaar is incapacitated or dies, or if the creature is moved more than 30 feet away from him.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Donaar makes two attacks with his greatsword or his whip.

Greatsword.name: Greatsword
Greatsword.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. Whenever Donaar rolls a 1 or 2 on a damage die, he can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

Whip.name: Whip
Whip.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage.

AcidVomit.name: AcidVomit
AcidVomit.description: Donaar regurgitates acid in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.description: mw,rw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

BenignTransportation(RechargesafterJimCa.description: As a bonus action, Jim teleports up to 30 feet to a space he can see. The space must be unoccupied or occupied by a willing Small or Medium creature. If the latter, Jim and the willing creature both teleport, swapping places.

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.description: mw,rw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

MinorConjuration.name: MinorConjuration
MinorConjuration.description: Jim conjures an inanimate object, no larger than 3 feet on a side and no more than 10 pounds, in his hand or on the ground in an unoccupied space he can see within 10 feet of him. The object is visibly magical, radiating dim light out to 5 feet. It disappears if it takes any damage, after 1 hour, or when Jim uses this feature again.

SpecialEquipment.name: Special Equipment
SpecialEquipment.description: K'thriss wears a robe of stars (accounted for in his statistics). The robe allows him to cast the following spells: 6/day: magic missile (7 missiles)

AwakenedMind.name: Awakened Mind
AwakenedMind.description: K'thriss can telepathically speak to any creature he can see within 30 feet of him, provided the creature can understand at least one language.

FeyAncestry.name: Fey Ancestry
FeyAncestry.description: K'thriss has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep. Sunlight Sensitivity. While in sunlight, K'thriss has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

CustomizableStorage.name: Customizable Storage
CustomizableStorage.description: A keg robot can hold up to three types of liquid payload totaling 12 gallons within its hollow, barrel-shaped body. A full keg robot can make one liquid attack per gallon before the liquid must be refilled. Filling a keg robot takes 2 rounds per gallon. Differing payloads can alter the keg robot's attacks from those presented here.

Fist.name: Fist
Fist.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

AcidSquirt.name: AcidSquirt
AcidSquirt.description: rw 5 to hit, range 20/40 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) acid damage.

BeerShower.name: BeerShower
BeerShower.description:
The keg robot spews an unnaturally potent beer in a 15-foot cone or in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned. While poisoned in this way, a creature has its speed halved by exposure to the potent brew. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Additionally, the beer shower extinguishes any fires or open flames in its area.

HotOilSpray{@recharge5}.name: HotOilSpray{@recharge5}
HotOilSpray{@recharge5}.description:
The keg robot sprays hot oil in a 15-foot cone or in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 7 (1d8 + 3) fire damage and falls prone. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and doesn't fall prone.
Any creature affected by the hot oil spray that takes fire damage before the oil dries (after 1 minute) takes an additional 3 (1d6) fire damage, and the oil burns away.
If the oil that remains in the area of the spray is lit, it burns for 1d4 rounds and deals 3 (1d6) fire damage to any creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there.

Shortsword.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

A creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself with a success.

Warhammer.name: Warhammer

SneakAttack(1/Turn).name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
SneakAttack(1/Turn).description: Portentia deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Portentia that isn't incapacitated and Portentia doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

ChangeShape.name: ChangeShape
ChangeShape.description: Portentia magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating equal to or less than her own, or back into her true form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (her choice). In a new form, Portentia retains her game statistics and ability to speak, but her AC, movement modes, Strength, Dexterity, and special senses are replaced by those of the new form, and she gains any statistics and capabilities (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that she lacks.

DivineEminence.name: Divine Eminence
DivineEminence.description: As a bonus action, Prophetess can expend a spell slot to cause her melee weapon attacks to magically deal an extra 10 (3d6) radiant damage to a target on a hit. This benefit lasts until the end of the turn. If Prophetess expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1st.

HalflingNimbleness.name: Halfling Nimbleness
HalflingNimbleness.description: Rosie can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than hers.

Evasion.name: Evasion
Evasion.description: If Rosie is subjected to an effect that allows her to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, she instead takes no damage if she succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if she fails. She can't use this trait if she's incapacitated.

ShadowStep.name: Shadow Step
ShadowStep.description: When Rosie is in dim light or darkness, she can use a bonus action to teleport 60 feet to an unoccupied space she can see that is also in dim light or darkness. She then has advantage on the first melee attack she makes before the end of the turn.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Rosie makes three attacks, then makes two unarmed strike attacks.

StaffoftheMaster(+1Quarterstaff).name: StaffoftheMaster(+1Quarterstaff)
StaffoftheMaster(+1Quarterstaff).description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

UnarmedStrike.name: UnarmedStrike
UnarmedStrike.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. Rosie's unarmed strikes are magical.

DefensiveAdvantage.description: As long as two or more of Splugoth's allies are within 5 feet of him and are not incapacitated, attack rolls against him are made with disadvantage.

NimbleEscape.name: Nimble Escape
NimbleEscape.description: Splugoth can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of his turns.

TouchofMadness.name: Touch of Madness
TouchofMadness.description: Splugoth has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Splugoth makes two attacks with his dagger.

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

WordFromBeyond(1/Day).name: WordFromBeyond(1/Day)
WordFromBeyond(1/Day).description: Splugoth remembers and repeats aloud a few words from a place he entered while walking back from the next world to this one. PetrifyingGaze.name: Petrifying Gaze
PetrifyingGaze.description:
When a creature that can see Kyrilla's eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of her, Kyrilla can force it to make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw if Kyrilla isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is instantly petrified. Otherwise, a creature that fails the save begins to turn to stone and is restrained. The restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming petrified on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.
Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see Kyrilla until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at Kyrilla in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.
Kyrilla's accursed gaze does not affect undead or constructs. If Kyrilla sees herself reflected on a polished surface within 30 feet of her and in an area of bright light, she is, due to her curse, affected by her own gaze.

One Humanoid that the apparition can see within 5 feet of itself must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by the apparition; the apparition then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. The apparition now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.
The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, the apparition ends it as a bonus action, the body leaves the Astral Plane, or the apparition is forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, the apparition reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. If it reappears in a location not on the Astral Plane, the apparition is destroyed. PhotonicBreath{@recharge5}.description: The dragon exhales a flashing mote of radiant energy that travels to a point the dragon can see within 120 feet of itself, then blossoms into a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point. Each creature in the sphere must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

DisembodiedVoice.name: Disembodied Voice
DisembodiedVoice.description: Up to three times in its life, the zodar can cause a message of up to twenty-five words to issue from the air around it. It speaks only when it has something profoundly important to say, and the message can be understood by any creature that has an Intelligence score of 2 or higher.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the zodar fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

TransportInhibitor.name: Transport Inhibitor
TransportInhibitor.description: The zodar can't be teleported or sent to any plane of existence against its will.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The zodar doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The zodar makes two Crushing Fist attacks. Before or after these attacks, the zodar uses Forced Teleport.

CrushingFist.name: CrushingFist
CrushingFist.description: mw 15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 21 (2d10 + 10) force damage.

ForcedTeleport.name: ForcedTeleport
ForcedTeleport.description: The zodar magically warps space around one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 22 (4d10) force damage, and the zodar teleports it, along with any equipment it's wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space that the zodar can see and that can support the target. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't teleported.

BadFlier.name: Bad Flier
BadFlier.description: The abyssal chicken falls at the end of a turn if it's airborne and the only thing holding it aloft is its flying speed.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The abyssal chicken makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

Claws.name: Claws
Claws.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

SuaveDefense.name: Suave Defense
SuaveDefense.description: While Amrik is wearing light or no armor and wielding no shield, his AC includes his Charisma modifier.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Amrik makes three dagger attacks.

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.description: mw,rw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

SmokeBomb(1/Day).name: SmokeBomb(1/Day)
SmokeBomb(1/Day).description: Amrik hurls a smoke bomb up to 20 feet away. The bomb explodes on impact, creating a cloud of black smoke that fills a 10-foot-radius sphere. The area within the cloud is heavily obscured. A strong wind disperses the cloud, which otherwise remains until the end of Amrik's next turn.

bludgeoningfromnonmagicalattacksthataren.name: bludgeoning from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

piercingfromnonmagicalattacksthataren'ts.name: piercing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

slashingfromnonmagicalattacksthataren'ts.name: slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

AuraofHate.name: Aura of Hate
AuraofHate.description: While Arkhan isn't incapacitated, he and all fiends and undead within 30 feet of him deal 4 extra damage whenever they hit with a melee weapon attack (already factored into Arkhan's attacks). This extra damage is of the same type as the weapon's damage type.

HandofVecna.name: Hand of Vecna
HandofVecna.description: The Hand of Vecna has 8 charges and regains 1d4 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. Arkhan can cast the following spells from the hand by expending the specified number of charges (spell save DC 18): finger of death (5 charges), sleep (1 charge), slow (2 charges), and teleport (3 charges).

SpecialEquipment.name: Special Equipment
SpecialEquipment.description: Arkhan wields Fane-Eater|BGDIA and wears a suit of Obsidian Flint Dragon Plate|BGDIA. The armor gives Arkhan advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid or end the grappled condition on him.

darkvision.name: darkvision
darkvision.value: 60 ft. (can see invisible creatures out to the same range)

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Arkhan makes three weapon attacks.

Fane-Eater(Battleaxe).name: Fane-Eater(Battleaxe)
Fane-Eater(Battleaxe).description: mw 13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 16 (1d8 + 12) slashing damage, or 17 (1d10 + 12) slashing damage when used with two hands, plus 9 (2d8) cold damage. If the target is a creature and Arkhan rolls a 20 on the attack roll, the creature takes an extra 9 (2d8) necrotic damage, and Arkhan regains an amount of hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt.

Javelin.name: Javelin
Javelin.description: mw,rw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage, plus 4 piercing damage and 9 (2d8) cold damage if the javelin was used to make a melee attack.

FearAura.name: Fear Aura
FearAura.description: Any creature hostile to Bel that starts its turn within 20 feet of him must make a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw unless Bel is incapacitated. If the save fails, the creature has the frightened condition until the start of its next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to Bel's Fear Aura for the next 24 hours.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If Bel fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: Bel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

bludgeoningfromnonmagicalattacksthataren.name: bludgeoning from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

piercingfromnonmagicalattacksthataren'ts.name: piercing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

slashingfromnonmagicalattacksthataren'ts.name: slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Bel attacks twice with his Greatsword and once with his Tail.

Greatsword.name: Greatsword
Greatsword.description: mw 17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) slashing damage plus 21 (6d6) fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being held or worn, it catches fire.

Tail.name: Tail
Tail.description: mw 17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 25 (3d10 + 9) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or have the stunned condition until the end of its next turn.

AuraofTerror.name: Aura of Terror
AuraofTerror.description: When a hostile creature within 5 feet of the black gauntlet makes an attack roll or a saving throw, it has disadvantage on the roll. Creatures that are immune to the frightened condition are immune to this trait.

TacticalDiscipline.name: Tactical Discipline
TacticalDiscipline.description: The black gauntlet has advantage on all ability checks and saving throws made during combat.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The black gauntlet makes two attacks with its mace.

Mace.name: Mace
Mace.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

GuidingBolt(1st-LevelSpell;RequiresaSpel.name: GuidingBolt(1st-LevelSpell;RequiresaSpellSlot)

value.value: Guiding Bolt (1st-Level Spell; Requires a Spell Slot)

GuidingBolt(1st-LevelSpell;RequiresaSpel.description: rs 7 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. on hit: 14 (4d6) radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against the target before the end of the black gauntlet's next turn has advantage. If the black gauntlet casts this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

Adhesive.name: Adhesive
Adhesive.description: The bone whelk can cause Medium or smaller objects to adhere to it. A Medium or smaller creature that touches the bone whelk is grappled by it (escape DC 10).

DeathScream.name: Death Scream
DeathScream.description: When the bone whelk dies, it emits a blood-curdling shriek than can be heard out to a range of 120 feet. This shriek causes nonmagical, organic material within 10 feet of the bone whelk to rot. Each creature within 10 feet of the bone whelk when it dies takes 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

SpiderClimb.name: Spider Climb
SpiderClimb.description: The bone whelk can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

SilveredPike.name: SilveredPike
SilveredPike.description: mw 2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d10) piercing damage.

HellfireWarhammer.name: HellfireWarhammer
HellfireWarhammer.description: mw 2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage, or 5 (1d10 + 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

Amphibious.name: Amphibious
Amphibious.description: Crokek'toeck can breathe air and water.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: Crokek'toeck has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

MagicWeapons.name: Magic Weapons
MagicWeapons.description: Crokek'toeck's weapon attacks are magical.

SecureMemory.name: Secure Memory
SecureMemory.description: Crokek'toeck is immune to the waters of the River Styx as well as any effect that would steal or modify its memories or detect or read its thoughts.

StandingLeap.name: Standing Leap
StandingLeap.description: Crokek'toeck's long jump is up to 60 feet and its high jump is up to 30 feet, with or without a running start.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 44 (10d6 + 9) piercing damage.

DisgorgeAllies{@recharge}.name: DisgorgeAllies{@recharge}
DisgorgeAllies{@recharge}.description: Crokek'toeck opens its mouth and disgorges 1d4 barlgura||barlguras, 3d6 gnoll||gnolls led by 1 gnoll fang of Yeenoghu, 6d6 dretch||dretches, or 1d3 vrock||vrocks. Each creature it disgorges appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of Crokek'toeck's mouth, or the next closest unoccupied space.

AuraofMurder.name: Aura of Murder
AuraofMurder.description: As long as the death's head is not incapacitated, hostile creatures within 5 feet of it gain vulnerability to piercing damage unless they have resistance or immunity to such damage.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The death's head has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The death's head uses Stunning Gaze and makes two dagger attacks.

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.description: mw,rw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage.

StunningGaze.name: StunningGaze
StunningGaze.description: The death's head targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

DarkDevotion.name: Dark Devotion
DarkDevotion.description: Thalamra has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

Devil'sSight.name: Devil's Sight
Devil'sSight.description: Thalamra can see normally in darkness, both magical and nonmagical, out to a distance of 120 feet.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Thalamra uses eldritch blast twice or makes two unarmed strikes.

EldritchBlast(Cantrip).name: EldritchBlast(Cantrip)
EldritchBlast(Cantrip).description: rs 6 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. on hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) force damage.

UnarmedStrike.name: UnarmedStrike
UnarmedStrike.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 4 bludgeoning damage.

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.description: mw,rw 5 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

Berserk.name: Berserk
Berserk.description: Whenever the golem starts its turn with 100 hit points or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its hit points. If the golem's creator is within 60 feet of the berserk golem, the creator can try to calm it by speaking firmly and persuasively. The golem must be able to hear its creator, who must take an action to make a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check. If the check succeeds, the golem ceases being berserk. If it takes damage while still at 100 hit points or fewer, the golem might go berserk again.

ImmutableForm.name: Immutable Form
ImmutableForm.description: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

LightningAbsorption.name: Lightning Absorption
LightningAbsorption.description: Whenever the golem is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

MagicWeapons.name: Magic Weapons
MagicWeapons.description: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

bludgeoningfromnonmagicalattacksthataren.name: bludgeoning from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine or silvered

piercingfromnonmagicalattacksthataren'ta.name: piercing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine or silvered

slashingfromnonmagicalattacksthataren'ta.name: slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine or silvered

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The golem makes two slam attacks.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

TacticalDiscipline.name: Tactical Discipline
TacticalDiscipline.description: The fist of Bane has advantage on all ability checks and saving throws made during combat.

Mace.name: Mace
Mace.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

Longbow.name: Longbow
Longbow.description: rw 2 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: Gideon regains 10 hit points at the start of each of his turns. If he takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Gideon is destroyed only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Gideon attacks twice with his fists.

Fist.name: Fist
Fist.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

WitheringGaze.name: WitheringGaze
WitheringGaze.description: Gideon targets one creature he can see within 60 feet of him. The target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

MagicWeapons.name: Magic Weapons
MagicWeapons.description: The hellwasp's weapon attacks are magical.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The hellwasp makes two attacks: one with its sting and one with its sword talons.

Sting.name: Sting
Sting.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, the target is also paralyzed. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

SwordTalons.name: SwordTalons
SwordTalons.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

AuraofInvulnerability.name: Aura of Invulnerability
AuraofInvulnerability.description: An invisible aura forms a 10-foot-radius sphere around the hollyphant for as long as it lives. Any spell of 5th level or lower cast from outside the barrier can't affect creatures or objects within it, even if the spell is cast using a higher level spell slot. Such a spell can target creatures and objects within the barrier, but the spell has no effect on them. Similarly, the area within the barrier is excluded from the areas affected by such spells. The hollyphant can use an action to suppress this trait until its concentration ends (as if concentration||concentrating on a spell).

MagicWeapons.name: Magic Weapons
MagicWeapons.description: The hollyphant's weapon attacks are magical.

Tusks.name: Tusks
Tusks.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

Trumpet(3/Day).name: Trumpet(3/Day)
Trumpet(3/Day).description: The hollyphant blows air through its trunk, creating a trumpet sound that can be heard out to a range of 600 feet. The trumpet also creates a 30-foot cone of energy that has one of the following effects, chosen by the hollyphant:

TrumpetofBlasting.name: TrumpetofBlasting
TrumpetofBlasting.description: Each creature in the cone must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 17 (5d6) thunder damage and is deafened for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't deafened. Nonmagical objects in the cone that aren't being held or worn take 35 (10d6) thunder damage.

TrumpetofSparkles.name: TrumpetofSparkles
TrumpetofSparkles.description: Creatures in the cone must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d8 + 4) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Evil creatures have disadvantage on the saving throw. Good creatures in the cone take no damage.

TacticalDiscipline.name: Tactical Discipline
TacticalDiscipline.description: The iron consul has advantage on all ability checks and saving throws made during combat.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The iron consul makes one attack with its spear and can use its Voice of Command ability.

Spear.name: Spear
Spear.description: mw,rw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage when used with two hands to make a melee attack.

VoiceofCommand.name: VoiceofCommand
VoiceofCommand.description: The iron consul selects up to two allies within 90 feet of it that can hear its commands. Each ally can immediately use its reaction to make one melee attack.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If Kostchtchie fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: Kostchtchie has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Kostchtchie makes two melee attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 18 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 13 (1d6 + 10) piercing damage.

Matalotok(Warhammer).name: Matalotok(Warhammer)
Matalotok(Warhammer).description: mw 18 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 19 (2d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage, or 21 (2d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage when used with two hands, and the weapon emits a burst of cold that deals 10 (3d6) cold damage to each creature within 30 feet of it.

HoldBreath.name: Hold Breath
HoldBreath.description: Krull can hold his breath for 1 hour.

InescapableDestruction.name: Inescapable Destruction
InescapableDestruction.description: Necrotic damage dealt by Krull's spells ignores resistance to necrotic damage.

Claws.name: Claws
Claws.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage.

+1Maul.name: +1Maul
+1Maul.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

ShellDefense.name: ShellDefense
ShellDefense.description: Krull withdraws into his shell. Until he emerges as a bonus action, he has a +4 bonus to AC and has advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws. While in his shell, Krull is prone, his speed is 0 and can't increase, he has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, he can't take reactions, and the only action he can take is to emerge from his shell.

LimitedMagicImmunity.name: Limited Magic Immunity
LimitedMagicImmunity.description: Mahadi can't be affected or detected by spells of 6th level or lower unless he wishes to be. He has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

MagicWeapons.name: Magic Weapons
MagicWeapons.description: Mahadi's weapon attacks are magical.

piercingfrommagicweaponswieldedbygoodcre.name: piercing from magic weapons wielded by good creatures

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Mahadi makes four claw attacks.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage, and the target is cursed if it's a creature. The curse takes effect whenever the target takes a short or long rest, filling the target's thoughts with horrible images and dreams. The cursed target gains no benefit from finishing a short or long rest. The curse lasts until it is lifted by a remove curse spell or similar magic.

SummonErinyes(1/Day).name: SummonErinyes(1/Day)
SummonErinyes(1/Day).description: Mahadi summons Ilzabet, an erinyes bound to him by an infernal contract. The erinyes appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of him, acts as his ally, and can't summon other devils. The erinyes remains for 10 minutes or until Mahadi dismisses it as an action. If the erinyes dies, Mahadi loses this action option.

GraveMagic.name: Grave Magic
GraveMagic.description: When the master of souls cast a spell that deals damage, it can change the spell's damage type to necrotic.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The master of souls attacks twice with its flail.

SilveredSkullFlail.name: SilveredSkullFlail
SilveredSkullFlail.description: mw 2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage, and the target has disadvantage on all saving throws until the end of the master of souls' next turn.

ChillTouch(Cantrip).name: ChillTouch(Cantrip)
ChillTouch(Cantrip).description: rs 6 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. on hit: 13 (2d8) necrotic damage, and the target can't regain hit points until the start of the master of souls' next turn. If the target is undead, it has disadvantage on attack rolls against the master of souls for the same duration.

RayofSickness(1st-LevelSpell;RequiresaSp.name: RayofSickness(1st-LevelSpell;RequiresaSpellSlot)

value.value: Ray of Sickness (1st-Level Spell; Requires a Spell Slot)

RayofSickness(1st-LevelSpell;RequiresaSp.description: rs 6 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. on hit: 9 (2d8) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of the master of souls' next turn. If the master of souls casts this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

ScorchingRay(2nd-LevelSpell;RequiresaSpe.name: ScorchingRay(2nd-LevelSpell;RequiresaSpellSlot)

value.value: Scorching Ray (2nd-Level Spell; Requires a Spell Slot)

ScorchingRay(2nd-LevelSpell;RequiresaSpe.description: rs 6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target per ray (3 rays if a 2nd-level spell slot is used, 4 rays if a 3rd-level spell slot is used). on hit: 7 (2d6) fire damage per ray.

Indomitable(2/Day).name: Indomitable
Indomitable(2/Day).description: Mortlock can reroll a saving throw that he fails. He must use the new roll.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Mortlock makes two attacks with his greatclub.

Greatclub.name: Greatclub
Greatclub.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage, plus 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage if Mortlock has taken any damage since his last turn.

HeavyCrossbow.name: HeavyCrossbow
HeavyCrossbow.description: rw 4 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

SkullFlail.name: SkullFlail
SkullFlail.description: mw 2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage.

ClawsoftheGrave.name: ClawsoftheGrave
ClawsoftheGrave.description: rs 5 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) necrotic damage.

NecroticBody.name: Necrotic Body
NecroticBody.description: A creature that touches the centipede or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

AuraofMurder.name: Aura of Murder
AuraofMurder.description: As long as the night blade is not incapacitated, hostile creatures within 5 feet of it gain vulnerability to piercing damage unless they have resistance or immunity to such damage.

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.description: mw,rw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

CunningAction.name: Cunning Action
CunningAction.description: On each of her turns in combat, Nine-Fingers can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

DaggerThrower.name: Dagger Thrower
DaggerThrower.description: Nine-Fingers adds double her proficiency bonus to the damage she deals on ranged attacks made with daggers (already factored into her attacks).

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Nine-Fingers attacks three times with her daggers.

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.description: mw,rw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage, plus 6 piercing damage if it's a ranged attack.

AuraofMurder.name: Aura of Murder
AuraofMurder.description: As long as the reaper is not incapacitated, hostile creatures within 5 feet of it gain vulnerability to piercing damage unless they have resistance or immunity to such damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The reaper makes two dagger attacks and uses Shroud Self.

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.description: mw,rw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage.

ShroudSelf.name: ShroudSelf
ShroudSelf.description: The reaper magically turns invisible until the start of its next turn. This invisibility ends if the reaper makes an attack roll, makes a damage roll, or casts a spell.

CunningAction.name: Cunning Action
CunningAction.description: On each of her turns in combat, Rilsa can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

Focus.name: Focus
Focus.description: If Rilsa damages a creature with a weapon attack, she gains advantage on attack rolls against that target until the end of her next turn.

TacticalLeadership.name: Tactical Leadership
TacticalLeadership.description: As a bonus action, Rilsa chooses one creature she can see within 30 feet of her. The creature doesn't provoke opportunity attacks until the end of its next turn, provided it can hear Rilsa's commands.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Rilsa makes three weapon attacks.

Shortsword.name: Shortsword
Shortsword.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.description: mw,rw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The skull lasher makes two attacks with its flail.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: Smiler has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Equipment.description: Smiler wears +2 leather armor. He carries seven soul coins in a bag and a +1 shortsword

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Smiler makes two weapon attacks. He can cast a spell in place of one of these attacks.

+1Shortsword.name: +1Shortsword
+1Shortsword.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) piercing damage.

ShadowofGuilt.name: Shadow of Guilt
ShadowofGuilt.description: Thavius's shadow is that of a pudgy, horned devil with small wings.

Mace.name: Mace
Mace.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

DarkDevotion.name: Dark Devotion
DarkDevotion.description: Thurstwell has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

SacredFlame(Cantrip).name: SacredFlame(Cantrip)
SacredFlame(Cantrip).description: Flame-like radiance descends on one creature Thurstwell can see within 60 feet of him. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 4 (1d8) radiant damage, gaining no benefit from cover.

GoringRush.name: Goring Rush
GoringRush.description: Immediately after using the Dash action, Torogar can make one melee attack with his horns.

LabyrinthineRecall.name: Labyrinthine Recall
LabyrinthineRecall.description: Torogar can perfectly recall any path he has traveled.

Rage(RechargesafteraShortorLongRest).name: Rage (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
Rage(RechargesafteraShortorLongRest).description:
As a bonus action, Torogar can enter a rage that lasts for 1 minute. The rage ends early if Torogar is knocked unconscious or if his turn ends and he hasn't attacked a hostile creature or taken damage since his last turn. While raging, Torogar gains the following benefits:
He has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.
He deals an extra 3 damage when he hits a target with a melee weapon attack.
He has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

SpecialEquipment.name: Special Equipment
SpecialEquipment.description: Torogar wears gauntlets of flaming fury|BGDIA and a belt of fire giant strength. Without the belt, his Strength is 21. He also carries a soul coin|BGDIA.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Torogar makes three attacks: two with his scimitars and one with his horns.

Scimitar.name: Scimitar
Scimitar.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage, or 17 (2d6 + 10) slashing damage while raging, plus 3 (1d6) fire damage from the gauntlets of flaming fury.

Horns.name: Horns
Horns.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) piercing damage, or 19 (2d8 + 10) piercing damage while raging.

DetectInvisibility.name: Detect Invisibility
DetectInvisibility.description: Within 50 feet of the tressym, magical invisibility fails to conceal anything from the tressym's sight

KeenSmell.name: Keen Smell
KeenSmell.description: The tressym has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

PoisonSense.name: Poison Sense
PoisonSense.description: The tressym can detect whether a substance is poisonous by taste, touch, or smell.

Familiar.name: Familiar
Familiar.description: With the DM's permission, a person who casts the find familiar spell can choose to conjure a tressym in­ stead of a normal cat.

Claws.name: Claws
Claws.description: mw 0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 1 slashing damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Ulder makes three melee attacks, only one of which can be with his shield.

+1Longsword.name: +1Longsword
+1Longsword.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage when used with two hands.

Shield.name: Shield
Shield.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and Ulder pushes the target 5 feet away from him. Ulder then enters the space vacated by the target. If the target is pushed to within 5 feet of a creature friendly to Ulder, the target provokes an opportunity attack from that creature.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The aerosaur has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The aerosaur makes one Bite attack and one Talons attack.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 27 (3d12 + 8) piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition, and the aerosaur can't Bite another target.

Talons.name: Talons
Talons.description: mw 12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) slashing damage.

WingGusts{@recharge5}.name: WingGusts{@recharge5}
WingGusts{@recharge5}.description: The aerosaur beats its wings, creating bursts of thunderous force. Each creature within 10 feet of the aerosaur must make a DC 20 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 38 (7d10) thunder damage, is pushed up to 30 feet horizontally from the aerosaur, and has the prone condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is pushed up to 15 feet horizontally from the aerosaur.

Amorphous.name: Amorphous
Amorphous.description: The bag jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The bag jelly makes two Pseudopod attacks.

Pseudopod.name: Pseudopod
Pseudopod.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (2d6 + 1) acid damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 11). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.

Stench.name: Stench
Stench.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the barrowghast must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has the poisoned condition for 1 minute. While poisoned this way, the creature can't regain hit points. On a successful save, the creature is immune to the Stench of all barrowghasts for 24 hours.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The barrowghast makes two Slam attacks. It can replace one Slam attack with a Life Drain attack.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

LifeDrain.name: LifeDrain
LifeDrain.description:
mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. on hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.
A Humanoid slain by this attack immediately rises as a zombie (see the Monster Manual). The zombie acts as an ally of the barrowghast but isn't under its control.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The cairnwight makes two Slam attacks or two Rock attacks, and it uses its Petrifying Touch if available.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

Rock.name: Rock
Rock.description: rw 10 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. on hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

PetrifyingTouch{@recharge5}.name: PetrifyingTouch{@recharge5}
PetrifyingTouch{@recharge5}.description: The cairnwight touches one creature it can see within 10 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 26 (4d12) force damage and have the restrained condition as it begins to turn to stone. The affected target must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the effect ends on the target. On a failed save, the target has the petrified condition instead of the restrained condition.

DeathBurst.name: Death Burst
DeathBurst.description: When the cinder hulk dies, it leaves behind a cloud of cinders and smoke that fills a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on its space. The sphere is heavily obscured. Any creature that moves into the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) fire damage. The cloud lasts for 1 minute or until it is dispersed by strong wind.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The cinder hulk makes two Slam attacks.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.

WaveofCinders{@recharge5}.name: WaveofCinders{@recharge5}
WaveofCinders{@recharge5}.description: The cinder hulk emits a wave of smoldering ash from its face, hands, or chest in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 31 (7d8) fire damage and has the blinded condition until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

CloudRune.name: Cloud Rune
CloudRune.description:
The giant has a cloud rune inscribed on a mask in its possession. While holding or wearing the mask bearing the rune, the giant has truesight within a range of 30 feet and can use its Thunderous Clap action and Negate Spell reaction.
The mask bearing the cloud rune has AC 15; 45 hit points; and immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. The mask regains all its hit points at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 hit points or when the giant dies. If the rune is destroyed, the giant can inscribe a cloud rune on a mask in its possession when it finishes a short or long rest.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The giant makes three Flying Staff attacks.

FlyingStaff.name: FlyingStaff
FlyingStaff.description: mw,rw 14 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 30/90 ft., one target. on hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 16 (3d10) thunder damage. {@hom}The staff magically returns to the giant's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

ThunderousClap(RequiresCloudRune).name: ThunderousClap(RequiresCloudRune)
ThunderousClap(RequiresCloudRune).description:
The giant magically summons a thundercloud that fills a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the giant can see within 60 feet of itself. The cloud spreads around corners. Each creature in that area must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw as the cloud emits a thunderous boom. On a failed save, a creature takes 52 (8d12) thunder damage and has the prone condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. The thunderclap is audible within 300 feet of the cloud's center point.
The cloud's area is heavily obscured. The cloud lingers until the start of the giant's next turn or until a strong wind disperses it.

Flyby.name: Flyby
Flyby.description: The giant doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The giant makes two Scimitar attacks and one Storm Boomerang attack.

Scimitar.name: Scimitar
Scimitar.description: mw 12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) slashing damage.

StormBoomerang.name: StormBoomerang
StormBoomerang.description: rw 12 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. on hit: 15 (3d4 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) thunder damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or have the stunned condition until the end of its next turn. {@hom}The boomerang magically returns to the giant's hand immediately after the attack.

AwakeningoftheScion.name: Awakening of the Scion
AwakeningoftheScion.description: The cradle is a container for the scion of Memnor|BGG. When the cradle drops to 0 hit points, its body dissipates into cloud wisps. The scion instantly appears in the space the cradle occupied and uses the cradle's initiative count.

Flyby.description: The cradle doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

LegendaryResistance(5/Day).description: If the cradle fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Slam.description: mw 17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 31 (4d10 + 9) bludgeoning damage plus 19 (3d12) thunder damage.

Vortex{@recharge5}.name: Vortex{@recharge5}
Vortex{@recharge5}.description:
The cradle conjures a vortex of wind at a point it can see within 90 feet of itself. The wind vortex is a 30-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder centered on that point. Each creature other than the cradle in that area must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 71 (11d12) bludgeoning damage and has the restrained condition within the vortex. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space outside the cylinder. The vortex lasts until the start of the cradle's next turn. A creature with the restrained condition falls prone when the vortex ends.
A creature with the restrained condition can use its action to try to escape the vortex. The creature makes a 19 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. On a successful check, the creature escapes and moves 3d6 × 10 feet away from the vortex in a random direction.

AwakeningoftheScion.name: Awakening of the Scion
AwakeningoftheScion.description: The cradle is a container for the scion of Surtur|BGG. When the cradle drops to 0 hit points, its body hardens and crumbles to ash. The scion instantly appears in the space the cradle occupied and uses the cradle's initiative count.

Until a creature within 5 feet of the fire takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 10 (3d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

EruptingBreath{@recharge5}.description:

If this damage would reduce the target to 0 hit points, the target drops to 1 hit point instead and has the petrified condition, turning into a frozen statue.
If the statue takes bludgeoning damage, it shatters, killing the frozen creature. If the statue would take fire damage, it instead takes no damage and thaws, ending the petrification.

AwakeningoftheScion.description: The cradle is a container for the scion of Grolantor|BGG. When the cradle drops to 0 hit points, its body crumbles to dirt and moss. The scion instantly appears in the space the cradle occupied and uses the cradle's initiative count.

RollingHills{@recharge}.description:
The cradle magically creates a wave of dirt that extends from a point on the ground within 120 feet of itself. The wave is up to 30 feet long, up to 30 feet tall, and up to 30 feet wide. Each creature in the wave must make a DC 22 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 58 (9d12) bludgeoning damage, has the prone condition, and is buried under dirt. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.
A buried creature has the restrained condition, has Cover||3||total cover, and can't breathe. As an action, a creature buried in this way, or another creature within 5 feet of it that isn't buried, can make a 17 Strength (Athletics) check. On a successful check, the buried creature no longer has the prone or restrained conditions.

The giant has a death rune inscribed on a giant's skull in its possession. While holding or wearing the skull bearing the rune, the giant can use its Reaping Scythe action and Shroud of Souls bonus action.
The skull bearing the death rune has AC 18; 35 hit points; and immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. The skull regains all its hit points at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 hit points or when the giant dies. If the rune is destroyed, the giant can inscribe a death rune on another skull in its possession when it finishes a short or long rest.

Multiattack.description: The giant makes three Soul Burst attacks. Alternatively, if the giant has its death rune, it can make three Reaping Scythe attacks.

MagicResistance.description: The ceremorph has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The ceremorph makes one Slam attack and one Tentacles attack. The ceremorph can replace one of the attacks with a Mind Bolt attack, if available.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

Tentacles.name: Tentacles
Tentacles.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. on hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) psychic damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 14) and must succeed on a 15 Intelligence saving throw or have the stunned condition until this grapple ends.

ExtractBrain.name: ExtractBrain
ExtractBrain.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one incapacitated Humanoid grappled by the ceremorph. on hit: 55 (10d10) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the ceremorph kills the target by extracting and devouring its brain.

MindBolt(3/Day).name: MindBolt(3/Day)
MindBolt(3/Day).description: rs 7 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. on hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or have the stunned condition until the end of its next turn.

DeathCurse.name: Death Curse
DeathCurse.description:
When the fensir starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate, it releases a curse on those around it. Each creature within 30 feet of the fensir when it dies must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be cursed for the next 24 hours.
While cursed in this way, an affected creature gains no benefit from finishing a short or long rest. At the end of every hour, the creature must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: The fensir regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it isn't in sunlight. If the fensir takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the fensir's next turn. The fensir dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

SunlightHypersensitivity.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
SunlightHypersensitivity.description: When the fensir starts its turn in sunlight, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the petrified condition until the fensir is no longer in sunlight.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The fensir makes two attacks, using Rend, Boulder, or a combination of them.

Rend.name: Rend
Rend.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) slashing damage.

Boulder.name: Boulder
Boulder.description: rw 8 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. on hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition. After the fensir throws the boulder, roll a d6; on a roll of 4 or lower, the fensir has no more boulders to throw.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: The fensir regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it isn't in sunlight. If the fensir takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the fensir's next turn. The fensir dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

SunlightHypersensitivity.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
SunlightHypersensitivity.description: When the fensir starts its turn in sunlight, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the petrified condition until the fensir is no longer in sunlight.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The fensir makes three Battleaxe attacks or two Magic Stone attacks.

Battleaxe.name: Battleaxe
Battleaxe.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.

MagicStone.name: MagicStone
MagicStone.description: rs 5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. on hit: 15 (2d12 + 2) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

MudtoStone{@recharge}.name: MudtoStone{@recharge}
MudtoStone{@recharge}.description: The fensir lobs a magical mass of mud that splashes all creatures in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the fensir can see within 60 feet of itself. Each non-fensir creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage and have the restrained condition as the mud begins to turn to stone. An affected creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the effect ends on the creature. On a failed save, the creature has the petrified condition for 24 hours.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The firbolg makes two Spear or Fire Lance attacks.

Spear.name: Spear
Spear.description: mw,rw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) fire damage.

FireLance.name: FireLance
FireLance.description: rs 5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) fire damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The firbolg makes two attacks using Longsword, Bewitching Bolt, or a combination of them.

Longsword.name: Longsword
Longsword.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 9 (2d8) psychic damage.

BewitchingBolt.name: BewitchingBolt
BewitchingBolt.description: rs 6 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. on hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or have the charmed condition until the start of the target's next turn.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the giant fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

FireRune.name: Fire Rune
FireRune.description:
The giant has a fire rune inscribed on a medallion or some other object in its possession. While holding or wearing the object bearing the rune, the giant can use its Magma Wave action and Furnace Armor bonus action.
The object bearing the rune has AC 15; 40 hit points; and immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. The object regains all its hit points at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 hit points or when the giant dies. If the rune is destroyed, the giant can inscribe a fire rune on an object in its possession when it finishes a short or long rest.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The giant makes three Forge Hammer attacks or two Heated Rock attacks.

ForgeHammer.name: ForgeHammer
ForgeHammer.description: mw 13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 24 (5d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage. {@hom}The giant can cause the hammer to emit a burst of heat in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on the target. Metal objects in that area glow red-hot until the start of the giant's next turn. Any creature in physical contact with a heated object at the start of its turn must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 10 (3d6) fire damage and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of its next turn unless it has immunity to fire damage. The hammer can emit heat in this way only once per turn.

HeatedRock.name: HeatedRock
HeatedRock.description: rw 13 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. on hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 19 (3d12) fire damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition. After the giant throws the rock, roll a d6; on a roll of 3 or lower, the giant has no more rocks to throw.

MagmaWave(RequiresFireRune).name: MagmaWave(RequiresFireRune)
MagmaWave(RequiresFireRune).description: The giant emits a wave of magma from its fire rune in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 36 (8d8) fire damage and has the restrained condition. As an action, a creature can make a DC 19 Strength (Athletics) check, freeing itself or a creature within its reach from the rock on a success. The rock restraining each creature has AC 17; 20 hit points; and immunity to fire, poison, and psychic damage. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

ShrapnelExplosion.name: Shrapnel Explosion
ShrapnelExplosion.description: When the giant drops to 0 hit points, its armor explodes, destroying the giant's body and scattering the armor as shrapnel. Creatures within 10 feet of the giant when its armor explodes must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The giant makes two Searing Scepter attacks or two Bolt of Imix attacks.

SearingScepter.name: SearingScepter
SearingScepter.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) fire damage, and the target is magically branded. While branded in this way, the target becomes visible if it's invisible, can't become invisible, and sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius. The brand disappears after 24 hours, or it can be removed from a creature or an object by any spell that ends a curse.

BoltofImix.name: BoltofImix
BoltofImix.description: rs 8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition until the end of the target's next turn.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The hellion has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

SoulTaker.name: Soul Taker
SoulTaker.description: A Giant or a Humanoid that is reduced to 0 hit points by the hellion dies, and its soul rises as a lemure (see the Monster Manual) on Avernus, one of the Nine Hells, in 1d4 hours. If the creature isn't revived before then, it can be restored to life only by a wish spell or by killing the lemure and casting true resurrection on the creature's original body.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The hellion makes two Morningstar attacks.

Morningstar.name: Morningstar
Morningstar.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) fire damage. If the target is a creature, it can't regain hit points until the start of the hellion's next turn.

InfernalOrb.name: InfernalOrb
InfernalOrb.description: The hellion hurls a magical ball of fire that explodes in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the hellion can see within 120 feet of itself. The sphere spreads around corners. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 18 (4d8) fire damage and 18 (4d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

FireBlood.name: Fire Blood
FireBlood.description: Whenever a creature within 5 feet of the firegaunt hits the firegaunt with a melee attack that deals piercing or slashing damage, that creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The firegaunt makes two Heated Maul attacks.

HeatedMaul.name: HeatedMaul
HeatedMaul.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
