The firegaunt can cause the maul to erupt with crimson flames, and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) fire damage and 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The maul can erupt with flames in this way only once per turn.

CrimsonRays{@recharge5}.name: CrimsonRays{@recharge5}
CrimsonRays{@recharge5}.description: The firegaunt emits beams of fire from its eyes, mouth, and wounds in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 31 (7d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a success or failure, that creature catches fire. Until the burning creature or another creature that can reach it takes an action to extinguish the fire, the burning creature can't regain hit points and takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

Berserk.name: Berserk
Berserk.description: If the core inside the colossus is destroyed, the colossus goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the colossus attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the colossus attacks an object. Once the colossus goes berserk, it remains berserk until it is destroyed.

ImmutableForm.name: Immutable Form
ImmutableForm.description: The colossus is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The colossus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

SiegeMonster.name: Siege Monster
SiegeMonster.description: The colossus deals double damage to objects and structures.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The colossus makes two Fist attacks.

Fist.name: Fist
Fist.description: mw 13 to hit (with advantage if the colossus is berserk), reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is pulled up to 15 feet toward the colossus, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 17), and it has the restrained condition until this grapple ends. The colossus can have up to two creatures grappled this way at a time.

ElementalBreath{@recharge5}.name: ElementalBreath{@recharge5}
ElementalBreath{@recharge5}.description:
The colossus exhales a cloud swirling with elemental energy in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 40 (9d8) damage of a type of the colossus's choosing: acid, cold, fire, or lightning. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.
At the same time as the colossus releases this exhalation, creatures inside the colossus's chest cavity take 40 (9d8) force damage from churning elemental energy.

Contortionist.name: Contortionist
Contortionist.description: The fomorian can enter a space large enough for a Large creature without squeezing.

CrawlingStance.name: Crawling Stance
CrawlingStance.description: While the fomorian has the prone condition, crawling does not cost it extra movement. In addition, the prone condition does not grant advantage on attack rolls against the fomorian.

SpiderClimb.name: Spider Climb
SpiderClimb.description: The fomorian can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The fomorian makes two Slam attacks and uses Crawling Hex if it is available.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

CrawlingHex{@recharge4}.name: CrawlingHex{@recharge4}
CrawlingHex{@recharge4}.description: The fomorian targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 31 (7d8) psychic damage, have the prone condition, and become cursed for 1 hour. While cursed this way, the target can't stand up and end the prone condition on itself.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The fomorian makes three Rod attacks.

Rod.name: Rod
Rod.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) force damage.

BloodRune.name: Blood Rune
BloodRune.description:
The fomorian has a blood rune inscribed on an effigy or some other object in its possession. While holding or wearing the object bearing the rune, the giant can use its Corrupting Hex action and Poisoning Rebuke reaction.
The object bearing the blood rune has AC 15; 30 hit points; and immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. The object regains all its hit points at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 hit points or when the fomorian dies. If the rune is destroyed, the fomorian can inscribe a blood rune on an object in its possession when it finishes a short or long rest.

Devil'sSight.name: Devil's Sight
Devil'sSight.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the fomorian's darkvision.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the fomorian fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The fomorian makes three Greatclub attacks. If the fomorian has its blood rune, it can replace one of these attacks with a use of Corrupting Hex.

Greatclub.name: Greatclub
Greatclub.description: mw 10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

CorruptingHex(RequiresBloodRune).name: CorruptingHex(RequiresBloodRune)
CorruptingHex(RequiresBloodRune).description: The fomorian targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or take 27 (6d8) necrotic damage and become cursed for 24 hours. While cursed this way, the target's speed is reduced by half, and if it tries to cast a spell, it must first succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence check or the spell fails and is wasted.

EldritchBurst.name: EldritchBurst
EldritchBurst.description: Magical energy explodes in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the fomorian can see within 120 feet of itself. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 32 (5d12) force damage and has the prone condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

FrostRune.name: Frost Rune
FrostRune.description:
The giant has a frost rune inscribed on a chunk of ice or some other object in its possession. While holding or wearing the object bearing the rune, the giant can use its Ice Wolves action and Ice Armor reaction.
The object bearing the rune has AC 16; 40 hit points; and immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. The object regains all its hit points at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 hit points or when the giant dies. If the rune is destroyed, the giant can inscribe a frost rune on an object in its possession when it finishes a short or long rest.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the giant fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The giant makes three attacks using Greataxe, Freezing Ray, or a combination of them.

Greataxe.name: Greataxe
Greataxe.description: mw 12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage.

FreezingRay.name: FreezingRay
FreezingRay.description: rs 10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) cold damage, and the target must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the restrained condition until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

IceWolves(RequiresFrostRune).name: IceWolves(RequiresFrostRune)
IceWolves(RequiresFrostRune).description: The giant magically summons 1d4 wolves made of ice (use the winter wolf stat block in the Monster Manual to represent them, but they are Elementals instead of Monstrosities). The wolves appear in unoccupied spaces the giant can see within 30 feet of itself. The wolves take their turn immediately after the giant on the same initiative count, and they obey the giant's commands. The wolves gain a +6 bonus to their attack and damage rolls while they are within 30 feet of the giant. The wolves disappear after 1 minute, when the giant dies, or when the giant uses this action again.

Amphibious.name: Amphibious
Amphibious.description: The giant can breathe air and water.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The giant makes two Battleaxe attacks and one Harpoon attack.

Battleaxe.name: Battleaxe
Battleaxe.description: mw 10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) slashing damage, or 22 (3d10 + 6) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.

Harpoon.name: Harpoon
Harpoon.description: rw 7 to hit, range 50/200 ft., one creature. on hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage, and the target has the grappled condition (escape DC 16). While the target is grappled this way, its speed isn't reduced, but it can't move farther from the giant. The target takes 5 (1d10) slashing damage if it escapes from the grapple or if it tries and fails. The giant can grapple only one target at a time with its harpoon.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The frostmourn makes one Freezing Touch attack and one Icy Axe attack. It can replace one of these attacks with a Polar Ray attack.

FreezingTouch.name: FreezingTouch
FreezingTouch.description:
mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 18 (4d8) cold damage plus 18 (4d8) necrotic damage. If this damage would reduce the target to 0 hit points, the target drops to 1 hit point instead and has the petrified condition, turning into a frozen statue.
If the statue takes bludgeoning damage, it shatters, killing the frozen creature. If the statue would take fire damage, it instead takes no damage and thaws, ending the petrification.

IcyAxe.name: IcyAxe
IcyAxe.description: mw 10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.

PolarRay.name: PolarRay
PolarRay.description: rs 8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 31 (5d10 + 4) cold damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

ChillingAura.name: Chilling Aura
ChillingAura.description: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the fury must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 11 (2d10) cold damage.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The fury has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The fury makes two Fist or Rock attacks.

Fist.name: Fist
Fist.description: mw 13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) cold damage, or 17 (5d6) cold damage if the target took damage from the fury's Chilling Aura since the end of the fury's last turn.

Rock.name: Rock
Rock.description: rw 13 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. on hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

WeirdAura.name: Weird Aura
WeirdAura.description: At the start of each of the gargantua's turns, each creature of the gargantua's choice within 30 feet of it must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target sees the gargantua as a manifestation of the target's worst fears; it takes 17 (5d6) psychic damage and has the frightened condition until the start of the target's next turn. On a successful save, a target is immune to this gargantua's Weird Aura for 24 hours.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The gargantua makes two Slam or Rock attacks.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 27 (3d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

Rock.name: Rock
Rock.description: rw 15 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. on hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

Club.name: Club
Club.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The goose makes one Beak attack and two Wing attacks.

Beak.name: Beak
Beak.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

Wing.name: Wing
Wing.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

ThunderousHonk{@recharge5}.name: ThunderousHonk{@recharge5}
ThunderousHonk{@recharge5}.description: The goose honks with ear-splitting volume. Each other creature within 30 feet of the goose must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 16 (3d10) thunder damage and has the deafened condition until the start of the goose's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. The honk can be heard within 300 feet.

Lynx'sSight(1/Day).name: Lynx's Sight
Lynx'sSight(1/Day).description: The lynx can cast clairvoyance, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

WoodlandCamouflage.name: Woodland Camouflage
WoodlandCamouflage.description: The lynx has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in undergrowth or snowy terrain.

Claws.name: Claws
Claws.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage. If the lynx moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition. If the target has the prone condition, the lynx can make another Claws attack against it as a bonus action.

BeastofBurden.name: Beast of Burden
BeastofBurden.description: The ox is considered to be one size larger for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

Gore.name: Gore
Gore.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage. If the ox moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage, and it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The ram has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Ram.name: Ram
Ram.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) force damage. If the ram moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

ForceBolt.name: ForceBolt
ForceBolt.description: rs 4 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (2d6) force damage.

Proboscis.name: Proboscis
Proboscis.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the tick attaches to the target. While attached, the tick can't make Proboscis attacks. The tick can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. As an action, a creature within reach of the tick can try to detach the tick, doing so with a successful DC 13 Strength check.

BloodDrain.name: BloodDrain
BloodDrain.description: The tick deals 10 (2d6 + 3) necrotic damage to one creature it is physically attached to, provided that creature isn't a Construct or an Undead, or 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage if the creature is a Giant. The tick regains hit points equal to the damage dealt.

Spell-ResistantCarapace.name: Spell-Resistant Carapace
Spell-ResistantCarapace.description: The gigant has advantage on saving throws against spells, and any creature that makes a spell attack against the gigant has disadvantage on the attack roll.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The gigant makes one Mandibles attack and two Talons attacks.

Mandibles.name: Mandibles
Mandibles.description: mw 13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. on hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) slashing damage, and the target has the grappled condition (escape DC 17). Until the grapple ends, the target takes 21 (4d6 + 7) slashing damage at the start of each of the gigant's turns. While the gigant is grappling a target, it can't use Mandibles against other targets.

Talons.name: Talons
Talons.description: mw 13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) slashing damage, and the target is pulled 10 feet straight toward the gigant.

ScaleDust{@recharge5}.name: ScaleDust{@recharge5}
ScaleDust{@recharge5}.description: The gigant releases magical dust from its wings in a 30-foot cube. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a success or failure, the creature has the poisoned condition for 1 hour. While poisoned this way, the creature can't regain hit points.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The goliath makes two Spear attacks.

Spear.name: Spear
Spear.description: mw,rw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The grinning cat has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

Claws.name: Claws
Claws.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage. If the grinning cat was invisible before it attacked, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition. If the target has the prone condition, the cat can make a Bite attack against it as a bonus action.

FadeAway.name: FadeAway
FadeAway.description: The grinning cat magically becomes invisible for 1 hour or until it attacks, gradually fading away over the course of its turn. It can choose to leave part of its body visible, such as its tail, its head, or its grinning mouth. Any equipment the cat wears or carries is invisible with it.

HillRune.name: Hill Rune
HillRune.description:
The giant has a hill rune inscribed on a rock or some other object in its possession. While holding or wearing the object bearing the rune, the giant can use its Stone Avalanche action and Hill Rebuff reaction.
The object bearing the rune has AC 15; 20 hit points; and immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. The object regains all its hit points at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 hit points or when the giant dies. If the rune is destroyed, the giant can inscribe a hill rune on an object in its possession when it finishes a short or long rest.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the giant fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The giant makes one Greatclub attack and uses Stone Bolas.

Greatclub.name: Greatclub
Greatclub.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) thunder damage.

StoneBolas.name: StoneBolas
StoneBolas.description: The giant conjures three stone balls connected by lines of magical force and throws them at one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the restrained condition until the start of the giant's next turn, and the stones erupt in a burst of thunderous energy that deals 14 (4d6) thunder damage to the target and each creature within 10 feet of the target. On a successful save, the stones vanish without erupting.

StoneAvalanche(RequiresHillRune).name: StoneAvalanche(RequiresHillRune)
StoneAvalanche(RequiresHillRune).description:
The giant conjures a hail of rocks in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point on the ground it can see within 120 feet of itself. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage and has the prone condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.
The rocks turn the ground in that area into difficult terrain until the start of the giant's next turn, when the rocks vanish.

Illumination.name: Illumination
Illumination.description: The lightning hulk sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

LightningForm.name: Lightning Form
LightningForm.description: The lightning hulk can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time the lightning hulk enters a creature's space on a turn, or if it begins its turn in a creature's space, that creature takes 7 (2d6) lightning damage. The hulk can also move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing. A creature that touches the lightning hulk or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) lightning damage.

ArcLightning.name: ArcLightning
ArcLightning.description: mw,rw 9 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. on hit: 18 (4d8) lightning damage. If the target is a creature, it can't take reactions until the start of its next turn, and lightning jumps from the target to another creature of the lightning hulk's choice that it can see within 30 feet of the target. The second creature must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 (4d8) lightning damage.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The maw has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The maw makes two Bite or Fang Fling attacks.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) piercing damage.

FangFling.name: FangFling
FangFling.description: rw 10 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (1d10 + 6) piercing damage.

GorgingCharge{@recharge5}.name: GorgingCharge{@recharge5}
GorgingCharge{@recharge5}.description: The maw moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks and can move through the spaces of Large or smaller creatures. Each time the maw enters a creature's space for the first time during this move, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or take 25 (3d12 + 6) piercing damage and have the grappled condition (escape 16); if a creature is already grappled this way, it has the prone condition. Until this grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition. The maw can have only one creature grappled in this way at a time.

AirForm.name: Air Form
AirForm.description: The mist hulk can enter another creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

DeathBurst.name: Death Burst
DeathBurst.description: When the mist hulk dies, it bursts in a wave of water. Each creature within 10 feet of it must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage and has the prone condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The mist hulk makes two Slam attacks.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) cold damage.

HideousWailing{@recharge5}.name: HideousWailing{@recharge5}
HideousWailing{@recharge5}.description: The mist hulk releases a wail infused with magical anguish. Each creature within 30 feet of it must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. A creature in the mist hulk's space has disadvantage on the saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage and has the incapacitated condition for 1 minute. The affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Amorphous.name: Amorphous
Amorphous.description: The mud hulk can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

StickyMud.name: Sticky Mud
StickyMud.description: The ground within 15 feet of the mud hulk is difficult terrain for other creatures.

EnvelopingSlam.name: EnvelopingSlam
EnvelopingSlam.description:
mw 5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be pulled into the mud hulk's space and be engulfed by the mud hulk. While engulfed, the target can't breathe, has the restrained condition, and takes 6 (1d12) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. When the mud hulk moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The mud hulk can have only one target engulfed at a time. While a creature is engulfed, the mud hulk can't use its Amorphous trait.
An engulfed target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a successful save, the target escapes and enters the nearest unoccupied space.

MudSplash.name: MudSplash
MudSplash.description: The mud hulk lobs a mass of mud that splashes in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 30 feet of the mud hulk. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The affected area is difficult terrain until the start of the mud hulk's next turn.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The regisaur has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The regisaur makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack. The regisaur can't target the same creature with both attacks.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 47 (6d12 + 8) piercing damage, and the target has the grappled condition (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition, and the regisaur can't Bite another target.

Tail.name: Tail
Tail.description: mw 13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 26 (4d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

DeathBurst.name: Death Burst
DeathBurst.description: When the rime hulk dies, it explodes in a 10-foot-radius sphere of frigid air and frost centered on itself. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) cold damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The rime hulk makes two Slam attacks.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage.

TrailofFrost{@recharge5}.name: TrailofFrost{@recharge5}
TrailofFrost{@recharge5}.description: The rime hulk moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks and can move through the space of any Medium or smaller creature. Each time the rime hulk enters another creature's space for the first time during this move, that creature must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 22 (4d10) cold damage, and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of the rime hulk's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

ImmutableForm.name: Immutable Form
ImmutableForm.description: The colossus is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The colossus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

SiegeMonster.name: Siege Monster
SiegeMonster.description: The colossus deals double damage to objects and structures.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The colossus makes two Slam attacks and then uses Stomp.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

Stomp.name: Stomp
Stomp.description: mw 14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or have the prone condition. Until the colossus uses its Stomp again or moves, the creature has the restrained condition. The restrained creature or another creature within 5 feet of it can use its action to make a DC 22 Strength check. On a successful check, the affected creature relocates to an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 feet of the colossus and is no longer restrained.

ArcaneBeam{@recharge5}.name: ArcaneBeam{@recharge5}
ArcaneBeam{@recharge5}.description: The colossus fires a beam of magical force from its chest, hands, or head in a 150-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 58 (9d12) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

LegendaryResistance(6/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(6/Day).description: If the scion fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The scion has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

SiegeMonster.name: Siege Monster
SiegeMonster.description: The scion deals double damage to objects and structures.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The scion makes one Great Tree Club attack and two Slam attacks, or it makes three Boulder attacks.

GreatTreeClub.name: GreatTreeClub
GreatTreeClub.description: mw 15 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. on hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 23 Strength saving throw or be pushed horizontally up to 100 feet straight away from the scion and have the prone condition.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 26 (4d8 + 8) force damage.

Boulder.name: Boulder
Boulder.description: rw 15 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. on hit: 27 (3d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

Inhale{@recharge5}.name: Inhale{@recharge5}
Inhale{@recharge5}.description:
The scion inhales a vortex of air in a 120-foot line that is 15 feet wide. Each creature in that area that is Huge or smaller must succeed on a DC 23 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 120 feet straight toward the scion and be swallowed. A swallowed creature has the restrained condition, has Cover||3||total cover against attacks and other effects outside the scion, and takes 24 (7d6) force damage at the start of each of the scion's turns.
The scion's stomach can hold up to two creatures at a time. If the scion takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the scion must succeed on a 17 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the scion and has the prone condition. If the scion dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting with the prone condition.

Flyby.name: Flyby
Flyby.description: The scion doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

LegendaryResistance(6/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(6/Day).description: If the scion fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The scion has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

SiegeMonster.name: Siege Monster
SiegeMonster.description: The scion deals double damage to objects and structures.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The scion makes one attack using Cloud Morningstar or Wind Javelin, as well as two Slam attacks.

CloudMorningstar.name: CloudMorningstar
CloudMorningstar.description: mw 18 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. on hit: 32 (4d10 + 10) force damage plus 22 (4d10) thunder damage.

WindJavelin.name: WindJavelin
WindJavelin.description: rw 18 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. on hit: 42 (5d12 + 10) thunder damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) force damage.

ThunderousVortex{@recharge5}.name: ThunderousVortex{@recharge5}
ThunderousVortex{@recharge5}.description: The scion magically creates a vortex of wind in a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on a point it can see within 120 feet of itself. Each creature in the sphere must succeed on a DC 24 Strength saving throw or be pulled straight toward the sphere's center, ending in an unoccupied space as close as possible to the center. Then a burst of thunder erupts in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on the same point. Each creature in that area takes 52 (8d12) thunder damage and must succeed on a DC 24 Constitution saving throw or have the stunned condition until the end of its next turn.

LegendaryResistance(6/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(6/Day).description: If the scion fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The scion has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

SiegeMonster.name: Siege Monster
SiegeMonster.description: The scion deals double damage to objects and structures.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The scion makes one Crystal Club attack and two Slam attacks, then uses Entombing Grasp if available. Alternatively, the scion makes two Runic Boulder attacks.

CrystalClub.name: CrystalClub
CrystalClub.description: mw 16 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. on hit: 35 (4d12 + 9) bludgeoning damage. {@hom}The scion can cause the club to flare with bright light, and the target must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or take 18 (4d8) radiant damage and have the blinded condition until the start of the scion's next turn.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 31 (4d10 + 9) force damage.

RunicBoulder.name: RunicBoulder
RunicBoulder.description: rw 16 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. on hit: 27 (4d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage. {@hom}The boulder explodes. The target and each creature within 30 feet of it must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 19 (3d12) force damage and has the prone condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

EntombingGrasp{@recharge}.name: EntombingGrasp{@recharge}
EntombingGrasp{@recharge}.description: The scion wreathes its hand in petrifying magic and touches one Huge or smaller creature it can see within 20 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) force damage and have the grappled condition (escape 19). At the start of the scion's next turn, if the target is still grappled, the target has the petrified condition.

Flyby.name: Flyby
Flyby.description: The scion doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

LegendaryResistance(6/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(6/Day).description: If the scion fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The scion has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

SiegeMonster.name: Siege Monster
SiegeMonster.description: The scion deals double damage to objects and structures.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The scion makes one attack using Lightning Sword or Hailstone, as well as two Slam attacks.

LightningSword.name: LightningSword
LightningSword.description: mw 18 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. on hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) force damage plus 22 (4d10) lightning damage.

Hailstone.name: Hailstone
Hailstone.description: rw 18 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. on hit: 32 (4d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) force damage.

LegendaryResistance(6/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(6/Day).description: If the scion fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The scion has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

SiegeMonster.name: Siege Monster
SiegeMonster.description: The scion deals double damage to objects and structures.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The scion makes one attack using Lava Blade or Lava Ball, as well as two Slam attacks.

LavaBlade.name: LavaBlade
LavaBlade.description: mw 18 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. on hit: 32 (4d10 + 10) slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) fire damage.

LavaBall.name: LavaBall
LavaBall.description: rw 18 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. on hit: 29 (3d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) force damage.

LavaWave{@recharge5}.name: LavaWave{@recharge5}
LavaWave{@recharge5}.description: The scion emits a wave of lava from its blade, hands, or mouth in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 60 (11d10) fire damage and has the restrained condition from being embedded in hardening rock. A creature can make a DC 25 Strength (Athletics) check as an action, freeing itself or a creature within reach from the rock on a success. The rock has AC 17 and 40 hit points, and it is immune to fire, poison, and psychic damage. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

LegendaryResistance(6/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(6/Day).description: If the scion fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The scion has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

SiegeMonster.name: Siege Monster
SiegeMonster.description: The scion deals double damage to objects and structures.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The scion makes one Ice Axe and two Slam attacks, or it makes two Glacier Throw attacks.

IceAxe.name: IceAxe
IceAxe.description: mw 17 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. on hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) force damage plus 18 (4d8) cold damage.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 32 (4d10 + 10) force damage.

GlacierThrow.name: GlacierThrow
GlacierThrow.description: rw 17 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. on hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 25 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

GlacialUpheaval{@recharge5}.name: GlacialUpheaval{@recharge5}
GlacialUpheaval{@recharge5}.description:
The scion digs its hands into the ground at a point it can see within 30 feet of itself and launches a magically conjured mass of ice into the air. Each creature other than the scion in a 30-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder centered on that point must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 36 (8d8) bludgeoning damage plus 19 (3d12) cold damage and is pushed vertically to the top of the cylinder, at which point the creature falls. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space outside the cylinder with no additional effects.
At the start of the scion's next turn, a mass of ice plummets to the ground on a point the scion can see within 60 feet of the point the scion dug its hands into. Each creature in a 30-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder centered on that point must succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) cold damage.

BlurredForm.name: Blurred Form
BlurredForm.description: Attack rolls against the spectral cloud are made with disadvantage unless the attacker is within 15 feet of the spectral cloud or the spectral cloud is incapacitated.

IncorporealMovement.name: Incorporeal Movement
IncorporealMovement.description: The spectral cloud can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The spectral cloud makes two Spectral Touch attacks.

SpectralTouch.name: SpectralTouch
SpectralTouch.description:
mw 12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) force damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.
A Humanoid slain by this attack immediately rises as a miniature spectral cloud (use the specter stat block in the Monster Manual). The miniature spectral cloud acts as an ally of its creator but isn't under its control.

ChillingWinds{@recharge5}.name: ChillingWinds{@recharge5}
ChillingWinds{@recharge5}.description:
The spectral cloud emits intensely cold wind in a 60-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 38 (7d10) cold damage and has the incapacitated condition for 1 minute. The affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.
If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, that creature is immune to this spectral cloud's Chilling Winds for the next 24 hours.

PackTactics.name: Pack Tactics
PackTactics.description: The lion has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the lion's allies is within 5 feet of the target and the ally doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

Rend.name: Rend
Rend.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage. If the lion moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition. If the target has the prone condition, the lion can make another Rend attack against it as a bonus action.

LabyrinthineRecall.name: Labyrinthine Recall
LabyrinthineRecall.description: The stalker can perfectly recall any path it has traveled.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The stalker has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The stalker makes two Glaive attacks or two Rock attacks.

Glaive.name: Glaive
Glaive.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) force damage.

Rock.name: Rock
Rock.description: rw 11 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. on hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition. After the stalker throws the rock, roll a d6; on a roll of 3 or lower, the stalker has no more rocks to throw.

EruptingHorns{@recharge5}.name: EruptingHorns{@recharge5}
EruptingHorns{@recharge5}.description:
The stalker causes the earth to churn at a point on the ground it can see within 60 feet of itself. Six horn-shaped stones erupt in a 30-foot-radius, 30-foot-high cylinder centered on that point and then crumble to dust.
Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 33 (6d10) piercing damage and is pushed up to 30 feet upward and then falls. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The giant makes two Thundering Stone Club or Boulder attacks in any combination.

ThunderingStoneClub.name: ThunderingStoneClub
ThunderingStoneClub.description: mw 10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage. The giant can cause the club to emit a burst of thunderous energy that deals 10 (3d6) thunder damage to each creature, other than the giant, within 30 feet of the target. The club can emit a burst this way only once per turn.

Boulder.name: Boulder
Boulder.description: rw 10 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. on hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition. After the giant throws the boulder, roll a d6; on a roll of 3 or lower, the giant has no more boulders to throw.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the giant fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

StoneRune.name: Stone Rune
StoneRune.description:
The giant has a stone rune inscribed on a mineral object in its possession. While holding or wearing the object bearing the rune, the giant can use its Prismatic Rays action.
The object bearing the rune has AC 18; 30 hit points; and immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. The object regains all its hit points at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 hit points or when the giant dies. If the rune is destroyed, the giant can inscribe a stone rune on an object in its possession when it finishes a short or long rest.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The giant makes three Prism Staff attacks.

PrismStaff.name: PrismStaff
PrismStaff.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage.

ExplodingGeode.name: ExplodingGeode
ExplodingGeode.description: The giant throws a geode at a point within 60 feet of itself, and the geode explodes in a dazzling flash. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 13 (3d8) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage and has the blinded condition until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. After the giant throws the geode, roll a d6; on a roll of 4 or lower, the giant has no more geodes to throw.

PrismaticRays(RequiresStoneRune).name: PrismaticRays(RequiresStoneRune)
PrismaticRays(RequiresStoneRune).description: The giant's stone rune emits beams of light that form a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. For each creature in that area, roll a d6 to determine what ray affects it:

1-2:BlazingRed.name: 1-2:BlazingRed
1-2:BlazingRed.description: On a failed save, the creature takes 35 (10d6) radiant damage and has the blinded condition until the end of the giant's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

3-4:DreadfulBlue.name: 3-4:DreadfulBlue
3-4:DreadfulBlue.description: On a failed save, the creature takes 35 (10d6) necrotic damage and has the frightened condition until the end of the giant's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

5-6:SappingGreen.name: 5-6:SappingGreen
5-6:SappingGreen.description: On a failed save, the creature takes 35 (10d6) force damage and has the incapacitated condition until the end of the giant's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

Amphibious.name: Amphibious
Amphibious.description: The crab can breathe air and water.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The crab makes two Claw attacks and one Stinger attack.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 16). The crab has four claws, each of which can grapple one target.

Stinger.name: Stinger
Stinger.description: mw 10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. on hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned and paralyzed conditions for 1 minute. The affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending both the poisoned and paralyzed conditions on itself on a success.

WaterJet{@recharge5}.name: WaterJet{@recharge5}
WaterJet{@recharge5}.description: The crab exhales water in a 150-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 27 (6d8) bludgeoning damage, is pushed up to 30 feet from the crab, and has the prone condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

Alert.name: Alert
Alert.description: The giant can't be surprised, and it has advantage on initiative rolls.

Amphibious.name: Amphibious
Amphibious.description: The giant can breathe air and water.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the giant fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Scrying(RequiresStormRune).name: Scrying (Requires Storm Rune)
Scrying(RequiresStormRune).description: The giant can use its crystal ball to cast the scrying spell (save DC 17).

StormRune.name: Storm Rune
StormRune.description:
The giant has a storm rune inscribed on a crystal ball. While the object bearing the rune is embedded in its body, the giant can use its Tempest Call action and its Scrying trait.
The object bearing the storm rune has AC 17; 50 hit points; and immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. The object regains all its hit points at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 hit points or when the giant dies. If the rune is destroyed, the giant can inscribe a storm rune on another crystal ball in its possession when it finishes a short or long rest.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The giant makes three Lightning Blade or Lightning Lance attacks.

LightningBlade.name: LightningBlade
LightningBlade.description: mw 15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) slashing damage plus 16 (3d10) lightning damage.

LightningLance.name: LightningLance
LightningLance.description: rs 13 to hit, range 500 ft., one target. on hit: 39 (5d12 + 7) lightning damage.

TempestCall(RequiresStormRune).name: TempestCall(RequiresStormRune)
TempestCall(RequiresStormRune).description: The giant creates an elemental vortex that fills a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Each creature in that area other than the giant must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 43 (8d8 + 7) damage of a type of the giant's choosing: cold, lightning, or thunder. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

Amphibious.name: Amphibious
Amphibious.description: The herald can breathe air and water.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The herald has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The herald makes one Claw attack, one Tentacles attack, and one Trident attack.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) slashing damage.

Tentacles.name: Tentacles
Tentacles.description: mw 14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 18). It also has the restrained condition and takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns until this grapple ends. The herald can have only one creature grappled this way at a time.

Trident.name: Trident
Trident.description: mw 14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) piercing damage or 21 (3d8 + 8) piercing damage if used with two hands, plus 13 (3d8) lightning damage.

PsychicWave{@recharge}.name: PsychicWave{@recharge}
PsychicWave{@recharge}.description:
The herald unleashes a blast of psionic energy into the minds of up to three creatures it can see within 90 feet of itself. Each target must make a DC 21 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 23 (3d10 + 7) psychic damage and has the stunned condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage only. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
If a creature is reduced to 0 hit points by this psychic damage, it dies and its head explodes if it has one.

IncorporealMovement.name: Incorporeal Movement
IncorporealMovement.description: The spirit can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. The spirit takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the spirit fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The spirit makes two Lightning Fist or Hailstone attacks in any combination.

LightningFist.name: LightningFist
LightningFist.description: mw 12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) lightning damage.

Hailstone.name: Hailstone
Hailstone.description: rw 12 to hit, range 90/180 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.

DeathBolt{@recharge5}.name: DeathBolt{@recharge5}
DeathBolt{@recharge5}.description: The spirit hurls a magical lightning bolt in a 120-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) lightning damage plus 16 (3d10) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a success or failure, an affected creature's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest. The creature dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

BeastofBurden.name: Beast of Burden
BeastofBurden.description: The titanothere is considered to be one size larger for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

Stomp.name: Stomp
Stomp.description: mw 10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the titanothere moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition if it is a creature.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the amalgam fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The amalgam has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: The amalgam regains 15 hit points at the start of its turn. If the amalgam takes acid or fire damage, it regains only 5 hit points at the start of its next turn. The amalgam dies only if it takes 20 or more acid or fire damage while it has 0 hit points.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The amalgam makes three Rend attacks.

Rend.name: Rend
Rend.description: mw 13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) slashing damage.

Mutation.name: Mutation
Mutation.description: When the troll mutate is created, it gains one of four possible body mutations at random: 1, Elastic Body; 2, Psionic Mirror; 3, Spell Scarred; or 4, Winged Form. This mutation determines certain traits in this stat block.

Amorphous(ElasticBodyOnly).name: Amorphous (Elastic Body Only)
Amorphous(ElasticBodyOnly).description: The mutate can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

MagicResistance(SpellScarredOnly).name: Magic Resistance (Spell Scarred Only)
MagicResistance(SpellScarredOnly).description: The mutate has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

PsychicRebuke(PsionicMirrorOnly).name: Psychic Rebuke (Psionic Mirror Only)
PsychicRebuke(PsionicMirrorOnly).description: If the mutate takes psychic damage, each creature within 20 feet of it takes that damage as well.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: The mutate regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the mutate takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the mutate's next turn. The mutate dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate. If the mutate starts its turn with 0 hit points and regenerates, it randomly gains a mutation it doesn't already have (up to a maximum of four mutations).

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The mutate makes two Rend attacks.

Rend.name: Rend
Rend.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft. (or 15 ft. if the mutate has the Elastic Body mutation), one target. on hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) force damage.

PsychicBurst{@recharge5}.name: PsychicBurst{@recharge5}
PsychicBurst{@recharge5}.description: The mutate unleashes a wave of psychic energy. Each creature within 30 feet of the mutate must make a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

LegendaryResistance(2/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(2/Day).description: If the assassin fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The assassin makes two Poison Blade attacks.

PoisonBlade.name: PoisonBlade
PoisonBlade.description: mw,rw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage.

HungeroftheVoid.name: Hunger of the Void
HungeroftheVoid.description: When the aspirant is reduced to 0 hit points, its body and everything it is wearing or carrying, except for magic items, are sucked into a void and destroyed. Creatures in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on the aspirant must make a DC 11 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage and is pulled 10 feet straight toward the aspirant's space. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

SinisterDevotion.name: Sinister Devotion
SinisterDevotion.description: The aspirant has advantage on saving throws against the charmed and frightened conditions.

Spear.name: Spear
Spear.description: mw,rw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

GuardianAura.name: Guardian Aura
GuardianAura.description: Whenever a creature of Asteria's choice within 30 feet of her makes a saving throw, Asteria can give the creature advantage on the saving throw (no action required). This trait doesn't function if Asteria has the incapacitated condition.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If Asteria fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

SpecialEquipment.name: Special Equipment
SpecialEquipment.description: Asteria wears Winged Boots, which grant her a flying speed (included in her statistics). She also carries one half of a pair of Sending Stones; the other half of the pair is held by Euryale.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Asteria makes two Radiant Blade attacks and uses Bursting Benediction.

RadiantBlade.name: RadiantBlade
RadiantBlade.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage.

BurstingBenediction.name: BurstingBenediction
BurstingBenediction.description: Asteria causes a burst of magical energy to envelop one creature she can see within 60 feet of herself. The target must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 40 (9d8) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Asteria or another creature that she can see within 60 feet of herself then regains 10 hit points.

HeatRegeneration.name: Heat Regeneration
HeatRegeneration.description: If the temperature around it is 100 degrees Fahrenheit or higher, Aurnozci regains 15 hit points at the start of its turn. If it takes cold or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. Aurnozci dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If Aurnozci fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: Aurnozci has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Aurnozci makes one Bite attack and two Tail attacks.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 21 (2d12 + 8) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) fire damage.

Tail.name: Tail
Tail.description: mw 15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

MucusSpray{@recharge5}.name: MucusSpray{@recharge5}
MucusSpray{@recharge5}.description: Aurnozci sprays mucus in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that cone must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: Augustus regains 10 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes damage from a silver weapon, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Augustus dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

SpecialEquipment.name: Special Equipment
SpecialEquipment.description: Augustus wields a +2 Longsword.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Augustus makes any combination of two Bite, Claw, or Magic Longsword attacks.

Bite(WolforHybridFormOnly).name: Bite(WolforHybridFormOnly)
Bite(WolforHybridFormOnly).description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 26 (5d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with lycanthropy. While cursed in this way, the target retains its alignment, languages, and equipment but otherwise uses the werewolf stat block, excluding actions that require equipment the target doesn't have. During any night when there's a full moon in the sky, the target becomes an NPC under the DM's control and remains so until the night ends. A Remove Curse spell or similar magic ends this curse.

Claw(WolforHybridFormOnly).name: Claw(WolforHybridFormOnly)
Claw(WolforHybridFormOnly).description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 21 (5d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

MagicLongsword(HumanoidorHybridFormOnly).name: MagicLongsword(HumanoidorHybridFormOnly)

value.value: Magic Longsword (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)

MagicLongsword(HumanoidorHybridFormOnly).description: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) slashing damage.

Evasion.name: Evasion
Evasion.description: If Delour is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw and only half damage if he fails, provided he doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

Nimbleness.name: Nimbleness
Nimbleness.description: Delour can move through the space of a Medium or larger creature.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: Delour regains 10 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes damage from a silver weapon, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Delour dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Delour makes any combination of three Bite, Shortsword, or Hand Crossbow attacks.

Bite(RatorHybridFormOnly).name: Bite(RatorHybridFormOnly)
Bite(RatorHybridFormOnly).description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 26 (5d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with lycanthropy. While cursed in this way, the target retains its alignment, languages, and equipment but otherwise uses the wererat stat block, excluding actions that require equipment the target doesn't have. During any night when there's a full moon in the sky, the target becomes an NPC under the DM's control and remains so until the night ends. A Remove Curse spell or similar magic ends this curse.

Shortsword(HumanoidorHybridFormOnly).name: Shortsword(HumanoidorHybridFormOnly)
Shortsword(HumanoidorHybridFormOnly).description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

HandCrossbow(HumanoidorHybridFormOnly).name: HandCrossbow(HumanoidorHybridFormOnly)

value.value: Hand Crossbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)

HandCrossbow(HumanoidorHybridFormOnly).description: rw 8 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

IncorporealMovement.name: Incorporeal Movement
IncorporealMovement.description: The breath drinker can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

RadiantAbsorption.name: Radiant Absorption
RadiantAbsorption.description: When the breath drinker is subjected to radiant damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the radiant damage dealt.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The breath drinker makes two Enervating Claw attacks. It can also use Drink Breath.

EnervatingClaw.name: EnervatingClaw
EnervatingClaw.description: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) necrotic damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 18). The target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

DrinkBreath.name: DrinkBreath
DrinkBreath.description: The breath drinker targets a creature that has the incapacitated condition or that the breath drinker is grappling and that isn't a Construct or an Undead. The target must make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 36 (8d8) necrotic damage, and its Charisma score is reduced by 1d6. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. If this reduces the target's Charisma to 0, the target dies. Until the breath drinker dies, the dead target can't be returned to life by any means short of divine intervention. On a successful save, the target takes half as much necrotic damage only. On a successful or failed save, the breath drinker regains a number of hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt.

Invisibility.name: Invisibility
Invisibility.description: The breath drinker has the invisible condition. This invisibility ends immediately after the breath drinker hits or misses with an attack roll or uses Drink Breath.

DemonicRitual.name: Demonic Ritual
DemonicRitual.description: Brusipha can spend 3 hours performing a ritual that summons 1d3 + 1 barlguras or 1 hezrou. She must sacrifice a Medium or larger living creature to Baphomet during this ritual, and the ritual can be performed only at night. The demons vanish at dawn.

LabyrinthineRecall.name: Labyrinthine Recall
LabyrinthineRecall.description: Brusipha can perfectly recall any path she has traveled.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Brusipha makes two Eldritch Blast attacks.

EldritchBlast.name: EldritchBlast
EldritchBlast.description: rs 5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) force damage.

Gore.name: Gore
Gore.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage. If Brusipha moved at least 10 feet straight toward the target immediately before she hit, the target takes an extra 4 (1d8) piercing damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet from Brusipha and have the prone condition.

IncitetheHunters(RechargesafteraShortorL.name: IncitetheHunters(RechargesafteraShortorLongRest)

value.value: Incite the Hunters (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)

IncitetheHunters(RechargesafteraShortorL.description: Brusipha allows each ally within 30 feet of herself that has the Unerring Tracker trait to make one weapon attack as a reaction against the target of that ally's Unerring Tracker.

AlliedKnight.name: Allied Knight
AlliedKnight.description: Some of the deck defender's statistics are based on the character who drew the Knight card. Where the deck defender stat block refers to "you," it refers to that character.

FoldedVersatility.name: Folded Versatility
FoldedVersatility.description: After finishing a long rest, you can refold the deck defender's shape, changing it to acrobat form, berserker form, or guardian form.

Fragile.name: Fragile
Fragile.description: If the deck defender is reduced to 0 hit points, it collapses into a haphazard pile of nonmagical playing cards and can't be resurrected or reconstructed.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The deck defender makes a number of attacks equal to half its proficiency bonus (rounded down).

PaperCut.name: PaperCut
PaperCut.description: mw PB + 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

RecklessStrike(BerserkerFormOnly).name: RecklessStrike(BerserkerFormOnly)
RecklessStrike(BerserkerFormOnly).description: mw PB + 3 to hit (with advantage), reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage, and attacks made against the deck defender until the start of its next turn have advantage.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the infiltrator fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

VeiledPresence.name: Veiled Presence
VeiledPresence.description: The infiltrator's AC includes its Wisdom modifier, and the infiltrator can't be targeted by divination magic or features that would read its mind or determine its creature type.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The infiltrator makes two Poison Blade attacks and can use Beguiling Whisper.

PoisonBlade.name: PoisonBlade
PoisonBlade.description: mw,rw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) poison damage.

BeguilingWhisper.name: BeguilingWhisper
BeguilingWhisper.description: The infiltrator magically whispers to a creature it can see within 30 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or have the stunned condition due to fear or delight (the infiltrator's choice) until the end of the target's next turn, after which the target is immune to this Beguiling Whisper for 24 hours.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If Euryale fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

SpecialEquipment.name: Special Equipment
SpecialEquipment.description: Euryale carries one half of a pair of Sending Stones; the other half of the pair is held by Asteria.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Euryale makes three attacks. If she is in serpent form, only one of these attacks can be Constrict.

Constrict(SerpentFormOnly).name: Constrict(SerpentFormOnly)
Constrict(SerpentFormOnly).description: mw 11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. on hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target has the grappled condition (escape DC 19). Until this grapple ends, the target takes 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns, and Euryale can't constrict another target.

SnakeBite.name: SnakeBite
SnakeBite.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition until the start of Euryale's next turn.

VerdantBolt(MedusaFormOnly).name: VerdantBolt(MedusaFormOnly)
VerdantBolt(MedusaFormOnly).description: rs 11 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 18 (4d8) acid damage.

LegendaryResistance(2/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(2/Day).description: If the hag fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

TracetheThreads(1/Day).name: Trace the Threads
TracetheThreads(1/Day).description: The hag can cast the Legend Lore spell, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The hag makes two Shears attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

Shears.name: Shears
Shears.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) force damage. If the target is a creature, it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of the hag's next turn.

EtherealSight.name: Ethereal Sight
EtherealSight.description: Gremorly can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when he is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

IncorporealMovement.name: Incorporeal Movement
IncorporealMovement.description: Gremorly can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. He takes 5 (1d10) force damage if he ends his turn inside an object.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If Gremorly fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Gremorly makes three Withering Strike attacks.

WitheringStrike.name: WitheringStrike
WitheringStrike.description: ms 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 19 (3d12) necrotic damage.

FellNecromancy.name: FellNecromancy
FellNecromancy.description: Gremorly targets one creature he can see within 60 feet of himself. The target must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 61 (7d8 + 30) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, Gremorly regains 9 (2d8) hit points.

Possession{@recharge}.name: Possession{@recharge}
Possession{@recharge}.description:
One Humanoid Gremorly can see within 5 feet of himself must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by him; Gremorly disappears, and the target has the incapacitated condition and loses control of its body. Gremorly can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn Undead, and he retains his alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to the charmed and frightened conditions. He otherwise uses the target's game statistics, but Gremorly doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.
The possession lasts until the target drops to 0 hit points, Gremorly ends it as a bonus action, or Gremorly is turned or forced out by an effect like the Dispel Evil and Good spell. When the possession ends, Gremorly reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target. The target is immune to this Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the champion fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The champion makes four Blazing Morningstar attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with Blade Storm, if available.

BlazingMorningstar.name: BlazingMorningstar
BlazingMorningstar.description: mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage.

BladeStorm{@recharge5}.name: BladeStorm{@recharge5}
BladeStorm{@recharge5}.description: The champion conjures a churning storm of spectral blades that fills a 20-foot cube centered on a point it can see within 120 feet of itself. The storm lasts until the start of the champion's next turn. While the storm is active, the area of the storm is difficult terrain. Whenever a creature enters the storm for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) slashing damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the champion fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The champion makes two Leeching Blade attacks and uses Hollow Void.

LeechingBlade.name: LeechingBlade
LeechingBlade.description: mw 14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 33 (6d10) cold damage, and the champion regains 10 hit points.

HollowVoid.name: HollowVoid
HollowVoid.description: The champion summons a hungering rift around a creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The creature must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 49 (11d8) force damage and has the stunned condition until the start of the champion's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only. If a creature is reduced to 0 hit points by this effect, the creature dies, and its body crumbles to dust.

HaloofPestilence.name: Halo of Pestilence
HaloofPestilence.description: The champion is surrounded by an aura of deadly magic that takes the form of a host of glowing white insects. Each creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the champion must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or have the incapacitated condition until the start of its next turn, as the insects ravage its body.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the champion fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The champion makes two Blight Staff attacks, two Plague Bolt attacks, or one of each.

BlightStaff.name: BlightStaff
BlightStaff.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage.

PlagueBolt.name: PlagueBolt
PlagueBolt.description: rs 10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 23 (4d8 + 5) poison damage, and the target has the poisoned condition until the start of the champion's next turn.

Talons.name: Talons
Talons.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

PlaneShift(2/Day).name: PlaneShift(2/Day)
PlaneShift(2/Day).description: The hawk casts Plane Shift on itself, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

PackTactics.name: Pack Tactics
