CrystallineSpit{@recharge5}.name: CrystallineSpit{@recharge5}
CrystallineSpit{@recharge5}.description: The drone spits crackling gel in a line 5 feet wide and 20 feet long. Each creature in the line must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 14 (4d6) lightning damage and is restrained by the gel, which hardens into crystal. The creature is restrained until the crystal is destroyed. The crystal has AC 15, 15 hit points, immunity to poison and psychic damage, and vulnerability to thunder damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't restrained.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The soldier makes two Longsword attacks.

Longsword.name: Longsword
Longsword.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage if used with two hands.

SpecialEquipment.name: Special Equipment
SpecialEquipment.description: Kansaldi has a glowing ruby embedded in her left eye socket. The gem functions as her eye and grants her truesight (included above). The gem can't be removed while Kansaldi is alive. When she dies, a creature can remove the gem as an action. The gem then functions as a gem of seeing.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Kansaldi makes two Pike attacks and uses Flame Burst.

Pike.name: Pike
Pike.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 16 (3d10) radiant damage.

FlameBurst.name: FlameBurst
FlameBurst.description: Kansaldi hurls magical flames at a creature she can see within 60 feet of herself. The target must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 11 (2d10) fire damage and catches fire; until a creature takes an action to put out the fire, the target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and doesn't catch fire.

DeathThroes.name: Death Throes
DeathThroes.description: When the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points, it dissolves into acid that splashes on those around it. Each creature within 5 feet of the draconian must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be covered in acid for 1 minute. A creature covered in the acid takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can use its action to scrape or wash the acid off itself or another creature.

Glide.name: Glide
Glide.description: When the draconian falls and isn't incapacitated, it subtracts up to 100 feet from the fall when calculating the fall's damage, and it can move up to 2 feet horizontally for every 1 foot it descends.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The draconian makes two Dagger attacks. If both attacks hit the same creature, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned until the end of the target's next turn. While poisoned in this way, the target is also paralyzed.

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.description: mw,rw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

Hoopak.name: Hoopak
Hoopak.description: mw,rw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 40/160 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage if the kender used the hoopak's sling to make a ranged attack.

Taunt.name: Taunt
Taunt.description: The kender launches a barrage of insults at a creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. If the target can hear the kender, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

EtherealSight.name: Ethereal Sight
EtherealSight.description: Leedara can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when she is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

IncorporealMovement.name: Incorporeal Movement
IncorporealMovement.description: Leedara can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. She takes 5 (1d10) force damage if she ends her turn inside an object.

WitheringTouch.name: WitheringTouch
WitheringTouch.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.

Etherealness.name: Etherealness
Etherealness.description: Leedara enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. She is visible on the Material Plane while she is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet she can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

HorrifyingVisage.name: HorrifyingVisage
HorrifyingVisage.description: Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of Leedara that can see her must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4 × 10 years. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to Leedara's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a greater restoration spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

Possession{@recharge}.name: Possession{@recharge}
Possession{@recharge}.description:
One humanoid that the ghost can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by Leedara; Leedara then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. Leedara now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. Leedara can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and she retains her alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. She otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.
The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, Leedara ends it as a bonus action, or Leedara is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, Leedara reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to Leedara's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

ChangeShape.name: ChangeShape
ChangeShape.description: Leedara magically assumes the appearance she had in life, and her creature type changes to Humanoid, while retaining her other game statistics. This transformation ends if Leedara is reduced to 0 hit points or uses an action to end it.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The dragon doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The dragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft. one target. on hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The dragon has two claws, each of which can grapple one target.

CataclysmicBreath{@recharge5}.name: CataclysmicBreath{@recharge5}
CataclysmicBreath{@recharge5}.description: The dragon exhales a wave of ghostly purple flames in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature dies if the breath reduces it to 0 hit points. Additionally, any Medium or smaller Humanoid killed by the breath's damage, as well as every corpse of such a creatures within the cone, becomes a zombie (see the Monster Manual) under the dragon's control. The zombie acts on the dragon's initiative but immediately after the dragon's turn. Absent any other command, the zombie tries to kill any non-Undead creature it encounters.

BonusProficiencies.name: Bonus Proficiencies
BonusProficiencies.description: Levna is proficient with simple and martial weapons, shields, and all armor.

PackTactics.name: Pack Tactics
PackTactics.description: Levna has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of her allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

Greatsword.name: Greatsword
Greatsword.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.

ToxicMastery.name: Toxic Mastery
ToxicMastery.description: Lohezet ignores a creature's resistance to poison damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Lohezet makes three Withering Blast attacks and uses Miasma if it's available. He can replace one of the attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

WitheringBlast.name: WitheringBlast
WitheringBlast.description: ms,rs 9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. on hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) necrotic damage.

Miasma{@recharge4}.name: Miasma{@recharge4}
Miasma{@recharge4}.description: Lohezet magically conjures a billowing cloud of purple fog in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 120 feet of himself. The area within the sphere is heavily obscured, and when a creature starts its turn in the sphere or enters the sphere for the first time on a turn, it must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 39 (6d12) poison damage and is poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't poisoned. The cloud lasts for 1 minute, until Lohezet ends it early (no action required), or until Lohezet uses this action again. A strong wind disperses the cloud.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If Soth fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: Soth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

MarshalUndead.name: Marshal Undead
MarshalUndead.description: Unless Soth is incapacitated, he and Undead creatures of his choice within 60 feet of him are immune to features that turn Undead.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: Soth doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Soth makes three Forsaken Brand attacks.

ForsakenBrand.name: ForsakenBrand
ForsakenBrand.description: mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, it can't regain hit points until the start of Soth's next turn.

CataclysmicFire(1/Day).name: CataclysmicFire(1/Day)
CataclysmicFire(1/Day).description:
Soth hurls a magical ball of fire that explodes at a point he can see within 120 feet of himself. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 35 (10d6) fire damage and 35 (10d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Additionally, any Medium or smaller Humanoid killed by this damage, as well as every corpse of such a creature within the sphere, becomes a skeleton (see the Monster Manual) under Soth's control. The skeleton acts on Soth's initiative but immediately after his turn. Absent any other command, the skeleton tries to kill any non-Undead creature it encounters.

WordofDeath(1/Day).name: WordofDeath(1/Day)
WordofDeath(1/Day).description: Soth points at a creature he can see within 60 feet of himself and magically commands it to die. The target must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 100 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target dies.

DraconicDevotion.name: Draconic Devotion
DraconicDevotion.description: While Red Ruin can see a Dragon that isn't hostile to her, she has advantage on attack rolls.

MountedCombatMaster.name: Mounted Combat Master
MountedCombatMaster.description: When Red Ruin is mounted and a creature targets her mount with an attack, Red Ruin can cause the attack to target her instead.

MountedEvasion.name: Mounted Evasion
MountedEvasion.description: When Red Ruin or her mount makes a Dexterity saving throw to take half damage from an effect, they take no damage on a success and half damage on a failure.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Red Ruin makes three Ember Lance attacks.

EmberLance.name: EmberLance
EmberLance.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or fall prone.

ExplosiveHandCrossbow{@recharge5}.name: ExplosiveHandCrossbow{@recharge5}
ExplosiveHandCrossbow{@recharge5}.description: Red Ruin fires an explosive crossbow bolt at a point she can see within 120 feet of herself. When the bolt reaches that point, or if it hits an object early, it detonates in a 20-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

KeenHearingandSight.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
KeenHearingandSight.description: The scout has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

FeyAncestry.name: Fey Ancestry
FeyAncestry.description: The scout has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put it to sleep.

ChildoftheSea.name: Child of the Sea
ChildoftheSea.description: The scout can breathe air and water.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The scout makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

Shortsword.name: Shortsword
Shortsword.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

Longbow.name: Longbow
Longbow.description: rw 4 to hit, ranged 150/600 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

DeathThroes.name: Death Throes
DeathThroes.description: When the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points by a creature that is Large or smaller, the draconian crumbles into dust that then forms a spectral, shrieking image of the creature that killed it. The image lasts for 1 minute. Each creature hostile to the draconian within 10 feet of the image must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the spectral image for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The draconian makes two Serrated Sword attacks and one Tail attack.

SerratedSword.name: SerratedSword
SerratedSword.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

Tail.name: Tail
Tail.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

UndeadFortitude.name: Undead Fortitude
UndeadFortitude.description: If damage reduces the skeletal knight to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is bludgeoning or from a critical hit. On a success, the skeletal knight drops to 1 hit point instead.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The skeletal knight doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The skeletal knight makes three Enervating Blade or Throwing Axe attacks in any combination.

EnervatingBlade.name: EnervatingBlade
EnervatingBlade.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, it can't regain hit points until the start of the skeletal knight's next turn.

ThrowingAxe.name: ThrowingAxe
ThrowingAxe.description: mw,rw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

BonusProficiencies.name: Bonus Proficiencies
BonusProficiencies.description: Tem is proficient with simple weapons and light armor.

Hoopak.name: Hoopak
Hoopak.description: mw,rw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 40/160 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, or 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage if Tem used the hoopak's sling to make a ranged attack.

Taunt.name: Taunt
Taunt.description: Tem launches an infuriating barrage of insults at a creature she can see within 60 feet of her. If the target can hear Tem, it must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

Flyby.name: Flyby
Flyby.description: The dragonnel doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The dragonnel makes two Rend attacks.

Rend.name: Rend
Rend.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

AcidSpit.name: AcidSpit
AcidSpit.description: rw 5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. on hit: 20 (5d6 + 3) acid damage.

UndeadFortitude.name: Undead Fortitude
UndeadFortitude.description: If damage reduces Wersten to 0 hit points, she must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is bludgeoning or from a critical hit. On a success, Wersten drops to 1 hit point instead.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: Wersten doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Wersten makes three Banner Pike attacks and uses Terrifying Litany if it's available.

BannerPike.name: BannerPike
BannerPike.description: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be cursed. The curse lasts until it is lifted by remove curse or similar magic. Black, thorny rose stems sprout from the creature's body while it is cursed, imposing disadvantage on the creature's ability checks and attack rolls and halving its speed. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw against the curse is immune to it for 24 hours.

TerrifyingLitany{@recharge5}.name: TerrifyingLitany{@recharge5}
TerrifyingLitany{@recharge5}.description: Wersten recites names of souls slain by Soth and his company, channeling their mortal terror. Each creature that isn't an Undead within 30 feet of her must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 22 (4d10) psychic damage and is frightened of Wersten for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't frightened. At the end of each of its turns, a frightened creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Hustle.name: Hustle
Hustle.description: The smuggler can move through the space of any creature that is of a larger size, but it can't stop there.

Shortsword.name: Shortsword
Shortsword.description: m 4, reach 5 ft. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

Pistol.name: Pistol
Pistol.description: r 4, range 30/90 ft. on hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) Piercing damage.

Hustle.name: Hustle
Hustle.description: The underboss can move through the space of any creature that is of a larger size, but it can't stop there.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The underboss makes three attacks, using Poisoned|XPHB Blade or Arcane Firearm in any combination.

PoisonedBlade.name: PoisonedBlade
PoisonedBlade.description: m 7, reach 5 ft. on hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned|XPHB condition until the start of the underboss's next turn. If the target is already Poisoned|XPHB, it instead takes an extra 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

ArcaneFirearm.name: ArcaneFirearm
ArcaneFirearm.description: r 7, range 30/90 ft. on hit: 26 (4d10 + 4) Force damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The artificer makes two attacks, using Battering Mace or Artillery Strike in any combination.

BatteringMace.name: BatteringMace
BatteringMace.description: m 6, reach 5 ft. on hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone|XPHB condition.

ArtilleryStrike.name: ArtilleryStrike
ArtilleryStrike.description: r 6, range 120 ft. on hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) Force damage.

BloodFrenzy.name: Blood Frenzy
BloodFrenzy.description: The bruiser has Advantage|XPHB on attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its Hit Points|XPHB.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The bruiser makes three Pummel attacks and uses Glare.

Pummel.name: Pummel
Pummel.description: m 9, reach 5 ft. on hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

Glare.name: Glare
Glare.description: wis DC 14, one creature the bruiser can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the Frightened|XPHB condition until the start of the bruiser's next turn.

PackTactics.name: Pack Tactics
PackTactics.description: The raider has Advantage|XPHB on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the raider's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated|XPHB condition.

Pummel.name: Pummel
Pummel.description: m 5, reach 5 ft. on hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The infiltrator makes three Mind Blade attacks.

MindBlade.name: MindBlade
MindBlade.description: m,r 7, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. on hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Psychic damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The mindkiller makes two Nightmare Whisper attacks.

NightmareWhisper.name: NightmareWhisper
NightmareWhisper.description: m,r 9, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. on hit: 27 (5d8 + 5) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened|XPHB condition until the start of the mindkiller's next turn. If the target is already Frightened|XPHB, it instead takes an extra 10 (3d6) Psychic damage.

PrimalFear(1/Day).name: PrimalFear(1/Day)
PrimalFear(1/Day).description: wis DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot-radius Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere centered on a point the mindkiller can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 35 (10d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened|XPHB condition until the start of the mindkiller's next turn. While Frightened|XPHB in this way, the target can do only one of the following on each of its turns: move, take an action, or take a Bonus Action|XPHB. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

AuraofAuthority.name: Aura of Authority
AuraofAuthority.description: While in a 30-foot Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation originating from the commander, the commander and its allies have Advantage|XPHB on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the commander doesn't have the Incapacitated|XPHB condition.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The commander makes two attacks, using Flail or Javelin in any combination.

Flail.name: Flail
Flail.description: m 6, reach 5 ft.  on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage—plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage if the commander is Bloodied—and the target has Disadvantage|XPHB on its next attack roll before the start of the commander's next turn.

Javelin.name: Javelin
Javelin.description: m,r 6, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft.  on hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage—plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage if the commander is Bloodied|XPHB.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The knight makes two attacks, using Flail or Javelin in any combination.

Flail.name: Flail
Flail.description: m 5, reach 5 ft. on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage—plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage if the knight is Bloodied—and the target has Disadvantage|XPHB on its next attack roll before the start of the knight's next turn.

Javelin.name: Javelin
Javelin.description: m,r 5, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage—plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage if the knight is Bloodied|XPHB.

Hustle.name: Hustle
Hustle.description: The troubleshooter can move through the space of any creature that is of a larger size, but it can't stop there.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The troubleshooter makes two Poisoned Dagger attacks.

PoisonedDagger.name: PoisonedDagger
PoisonedDagger.description: m,r 5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. on hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned|XPHB condition until the start of the troubleshooter's next turn.

Evasion.name: Evasion
Evasion.description: If the homunculus is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it's incapacitated.

ForceStrike.name: ForceStrike
ForceStrike.description: rw {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, range 30 ft., one target you can see. on hit: 1d4 + PB force damage.

Lucky.name: Lucky
Lucky.description: When the medic rolls a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test|XPHB, it can reroll the die, and it must use the new roll.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The medic makes two Radiant Burst attacks.

RadiantBurst.name: RadiantBurst
RadiantBurst.description: m,r 5, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. on hit: 7 (2d6) Radiant damage, and the creature has the Blinded|XPHB condition until the start of the medic's next turn.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The warden has Advantage|XPHB on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The warden makes two Arcane Whip attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Shackling Glyph if available.

ArcaneWhip.name: ArcaneWhip
ArcaneWhip.description: m 6, reach 10 ft. on hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Force damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone|XPHB condition. If the target already has the Prone|XPHB condition, the attack deals an extra 7 (2d6) Force damage.

ShacklingGlyph{@recharge}.name: ShacklingGlyph{@recharge}
ShacklingGlyph{@recharge}.description: str DC 14, one creature the warden can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} The creature has the Grappled|XPHB condition (escape DC 14). While Grappled|XPHB, the creature has the Restrained|XPHB condition.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The scion makes two Thunderbolt attacks and uses Spellcasting.

Thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
Thunderbolt.description: m,r 6, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Lightning damage plus 9 (2d8) Thunder damage. Critical on hit: The creature also has the Deafened|XPHB condition for 1 minute.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The inquisitive makes three Crooked Staff attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Inquisitive Eye.

CrookedStaff.name: CrookedStaff
CrookedStaff.description: m 4, reach 5 ft. on hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone|XPHB condition. If the target already has the Prone|XPHB condition, the attack deals an extra 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.

InquisitiveEye.name: InquisitiveEye
InquisitiveEye.description: wis DC 13, one creature the inquisitive can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 10 (3d6) Psychic damage, and the target is marked. The inquisitive has Advantage|XPHB on attack rolls against a target it has marked. While marked, the target can't become hidden from the inquisitive, and if it has the Invisible|XPHB condition, it gains no benefit from that condition against the inquisitive. The mark disappears after 1 minute or when the inquisitive uses this action again. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The enforcer makes three Dagger attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Lightning Cage if available.

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.description: m,r 6, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. on hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

LightningCage{@recharge5}.name: LightningCage{@recharge5}

SharkTelepathy.name: Shark Telepathy
SharkTelepathy.description: The warlock can magically command any shark within 120 feet of it, using a limited telepathy.

Longsword.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage when used with two hands.

PetrifyingSecretions.description: A creature must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw if it hits the basilisk with a weapon attack while within 5 feet of it or if it starts its turn grappled by the basilisk. Unless the save succeeds, the creature magically begins to turn to stone and is restrained, and it must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is petrified.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The basilisk makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

Tail.name: Tail
Tail.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 12).

Charge.name: Charge
Charge.description: If the udaak moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a slam attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 27 (6d8) bludgeoning damage. SiegeMonster.name: Siege Monster
SiegeMonster.description: The udaak deals double damage to objects and structures.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The udaak makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its slam.

Bite.description: mw 13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 21 (2d12 + 8) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 21). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the udaak can't bite another target.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

Swallow.name: Swallow
Swallow.description:
The udaak makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has Cover||3||total cover against attacks and other effects outside the udaak, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the udaak's turns.
If the udaak takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the udaak must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the udaak. If the udaak dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

VoiceLock.name: Voice Lock
VoiceLock.description: The vox seeker must move toward and attack the source of the nearest voice within 60 feet of it, to the exclusion of all other targets, for as long as it remains operational.

SpiderClimb.name: Spider Climb
SpiderClimb.description: The vox seeker can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Pincer.name: Pincer
Pincer.description: mw 2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage plus 3 lightning damage.

FeyAncestry.name: Fey Ancestry
FeyAncestry.description: Yinra has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put her to sleep.

KeenHearingandSight.name: Keen Hearing and Sight

EyeThief.name: Eye Thief
EyeThief.description: Belashyrra can see through the eyes of all creatures within 120 feet of it. It can use its Eye Ray through any creature within 120 feet of it, as though it were in that creature's space.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If Belashyrra fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: Belashyrra regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn. If it takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. Belashyrra dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

Teleport.name: Teleport
Teleport.description: As a bonus action, Belashyrra can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Belashyrra makes two attacks with its claws and uses its Eye Ray once.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) slashing damage.

EyeRay.name: EyeRay
EyeRay.description: Belashyrra shoots one of the following magical eye rays of its choice, targeting one creature it can see within 120 feet of it:

CommanderofBones.name: Commander of Bones
CommanderofBones.description: As a bonus action, the knight can target one skeleton or zombie it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target must obey the knight's commands until the knight dies or until the knight releases it as a bonus action. The knight can command up to twelve undead at a time this way.

MasterofthePallidBanner.name: Master of the Pallid Banner
MasterofthePallidBanner.description: While within 60 feet of the knight, any undead ally of the knight has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The knight attacks twice with one of its weapons.

Greatsword.name: Greatsword
Greatsword.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

ChangeAppearance.name: Change Appearance
ChangeAppearance.description: The changeling can use its action to polymorph into a Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. UnarmoredDefense.name: Unarmored Defense
UnarmoredDefense.description: While the dolgaunt is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The dolgaunt makes two tentacle attacks and two unarmed strikes. Up to two tentacle attacks can be replaced by Vitality Drain.

Tentacle.name: Tentacle
Tentacle.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 12) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the dolgaunt can't use the same tentacle on another target. The dolgaunt has two tentacles.

UnarmedStrike.name: UnarmedStrike
UnarmedStrike.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

VitalityDrain.description: One creature grappled by a tentacle of the dolgaunt must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 9 (2d8) necrotic damage, and the dolgaunt regains a number of hit points equal to half the necrotic damage taken.

DualConsciousness.name: Dual Consciousness
DualConsciousness.description: The dolgrim has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

Dyrrn targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or take 22 (4d6 + 8) necrotic damage and become corrupted for 1 minute.
A corrupted creature's flesh twists in alien ways. The creature has disadvantage on attack rolls, its speed is reduced by half, and if it tries to cast a spell, it must first succeed on a 15 Intelligence check or the spell fails and is wasted. The corrupted creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

ExtractBrain.name: ExtractBrain
ExtractBrain.description: mw 15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one incapacitated creature grappled by Dyrrn. on hit: 55 (10d10) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, Dyrrn kills the target by extracting and devouring its brain.

Flyby.name: Flyby
Flyby.description: The messenger doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

TelepathicBond.name: Telepathic Bond
TelepathicBond.description: While the messenger is on the same plane of existence as its master, it can magically convey what it senses to its master, and the two can communicate telepathically.

Possession{@recharge}.name: Possession{@recharge}
Possession{@recharge}.description:
One humanoid that the quori can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by the quori; the quori then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. The quori now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The quori can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.
The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, the quori ends it as a bonus action, or the quori is forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, the quori reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to this quori's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

All-AroundVision.description: The quori can't be surprised while it isn't incapacitated.

Only the wish spell can free the thrall from this control.

SwarmofEyes{@recharge}.description: The quori creates a swarm of spectral eyes that fills a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point it can see within 60 feet of it. ChangeShape.description:

In a new form, Rak Tulkhesh retains his alignment, hit points, Hit Dice, ability to speak, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. His statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features or legendary actions of that form.

Claws.name: Claws

Stinger.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. on hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the quori for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Possession{@recharge}.name: Possession{@recharge}
Possession{@recharge}.description:
One humanoid that the quori can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by the quori; the quori then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. The quori now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The quori can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.
The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, the quori ends it as a bonus action, or the quori is forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, the quori reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to this quori's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

AuraofRadiance.name: Aura of Radiance
AuraofRadiance.description: The councilor magically sheds bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet. If the bright light overlaps with an area of darkness created by a spell of 3rd level or lower, the spell that created that darkness is dispelled.

If the councilor casts this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the fire damage or the radiant damage (its choice) increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 5th.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The colossus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

SiegeMonster.name: Siege Monster
SiegeMonster.description: The colossus deals double damage to objects and structures.

ToweringTerror.name: Towering Terror
ToweringTerror.description: Any enemy outside the colossus that starts its turn within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 26 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the start of the enemy's next turn. If the enemy's saving throw is successful, it is immune to this colossus's Towering Terror for the next 24 hours.

Multiattack.description: The colossus makes three attacks—one with its slam and two with its eldritch turrets—and then uses Stomp.

Slam.description: mw 18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 29 (3d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage, and the colossus can push the target up to 20 feet away from it.

EldritchTurret.name: EldritchTurret
EldritchTurret.description: rs 18 to hit, range 300 ft., one target. on hit: 18 (4d8) force damage, and if the target is a creature, it is knocked prone.

Stomp.name: Stomp
Stomp.description:
The colossus stomps one of its feet at a point on the ground within 20 feet of it. Any creature in a 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder centered on this point must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take 33 (6d10) bludgeoning damage and fall prone. Until the colossus uses its Stomp again or moves, the creature is restrained. While restrained in this way, the creature (or another creature within 5 feet of it) can use its action to make a DC 26 Strength check. On a success, the creature relocates to an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 feet of the colossus and is no longer restrained.
Structures, as well as nonmagical objects that are neither being worn nor carried, take the same amount of damage if they are in the cylinder (no save).

IncineratingBeam{@recharge5}.name: IncineratingBeam{@recharge5}
IncineratingBeam{@recharge5}.description: The colossus fires a beam of light in a 150-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw, taking 60 (11d10) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this beam is disintegrated, leaving behind anything it was wearing or carrying.

MassTelekinesis(GemAwakeningOnly;Recharg.description:
The greatwyrm targets any number of creatures and objects it can see within 120 feet of it. No one target can weigh more than 4,000 pounds, and objects can't be targeted if they're being worn or carried. Each targeted creature must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or be restrained in the greatwyrm's telekinetic grip. At the end of a creature's turn, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.
At the end of the greatwyrm's turn, it can move each creature or object it has in its telekinetic grip up to 60 feet in any direction, but not beyond 120 feet of itself. In addition, it can choose any number of creatures restrained in this way and deal 45 (7d12) force damage to each of them.

MultipleHeads.name: Multiple Heads
MultipleHeads.description:
The dracohydra has five heads. While it has more than one head, the dracohydra has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.
Whenever the dracohydra takes 30 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the dracohydra dies.
At the end of its turn, the dracohydra grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken radiant damage since its last turn. The dracohydra regains 10 hit points for each head regrown this way.

ReactiveHeads.name: Reactive Heads
ReactiveHeads.description: For each head the dracohydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for opportunity attacks.

Wakeful.description: While the dracohydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

Tail.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

ControlledFall.name: Controlled Fall
ControlledFall.description: When the draconian falls and isn't incapacitated, it subtracts up to 100 feet from the fall when calculating the fall's damage.

DeathThroes.name: Death Throes
DeathThroes.description: When the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points, its body turns to stone and releases a petrifying gas. Each creature within 5 feet of the draconian must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be restrained as it begins to turn to stone. The restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends; otherwise the creature is petrified for 1 minute. After 1 minute, the body of the draconian crumbles to dust.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The draconian makes two Shortsword attacks.

Shortsword.name: Shortsword
Shortsword.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

DeathThroes.name: Death Throes
DeathThroes.description: When the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points, it turns into a puddle of acid and splashes acid on those around it. Each creature within 5 feet of the draconian must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be covered in acid for 1 minute. A creature can use its action to scrape or wash the acid off itself or another creature. A creature covered in the acid takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns.

Glide.name: Glide
Glide.description: When the draconian falls and isn't incapacitated, it subtracts up to 100 feet from the fall when calculating the fall's damage, and it can move up to 2 feet horizontally for every 1 foot it descends.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The draconian makes two Dagger attacks. If both attacks hit the same creature, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned until the end of the target's next turn. While poisoned in this way, the target is also paralyzed.

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.description: mw,rw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

DeathThroes.name: Death Throes
DeathThroes.description: When the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points, its scales and flesh immediately shrivel away and its bones explode. Each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) force damage.

Glide.name: Glide
Glide.description: When the draconian falls and isn't incapacitated, it subtracts up to 100 feet from the fall when calculating the fall's damage, and it can move up to 2 feet horizontally for every 1 foot it descends.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The draconian makes two Trident or Necrotic Ray attacks.

Trident.name: Trident
Trident.description: mw,rw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

NecroticRay.name: NecroticRay
NecroticRay.description: rs 4 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

DeathThroes.name: Death Throes
DeathThroes.description: When the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points, its magical essence lashes out as a ball of lightning at the closest creature within 30 feet of it before arcing out to up to two other creatures within 15 feet of the first. Each creature must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 9 (2d8) lightning damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't stunned.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The draconian makes three Rend or Energy Ray attacks.

Rend.name: Rend
Rend.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

EnergyRay.name: EnergyRay
EnergyRay.description: rs 6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) force damage.

NoxiousBreath{@recharge5}.name: NoxiousBreath{@recharge5}
NoxiousBreath{@recharge5}.description: The draconian exhales a 15-foot cone of noxious gas. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 21 (6d6) poison damage and gains 1 level of exhaustion. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage, doesn't gain exhaustion, and is immune to all draconians' Noxious Breath for 24 hours.

Deflection.name: Deflection
Deflection.description: The shard's AC includes its Intelligence modifier.

IncorporealMovement.name: Incorporeal Movement
IncorporealMovement.description: The shard can move through creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain||3. If it ends its turn inside an object, it takes 5 (1d10) force damage.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the shard fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description: When it drops to 0 hit points, the shard disappears and leaves a Tiny cracked gemstone in its space. The gemstone matches the kind of gem dragon it was in life and has AC 20, 15 hit points, and immunity to all damage except force. Unless the gemstone is destroyed, after 1d20 days, the gemstone dissipates and the shard re-forms, regaining all its hit points and appearing in the place the gemstone once occupied or in the nearest unoccupied space.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The shard doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The shard makes two Telekinetic Rend attacks.

TelekineticRend.name: TelekineticRend
TelekineticRend.description: ms,rs 12 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) force damage.

InhabitObject.name: InhabitObject
InhabitObject.description:
The shard disappears as it pours its psychic essence into a Medium or smaller nonsentient object it can see within 30 feet of it, magically possessing it. The object uses the shard's AC, and any damage dealt to the object applies to the shard's hit points. The shard inhabits the object until it uses an action to leave; until it is turned; until it is reduced to 0 hit points; or until an effect that ends possession, such as a dispel evil and good spell, is used on it. When it leaves the object, it reappears in the nearest unoccupied space.
While inhabited, the object becomes a magic item if it wasn't already, and a Tiny cracked gemstone matching the kind of gem dragon the shard was in life appears somewhere on the object. The shard can cause the object to fly using the shard's own flying speed, use its senses, speak verbally or telepathically, cast spells, and use its legendary actions.
If a creature wears or carries the inhabited object, the shard can grant the creature the following benefits:
Each of the creature's attacks deals an extra 1d8 force damage on a hit.
The creature gains resistance to psychic damage.

PsychicCrush{@recharge5}.name: PsychicCrush{@recharge5}
PsychicCrush{@recharge5}.description: The shard unleashes a pulse of psychic power. Each creature of the shard's choice in a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on it must make a DC 20 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 55 (10d10) psychic damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't stunned.

SharedResistances.name: Shared Resistances
SharedResistances.description: When you summon the spirit, choose one of its Resistances. You have Resistance to the chosen damage type until the spell ends.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The spirit makes a number of Rend attacks equal to half the spell's level (round down), and it uses Breath Weapon.

Rend.name: Rend
Rend.description: m Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 10 feet. on hit: 1d6 + 4 + summonSpellLevel Piercing damage.

BreathWeapon.name: BreathWeapon
BreathWeapon.description: dex DC equals your spell save DC, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. {@actSaveFail} 2d6 damage of a type this spirit has Resistance to (your choice when you cast the spell). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The blessed makes two Mace or Radiant Bolt attacks.

Mace.name: Mace
Mace.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage.

RadiantBolt.name: RadiantBolt
RadiantBolt.description: rs 6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 22 (5d8) radiant damage, and the blessed regains 5 (1d10) hit points.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The chosen makes one Handaxe attack and two Shortsword attacks.

Handaxe.name: Handaxe
Handaxe.description: mw,rw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage. {@hom}The handaxe magically returns to the chosen's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

Shortsword.name: Shortsword
Shortsword.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The speaker makes two Thunder Bolt attacks.

ThunderBolt.name: ThunderBolt
ThunderBolt.description: ms,rs 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (3d8) thunder damage, and the target is pushed horizontally up to 10 feet away from the speaker.

Amphibious.name: Amphibious
Amphibious.description: The dragon turtle can breathe air and water.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (1d12 + 3) piercing damage.

SteamBreath{@recharge5}.name: SteamBreath{@recharge5}
SteamBreath{@recharge5}.description: The dragon turtle exhales steam in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Being underwater doesn't grant resistance against this damage.

Amorphous.name: Amorphous
Amorphous.description: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

SpiderClimb.name: Spider Climb
SpiderClimb.description: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The ooze makes two Pseudopod attacks. The ooze can replace one Pseudopod attack with its Slime Breath, if available.

Pseudopod.name: Pseudopod
Pseudopod.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns.

SlimeBreath{@recharge}.name: SlimeBreath{@recharge}
SlimeBreath{@recharge}.description: The ooze expels a spray of its gelatinous mass in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 22 (4d10) acid damage and is pulled up to 30 feet straight toward the ooze. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't pulled.

FearAura.name: Fear Aura
FearAura.description: Each creature of the golem's choice that starts its turn within 20 feet of the golem must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw unless the golem is incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature is frightened until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this golem's Fear Aura for the next 24 hours.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The golem doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The golem makes one Pinion attack and two Rend attacks.

Pinion.name: Pinion
Pinion.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is pinned beneath the bony pinion and restrained. The golem has two pinions, each of which can restrain one target. If a creature is restrained by one of the pinions, the golem can't attack with it. Any creature restrained by a pinion can free itself at the start of its turn with a successful DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check.

Rend.name: Rend
Rend.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

PetrifyingBreath{@recharge5}.name: PetrifyingBreath{@recharge5}
PetrifyingBreath{@recharge5}.description: The golem emits a 60-foot cone of petrifying gas from its mouth. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 35 (10d6) poison damage and be restrained as it begins to turn to stone. The restrained target must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the effect ends on the target. On a failed save, the target is petrified.

LegendaryResistance(1/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(1/Day).description: If the dragonborn fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The dragonborn makes three Longsword attacks.

Longsword.name: Longsword
Longsword.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage. The dragonborn can cause the sword to flare with bright light, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the start of the dragonborn's next turn. The sword can flare in this way only once per turn.

HealingTouch(1/Day).name: HealingTouch(1/Day)
HealingTouch(1/Day).description: The dragonborn touches another creature within 5 feet of it. The target magically regains 40 hit points. In addition, all diseases and poisons affecting the target are removed.

RadiantBreath{@recharge}.name: RadiantBreath{@recharge}
RadiantBreath{@recharge}.description: The dragonborn exhales fiery radiance in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. When the dragonborn uses this action, it can choose up to three creatures in the cone. These creatures take no damage from the radiance and instead regain 22 (4d10) hit points each.

LegendaryResistance(1/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(1/Day).description: If the dragonborn fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

MentalDefense.name: Mental Defense
MentalDefense.description: While the dragonborn is wearing no armor, its AC includes its Intelligence modifier.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The dragonborn makes three Mind Blade attacks.

MindBlade.name: MindBlade
MindBlade.description: mw,rw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

HeatBreath{@recharge}.name: HeatBreath{@recharge}
HeatBreath{@recharge}.description: The dragonborn exhales a wave of intense heat in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Metal objects in that area glow red-hot until the end of the dragonborn's next turn. Any creature in physical contact with a heated object at the start of its turn must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 9 (2d8) fire damage and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of its next turn.

LegendaryResistance(1/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(1/Day).description: If the dragonborn fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The dragonborn makes two Greataxe attacks.

Greataxe.name: Greataxe
Greataxe.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

NecroticBreath{@recharge}.name: NecroticBreath{@recharge}
NecroticBreath{@recharge}.description: The dragonborn exhales shadowy fire in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 36 (8d8) necrotic damage and is frightened of the dragonborn for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't frightened. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

CloyingMiasma.name: Cloying Miasma
CloyingMiasma.description: The abomination is surrounded by a noxious stench. At the start of the abomination's turn, any creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of the abomination's next turn.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: The abomination regains 10 hit points at the start of its turns if it has at least 1 hit point.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The abomination makes three attacks using Claw, Acidic Spit, or a combination of them. It can replace one of the attacks with a Tail attack.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage.

Tail.name: Tail
Tail.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

AcidicSpit.name: AcidicSpit
AcidicSpit.description: rw 5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (3d6) acid damage.

AcidBelch{@recharge5}.name: AcidBelch{@recharge5}
AcidBelch{@recharge5}.description: The abomination belches forth a cloud of acidic gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The grafter makes one Claw attack and one Greatclub attack.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage.

Greatclub.name: Greatclub
Greatclub.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

AcidRetch{@recharge5}.name: AcidRetch{@recharge5}
AcidRetch{@recharge5}.description: The grafter retches forth a spray of acidic bile in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Flyby.name: Flyby
Flyby.description: The dragonnel doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The dragonnel makes two Rend attacks.

Rend.name: Rend
Rend.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

DraconicEssence.name: Draconic Essence
DraconicEssence.description: When you summon the drake, choose a damage type: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. The chosen type determines the drake's damage immunity and the damage of its Infused Strikes trait.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 1d6 plus PB piercing damage.

Amphibious.name: Amphibious
Amphibious.description: The egg hunter can breathe air and water.

FalseAppearance.name: False Appearance
FalseAppearance.description: If the egg hunter is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the egg hunter move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the egg hunter is animate. Dragons have disadvantage on this check.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The egg hunter makes two Barbed Proboscis attacks, and it can use Torpor Spores if it's available.

BarbedProboscis.name: BarbedProboscis
BarbedProboscis.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage, and the egg hunter regains hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt.

TorporSpores{@recharge5}.name: TorporSpores{@recharge5}
TorporSpores{@recharge5}.description: The egg hunter releases a billow of sparkling blue spores. Each creature in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on the egg hunter must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, the creature can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn but not both, and it can't take reactions. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to this egg hunter's Torpor Spores for the next 24 hours.

Amphibious.name: Amphibious
Amphibious.description: The egg hunter can breathe air and water.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The egg hunter makes two Egg Tooth attacks.

EggTooth.name: EggTooth
EggTooth.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 17 (4d6 + 3) piercing damage if the target is an object.

LegendaryResistance(4/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(4/Day).description: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

SiegeMonster.name: Siege Monster
SiegeMonster.description: The dragon deals double damage to objects and structures.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The dragon doesn't require air or sleep.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The dragon makes one Bite attack, two Claw attacks, and one Tentacle attack.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) psychic damage.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (1d6 + 8) slashing damage.

Tentacle.name: Tentacle
Tentacle.description: mw 15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. on hit: 12 (1d8 + 8) psychic damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 18). The dragon can have up to four targets grappled at a time.

TadpoleBrineBreath{@recharge5}.name: TadpoleBrineBreath{@recharge5}
TadpoleBrineBreath{@recharge5}.description:
The dragon exhales brine in a 120-foot line that is 15 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 55 (10d10) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a success or failure, if the creature isn't a Construct or an Undead, it becomes infested with illithid tadpoles.
While infested, the creature takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself after it succeeds on three of these saves. If the creature is targeted by magic that ends a curse or restores 40 hit points or more, the tadpoles infesting the creature are killed instantly, ending the effect on the creature.
If a Humanoid is reduced to 0 hit points while infested, the creature is stable but remains unconscious for 6d12 hours. When the period of unconsciousness ends, the creature transforms into a mind flayer (see the Monster Manual) with all its hit points. Casting a wish spell on the unconscious creature rids it of the infestation and prevents it from turning into a mind flayer.

Tunneler.name: Tunneler
Tunneler.description: The dragon can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and can leave a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) psychic damage.

DisorientingBreath{@recharge5}.name: DisorientingBreath{@recharge5}
DisorientingBreath{@recharge5}.description: The dragon exhales a wave of psychic dissonance in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 17 (5d6) psychic damage, and until the end of its next turn, when the creature makes an attack roll or an ability check, it must roll a d4 and reduce the total by the number rolled. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage with no additional effects.

GemAwakening(RechargesafteraShortorLongR.name: Gem Awakening (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
GemAwakening(RechargesafteraShortorLongR.description: If the greatwyrm would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 400 hit points, it recharges its Breath Weapon, and it regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, the greatwyrm can now use its Mass Telekinesis action during the next hour. Award a party an additional 90,000 XP (180,000 XP total) for defeating the greatwyrm after its Gem Awakening activates.

LegendaryResistance(4/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(4/Day).description: If the greatwyrm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The greatwyrm doesn't require food or drink.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The greatwyrm makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 20 (2d10 + 9) piercing damage plus 16 (3d10) force damage.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 18 (2d8 + 9) slashing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 19) and is restrained until this grapple ends. The greatwyrm can have only one creature grappled in this way at a time.

BreathWeapon{@recharge5}.name: BreathWeapon{@recharge5}
BreathWeapon{@recharge5}.description: The greatwyrm exhales crushing force in a 300-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 71 (11d12) force damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone. On a success or failure, the creature's speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn.

MassTelekinesis(GemAwakeningOnly;Recharg.name: MassTelekinesis(GemAwakeningOnly;RechargesafteraShortorLongRest)

value.value: Mass Telekinesis (Gem Awakening Only; Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)

MassTelekinesis(GemAwakeningOnly;Recharg.description:
The greatwyrm targets any number of creatures and objects it can see within 120 feet of it. No one target can weigh more than 4,000 pounds, and objects can't be targeted if they're being worn or carried. Each targeted creature must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or be restrained in the greatwyrm's telekinetic grip. At the end of a creature's turn, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.
At the end of the greatwyrm's turn, it can move each creature or object it has in its telekinetic grip up to 60 feet in any direction, but not beyond 120 feet of itself. In addition, it can choose any number of creatures restrained in this way and deal 45 (7d12) force damage to each of them.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The eyedrake doesn't require food or drink.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage.

AntimagicBreath{@recharge}.name: AntimagicBreath{@recharge}
AntimagicBreath{@recharge}.description: The eyedrake emits a magic wave in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 39 (6d12) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Every spell of 3rd level or lower ends on creatures and objects of the eyedrake's choice in that area.

EyeRays.name: EyeRays
EyeRays.description: The eyedrake shoots three of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), each ray targeting one creature it can see within 60 feet of it:

SpiderClimb.name: Spider Climb
SpiderClimb.description: The gem stalker can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The gem stalker doesn't require food or drink.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The gem stalker makes four Claw attacks.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

IncorporealMovement.name: Incorporeal Movement
IncorporealMovement.description: The ghost dragon can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain||3. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the ghost dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The ghost dragon doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The ghost dragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 32 (6d8 + 5) cold damage, and the target's speed is halved until the start of the dragon's next turn.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) necrotic damage.

TerrifyingBreath{@recharge}.name: TerrifyingBreath{@recharge}
TerrifyingBreath{@recharge}.description:
The ghost dragon exhales shadowy mist in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 40 (9d8) cold damage and is frightened of the ghost dragon for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't frightened.
While frightened of the ghost dragon, a creature is paralyzed. The frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to this ghost dragon's Terrifying Breath for the next 24 hours.

Peck.name: Peck
Peck.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

LegendaryResistance(4/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(4/Day).description: If the greatwyrm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

MetallicAwakening(RechargesafteraShortor.name: Metallic Awakening (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
MetallicAwakening(RechargesafteraShortor.description: If the greatwyrm would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 450 hit points, it recharges its Breath Weapon, and it regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, the greatwyrm can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 120,000 XP (240,000 XP total) for defeating the greatwyrm after its Metallic Awakening activates.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The greatwyrm doesn't require food or drink.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The greatwyrm makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 18 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 21 (2d10 + 10) piercing damage plus 13 (2d12) force damage.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 18 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 19 (2d8 + 10) slashing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 20) and is restrained until this grapple ends. The greatwyrm can have only one creature grappled in this way at a time.

Tail.name: Tail
Tail.description: mw 18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 21 (2d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

BreathWeapon{@recharge5}.name: BreathWeapon{@recharge5}
BreathWeapon{@recharge5}.description: The greatwyrm uses one of the following breath weapons:

ChangeShape.name: ChangeShape
ChangeShape.description: The greatwyrm magically transforms into any creature that is Medium or Small, while retaining its game statistics (other than its size). This transformation ends if the dragon is reduced to 0 hit points or uses its action to end it.

ChromaticAwakening(RechargesafteraShorto.name: Chromatic Awakening (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
ChromaticAwakening(RechargesafteraShorto.description: If the greatwyrm would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 425 hit points, it recharges its Breath Weapon, and it regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, the greatwyrm can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 105,000 XP (210,000 XP total) for defeating the greatwyrm after its Chromatic Awakening activates.

LegendaryResistance(4/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(4/Day).description: If the greatwyrm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Tail.description: mw 18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 19 (2d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
