The aging effect can be reversed by a greater restoration spell, but only if it is cast within 24 hours.

Possession{@recharge}.name: Possession{@recharge}
Possession{@recharge}.description: One humanoid that the ghost can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by the ghost; the ghost then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. The ghost now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The ghost can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, the ghost ends it as a bonus action, or the ghost is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, the ghost reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

ShockingGrasp(Cantrip).name: ShockingGrasp(Cantrip)
ShockingGrasp(Cantrip).description: ms 5 to hit (with advantage on the attack if the target is wearing armor made of metal), reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 9 (2d8) lightning damage, and the target can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

HoldBreath.name: Hold Breath
HoldBreath.description: The seal can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

KeenSmell.name: Keen Smell
KeenSmell.description: The seal has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 1 piercing damage.

ColdRegeneration.name: Cold Regeneration
ColdRegeneration.description: If the temperature around him is 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower, Sephek regains 5 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of Sephek's next turn. Sephek dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Sephek attacks twice with a weapon.

IceLongsword.name: IceLongsword
IceLongsword.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if Sephek uses the weapon with two hands, plus 5 (2d4) cold damage.

IceDagger.name: IceDagger
IceDagger.description: rw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) cold damage.

ColdAbsorption.name: Cold Absorption
ColdAbsorption.description: Whenever the golem is subjected to cold damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the cold damage dealt.

ImmutableForm.name: Immutable Form
ImmutableForm.description: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

Melt.name: Melt
Melt.description: While in an area of extreme heat, the golem loses 1d6 hit points at the start of each of its turns.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The golem doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The golem makes three melee attacks.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.

Snowball.name: Snowball
Snowball.description: rw 0 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) cold damage.

GnomeCunning.name: Gnome Cunning
GnomeCunning.description: Spellix has advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

ShockingGrasp(Cantrip).name: ShockingGrasp(Cantrip)
ShockingGrasp(Cantrip).description: ms 5 to hit (with advantage on the attack roll if the target is wearing armor made of metal), reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 4 (1d8) lightning damage, and the target can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

FireBolt(Cantrip).name: FireBolt(Cantrip)
FireBolt(Cantrip).description: rs 5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d10) fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell ignites if it isn't being worn or carried.

Echolocation.name: Echolocation
Echolocation.description: The whale can't use its blindsight while deafened.

HoldBreath.name: Hold Breath
HoldBreath.description: The whale can hold its breath for 90 minutes.

KeenHearing.name: Keen Hearing
KeenHearing.description: The whale has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The whale makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the whale. A swallowed creature has Cover||3||total cover against attacks and other effects outside the whale, and it takes 3 (1d6) acid damage at the start of each of the whale's turns. If the whale takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the whale must succeed on a 16 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the whale. If the whale dies, a swallowed creature can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

Tail.name: Tail
Tail.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage, or 37 (6d6 + 16) bludgeoning damage if the target is an object.

Shapechanger.name: Shapechanger
Shapechanger.description: The mimic can use its action to polymorph into an object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

Adhesive(ObjectFormOnly).name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
Adhesive(ObjectFormOnly).description: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic is also grappled by it (escape DC 16). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.

FalseAppearance(ObjectFormOnly).name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
FalseAppearance(ObjectFormOnly).description: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

Grappler.name: Grappler
Grappler.description: The mimic has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The mimic has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The mimic attacks three times: twice with its pseudopods and once with its bite.

Pseudopods.name: Pseudopods
Pseudopods.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the mimic is in object form, the target is subjected to its Adhesive trait.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

SpitAcid{@recharge5}.name: SpitAcid{@recharge5}
SpitAcid{@recharge5}.description: The mimic spits acid at one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 32 (9d6 + 1) acid damage on failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

PetrifiedDeath.name: Petrified Death
PetrifiedDeath.description: A tomb tapper reduced to 0 hit points turns into a lifeless stone statue. Anything it's wearing or carrying is not transformed.

SenseMagic.name: Sense Magic
SenseMagic.description: The tomb tapper senses magic within 30 feet of it and can use an action to pinpoint the location of any creature, object, or area in that range that bears magic. This sense penetrates barriers but is blocked by a thin sheet of lead.

Tunneler.name: Tunneler
Tunneler.description: The tomb tapper can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 10-foot-wide, 20-foot-tall tunnel in its wake.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The tomb tapper doesn't require air or sleep.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The tomb tapper makes two melee attacks with its sledgehammer or with its claws. If it hits the same creature with both claws, it can pull that creature within 5 feet of its mouth and make a bite attack against it.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) slashing damage.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) slashing damage.

Sledgehammer.name: Sledgehammer
Sledgehammer.description: mw,rw 10 to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. on hit: 27 (6d6 + 6) bludgeoning or force damage (tomb tapper's choice). If thrown, the hammer returns to the tomb tapper at the end of its turn, landing at the tomb tapper's feet if it doesn't have a hand free to catch the weapon.

SpecialEquipment.name: Special Equipment
SpecialEquipment.description: Vellynne wears bracers of defense and carries a wand of magic missiles (see "Actions" below).

VampiricTouch(3rd-LevelSpell;RequiresaSp.name: VampiricTouch(3rd-LevelSpell;RequiresaSpellSlot)

value.value: Vampiric Touch (3rd-Level Spell; Requires a Spell Slot)

VampiricTouch(3rd-LevelSpell;RequiresaSp.description: ms 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, and Vellynne regains hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt. If Vellynne casts this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the necrotic damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

ChillTouch(Cantrip).name: ChillTouch(Cantrip)
ChillTouch(Cantrip).description: rs 6 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. on hit: 9 (2d8) necrotic damage, and the target can't regain hit points until the start of Vellynne's next turn.

WandofMagicMissiles.name: WandofMagicMissiles
WandofMagicMissiles.description: While holding this wand, Vellynne can expend 1 or more of its 7 charges to cast the magic missile spell from it. She can expend 1 charge to cast the 1st-level version of the spell. She can increase the spell slot level by one for each additional charge she expends. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If the wand's last charge is expended, roll a d20; on a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

SimpleWeaponWielder.name: Simple Weapon Wielder
SimpleWeaponWielder.description: A simple weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the verbeeg hits with it (included in the attack).

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The verbeeg makes two melee attacks.

Spear.name: Spear
Spear.description: mw,rw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage if used to make a ranged attack or used with two hands to make a melee attack.

Sling.name: Sling
Sling.description: rw 5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (3d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

SimpleWeaponWielder.name: Simple Weapon Wielder
SimpleWeaponWielder.description: A simple weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the verbeeg hits with it (included in the attack).

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The verbeeg makes two melee attacks.

Spear.name: Spear
Spear.description: mw,rw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage if used to make a ranged attack or used with two hands to make a melee attack.

HoldBreath.name: Hold Breath
HoldBreath.description: The walrus can hold its breath for 10 minutes.

Tusks.name: Tusks
Tusks.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.

DuergarResilience.name: Duergar Resilience
DuergarResilience.description: Xardorok has advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, and illusions, as well as to resist being charmed or paralyzed.

SunlightSensitivity.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
SunlightSensitivity.description: While in sunlight, Xardorok has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Xardorok attacks twice with a weapon or casts eldritch blast twice.

SpikedGauntlet.name: SpikedGauntlet
SpikedGauntlet.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, or 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage while Xardorok is enlarged.

EldritchBlast(Cantrip).name: EldritchBlast(Cantrip)
EldritchBlast(Cantrip).description: rs 7 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. on hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) force damage.

Enlarge(RechargesafteraShortorLongRest).name: Enlarge(RechargesafteraShortorLongRest)

value.value: Enlarge (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)

Enlarge(RechargesafteraShortorLongRest).description: For 1 minute, Xardorok magically increases in size, along with anything he is wearing or carrying. While enlarged, Xardorok is Large, doubles his damage dice on Strength-based weapon attacks (included in his attacks), and makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage. If Xardorok lacks the room to become Large, he attains the maximum size possible in the space available.

Invisibility{@recharge4}.name: Invisibility{@recharge4}
Invisibility{@recharge4}.description: Xardorok magically turns invisible until he attacks, he casts a spell, he uses his Enlarge, or his concentration is broken (as if concentration||concentrating on a spell). Any equipment Xardorok wears or carries is invisible with him.

KeenSmell.name: Keen Smell
KeenSmell.description: The yeti tyke has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

SnowCamouflage.name: Snow Camouflage
SnowCamouflage.description: The yeti tyke has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in snowy terrain.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage, plus 2 (1d4) cold damage. Claw does both slashing and cold damage.

TwoHeads.name: Two Heads
TwoHeads.description: The ettin has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

Wakeful.name: Wakeful
Wakeful.description: When one of the ettin's heads is asleep, its other head is awake.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The ettin makes two attacks: one with its battleaxe and one with its morningstar.

Battleaxe.name: Battleaxe
Battleaxe.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

Morningstar.name: Morningstar
Morningstar.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

FireBreath{@recharge5}.name: FireBreath{@recharge5}
FireBreath{@recharge5}.description: The ettin's right head exhales fire in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

ColdBreath{@recharge5}.name: ColdBreath{@recharge5}
ColdBreath{@recharge5}.description: The ettin's left head exhales an icy blast in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Gaze.name: Gaze
Gaze.description:
The ettin turns its magical gaze toward one creature that it can see within 120 feet of it. That target must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. Unless the target is incapacitated, it can avert its eyes to avoid the gaze and to automatically succeed on the save. If the target does so, it can't see the ettin until the start of the ettin's next turn. If the target looks at the ettin in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.
If the target fails the save, it suffers one of the following effects of the ettin's choice or at random:

BeguilingGaze.name: BeguilingGaze
BeguilingGaze.description: The target is stunned until the start of the ettin's next turn or until the ettin is no longer within line of sight.

HypnoticGaze.name: HypnoticGaze
HypnoticGaze.description: The target is charmed by the ettin until the start of the ettin's next turn. The ettin chooses how the charmed target uses its actions, reactions, and movement.

InsanityGaze.name: InsanityGaze
InsanityGaze.description: The target suffers the effect of the confusion spell without making a saving throw. The effect lasts until the start of the ettin's next turn. The ettin doesn't need to concentrate on the spell.

RustMonsterCloak.name: Rust Monster Cloak
RustMonsterCloak.description: Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits Barbatos corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal that hits Barbatos is destroyed after dealing damage.

HeartoftheTroll.name: Heart of the Troll
HeartoftheTroll.description: Barbatos regains 10 hit points at the start of his turn. If Barbatos takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of Barbatos's next turn. Barbatos dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Barbatos makes two bone shortsword attacks.

BoneShortsword.name: BoneShortsword
BoneShortsword.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

LightCrossbow.name: LightCrossbow
LightCrossbow.description: rw 6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is also unconscious. The target regains consciousness if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it.

CloakSweep.name: CloakSweep
CloakSweep.description:
Barbatos corrodes a nonmagical ferrous metal object he can see within 5 feet of himself. If the object isn't being worn or carried, the touch destroys a 1-foot cube of it. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature can make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw to avoid Barbatos's touch.
If the object touched is either metal armor or a metal shield being worn or carried, it takes a permanent and cumulative 1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield that drops to a +0 bonus is destroyed. If the object touched is a held metal weapon, it rusts as described in Barbatos's Rust Monster Cloak trait.

PickorHammer.name: PickorHammer
PickorHammer.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning or piercing damage.

PetrifyingGaze.name: Petrifying Gaze
PetrifyingGaze.description:
When a creature that can see the medusa's eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of the medusa, the medusa can force it to make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw if the medusa isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is instantly petrified. Otherwise, a creature that fails the save begins to turn to metal, wood, or porcelain (the medusa's choice) and is restrained. The restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming petrified on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the  greater restoration spell or other magic.
Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the medusa until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the medusa in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.
If the medusa sees itself reflected on a polished surface within 30 feet of it and in an area of bright light, the medusa is, due to its curse, affected by its own gaze.

SpecialEquipment.name: Special Equipment
SpecialEquipment.description: Lynx's crystal eye is a magically shrunken crystal ball of true seeing. One of her teeth is a refashioned ring of mind shielding, while another has been magicked to place her under a permanent Nystul's magic aura spell, concealing the magic of these items and hiding her true nature from magic or features that can detect undead.

AversionofFire.name: Aversion of Fire
AversionofFire.description: If Lynx takes fire damage, she has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of her next turn.

ImmutableForm.name: Immutable Form
ImmutableForm.description: Lynx is immune to any spell or effect that would alter her form.

LightningAbsorption.name: Lightning Absorption
LightningAbsorption.description: Whenever Lynx is subjected to lightning damage, she takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: Lynx has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: Lynx regains 10 hit points at the start of her turn. If she takes fire or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of her next turn. Lynx's body is destroyed only if she starts her turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

TurnImmunity.name: Turn Immunity
TurnImmunity.description: Lynx is immune to effects that turn undead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Lynx makes two shortsword attacks.

Shortsword.name: Shortsword
Shortsword.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

SpecialEquipment.name: Special Equipment
SpecialEquipment.description: Moghadam wields Ruinblade|IMR (see appendix C).

ArtificialMind.name: Artificial Mind
ArtificialMind.description: Moghadam can manifest an artificial mind as a floating spectral image of a demilich's jeweled skull. Moghadam can communicate telepathically with this mind, send it up to 300 feet away from him, and see and hear through it.

Infoportation(1/Day).name: Infoportation
Infoportation(1/Day).description: Moghadam can teleport himself into an unoccupied space next to his artificial mind.

Ruinblade.name: Ruinblade
Ruinblade.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.

Blight(1/Day).name: Blight(1/Day)
Blight(1/Day).description: While wielding Ruinblade|IMR, Moghadam can cast the blight spell (DC 15).

Disintegrate(1/7Days).name: Disintegrate(1/7Days)
Disintegrate(1/7Days).description: While wielding Ruinblade|IMR, Moghadam can cast the disintegrate spell against any nonmagical object or creation of magical force.

InformationOverload{@recharge5}.name: InformationOverload{@recharge5}
InformationOverload{@recharge5}.description: Moghadam overloads the thoughts of one creature within 5 feet of either himself or his artificial mind. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or take 22 (4d8 + 4) psychic damage, and the next attack roll made against the target before the end of Moghadam's next turn has advantage.

LimitedTelepathy.name: Limited Telepathy
LimitedTelepathy.description: The otyugh can magically transmit simple messages and images to any creature within 120 feet of it that can understand a language. This form of telepathy doesn't allow the receiving creature to telepathically respond.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The neo-otyugh makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its tentacles.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw against disease or become poisoned until the disease is cured. Every 24 hours that elapse, the target must repeat the saving throw, reducing its hit point maximum by 5 (1d10) on a failure. The disease is cured on a success. The target dies if the disease reduces its hit point maximum to 0. This reduction to the target's hit point maximum lasts until the disease is cured.

Tentacle.name: Tentacle
Tentacle.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 16) and restrained until the grapple ends. The neo-otyugh has two tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

TentacleSlam.name: TentacleSlam
TentacleSlam.description: The neo-otyugh slams creatures grappled by it into each other or a solid surface. Each creature must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and be stunned until the end of the neo-otyugh's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half the bludgeoning damage and isn't stunned.

SpecialEquipment.name: Special Equipment
SpecialEquipment.description: Sir Ursas wears a ring of mind shielding and plate armor of fire resistance.

Brave.name: Brave
Brave.description: Sir Ursas has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

Brute.name: Brute
Brute.description: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when Sir Ursas hits with it (included in his attack).

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Sir Ursas makes three melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

Spear.name: Spear
Spear.description: mw,rw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft. and range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

ShieldBash.name: ShieldBash
ShieldBash.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

Talons.name: Talons
Talons.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (2d6 + 1) slashing damage.

SpecialEquipment.name: Special Equipment
SpecialEquipment.description: Thessalar wields a +1 dagger coated with Thessaltoxin|IMR|thessaltoxin poison (see appendix C).

AlchemicalHomunculus.name: Alchemical Homunculus
AlchemicalHomunculus.description: Thessalar is accompanied by his Thessalar's homunculus|IMR. If the mending spell is cast on it, the homunculus regains 2d6 hit points.

HealingToxicity.name: Healing Toxicity
HealingToxicity.description: Any magic item that restores hit points and can be applied to a piercing or slashing weapon (a potion, an ointment, and so forth) causes a hit with that weapon to deal extra damage to Thessalar equal to the amount the item would normally heal.

GreaterRestoration(1/Day).name: Greater Restoration
GreaterRestoration(1/Day).description: Thessalar can cast greater restoration if he has access to Alchemist's Supplies|phb|alchemical supplies.

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.description: mw,rw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is affected as if by the polymorph spell, transforming into a random beast|bestiary|type=beast|miscellaneous=!swarm or a creature it has seen within the last 24 hours (as chosen by the DM). This effect lasts until the target finishes a long rest.

TelepathicBond.name: Telepathic Bond
TelepathicBond.description: While the construct is on the same plane of existence as its master, it can magically convey what it senses to its master, and the two can communicate telepathically.

Claws.name: Claws
Claws.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 1 slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is instead poisoned for 5 (1d10) minutes and unconscious while poisoned in this way.

Amphibious.name: Amphibious
Amphibious.description: The thessalkraken can breathe air and water.

FreedomofMovement.name: Freedom of Movement
FreedomofMovement.description: The thessalkraken ignores difficult terrain||3, and magical effects can't reduce its speed or cause it to be restrained. It can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being grappled.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The thessalkraken makes one bite attack and two tentacle attacks. It can replace each tentacle attack with one use of Fling.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description:
mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) acid damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature grappled by the thessalkraken, that creature is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has Cover||3||total cover against attacks and other effects outside the thessalkraken, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the thessalkraken's turns.
If the thessalkraken takes 35 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the thessalkraken. If the thessalkraken dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

Tentacle.name: Tentacle
Tentacle.description: mw 12 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The thessalkraken has ten tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

Fling.name: Fling
Fling.description: One Medium or smaller object held or creature grappled by the thessalkraken is thrown up to 40 feet in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

AcidSaliva{@recharge5}.name: AcidSaliva{@recharge5}
AcidSaliva{@recharge5}.description: The thessalkraken spits a glob of acid at a point it can see within 60 feet of it. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

HoldBreath.name: Hold Breath
HoldBreath.description: The two-headed crocodile can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

TwoHeads.name: Two Heads
TwoHeads.description: The two-headed crocodile has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

Wakeful.name: Wakeful
Wakeful.description: When one of the crocodile's heads is asleep, its other head is awake.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The two-headed crocodile makes two attacks with its bite.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and that head of the crocodile can't bite another target.

TwoHeads.name: Two Heads
TwoHeads.description: The two-headed owlbear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

Wakeful.name: Wakeful

Multiattack.description: The two-headed owlbear makes three attacks: two with its beaks and one with its claws.

Beak.name: Beak
Beak.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

Claws.name: Claws

Tunneler.name: Tunneler
Tunneler.description: The aurumvorax can burrow through solid rock and metal at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

Multiattack.description: The aurumvorax makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature wearing armor of any type, the aurumvorax regains 4 (1d6 + 1) hit points.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the aurumvorax can't use its Claw attack on another target, and when it moves, it can drag the grappled creature with it, without the aurumvorax's speed being halved.

PackLeader.name: Pack Leader
PackLeader.description: The aurumvorax's allies have advantage on attack rolls while within 10 feet of the aurumvorax, provided it isn't incapacitated.

Frenzy.description: The aurumvorax has advantage on attack rolls until start of its next turn.

Claw.name: Claw

Amphibious.name: Amphibious
Amphibious.description: The bakunawa can breathe air and water.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the bakunawa fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The bakunawa makes one Bite attack and one Storm Slam attack.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description:
mw 9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) lightning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be swallowed by the bakunawa. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, and it has Cover||3||total cover against attacks and other effects outside the bakunawa. At the start of each of the bakunawa's turns, each swallowed creature takes 10 (3d6) lightning damage.
The bakunawa's gullet can hold up to two creatures at a time. If the bakunawa takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a swallowed creature, the bakunawa must succeed on a 16 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 15 feet of the bakunawa. If the bakunawa dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

StormSlam.name: StormSlam
StormSlam.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) thunder damage, and the target is pushed up to 10 feet in a horizontal direction away from the bakunawa.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The scout makes two melee attacks.

BrokenBottle.name: BrokenBottle
BrokenBottle.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

High-HeeledShoe.name: High-HeeledShoe
High-HeeledShoe.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

IncorporealMovement.name: Incorporeal Movement
IncorporealMovement.description: The haint can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The haint doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The haint makes two Sorrowful Touch attacks.

SorrowfulTouch.name: SorrowfulTouch
SorrowfulTouch.description: ms 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) psychic damage.

ChangeShape.name: ChangeShape
ChangeShape.description: The haint magically assumes the appearance of the Humanoid it was in life, while retaining its game statistics. The assumed appearance ends if the haint is reduced to 0 hit points or uses an action to end it.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance

UnusualNature.description: The pari doesn't require food, drink, or sleep.

Multiattack.description: The pari makes three Mace attacks.

Mace.name: Mace
Mace.description: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage.

DisorientingFutures.name: DisorientingFutures
DisorientingFutures.description: The pari attempts to flood the mind of one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself with visions of the future. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or take 27 (5d10) psychic damage and have disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of the pari's next turn.

Amphibious.name: Amphibious
Amphibious.description: The riverine can breathe air and water.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the riverine fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.description: The riverine makes two Flood Strike attacks.

FloodStrike.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) cold damage.

EnthralledLure(1/Day).name: Enthralled Lure
EnthralledLure(1/Day).description: The soul shaker can cast the geas spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12).

Reconstruction.name: Reconstruction
Reconstruction.description: When the soul shaker is reduced to 0 hit points, it explodes into 7 (1d4 + 5) crawling claws. After 6 (1d12) days, if at least two of those crawling claws are alive, they teleport to the location of the soul shaker's death and merge together, whereupon the soul shaker reforms and regains all its hit points.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The soul shaker doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

CrushingGrasp.name: CrushingGrasp
CrushingGrasp.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). The soul shaker can have only one creature grappled in this way at a time.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The tlacatecolo has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The tlacatecolo makes two Talon attacks.

Talon.name: Talon
Talon.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 14 (3d8) poison damage.

ChangeShape.name: ChangeShape
ChangeShape.description: The tlacatecolo magically transforms into a Medium owl, while retaining its game statistics (other than its size). This transformation ends if the tlacatecolo is reduced to 0 hit points or if it uses its action to end it.

PlagueWinds(FiendFormOnly;Recharge5-6).name: PlagueWinds(FiendFormOnly;Recharge5-6)
PlagueWinds(FiendFormOnly;Recharge5-6).description:
The tlacatecolo emits a chilling, disease-ridden wind in a 60-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 26 (4d12) cold damage and become poisoned.
While poisoned in this way, the creature can't regain hit points. At the end of every hour, the creature must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or gain 1 level of exhaustion. If the creature is in direct sunlight when it makes this saving throw, it automatically succeeds on the save.
If the creature is targeted by magic that ends a poison or disease, such as lesser restoration, while the creature isn't in direct sunlight, the effect does not end.

FireAura.name: Fire Aura
FireAura.description: At the start of each of the tlexolotl's turns, each creature within 10 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage, and flammable objects in that aura that aren't being worn or carried ignite. A creature that touches the tlexolotl or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

Illumination.name: Illumination
Illumination.description: The tlexolotl sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: The tlexolotl regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the tlexolotl takes cold damage or is immersed in water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the tlexolotl's next turn. The tlexolotl dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The tlexolotl makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 12 (1d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) fire damage.

Tail.name: Tail
Tail.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the tlexolotl and knocked prone.

Pyroclasm{@recharge5}.name: Pyroclasm{@recharge5}
Pyroclasm{@recharge5}.description: Gouts of molten lava erupt from the tlexolotl's body. Each creature in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on the tlexolotl must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed saving throw, a creature takes 21 (6d6) fire damage and 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage. On a successful saving throw, a creature takes half as much damage.

BlurredForm.name: Blurred Form
BlurredForm.description: Attack rolls against the whistler are made with disadvantage unless the whistler is incapacitated.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The whistler doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The whistler makes three Psychic Swipe attacks.

PsychicSwipe.name: PsychicSwipe
PsychicSwipe.description: ms 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. on hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) psychic damage.

OtherworldlyMelody{@recharge5}.name: OtherworldlyMelody{@recharge5}
OtherworldlyMelody{@recharge5}.description: The whistler telepathically whistles an otherworldly melody into the minds of up to two creatures it can see within range of its telepathy. Each target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or take 33 (6d10) psychic damage and become frightened of the whistler for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

CloakoftheMountain{@recharge4}.name: CloakoftheMountain{@recharge4}
CloakoftheMountain{@recharge4}.description: The wynling magically turns invisible, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, for 1 minute or until it makes an attack roll.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If Charmayne fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Charmayne makes three Ashen Burst attacks. She can replace one of these attacks with one use of Spellcasting.

AshenBurst.name: AshenBurst
AshenBurst.description: ms,rs 9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (5d6) fire damage.

CinderSpite{@recharge5}.name: CinderSpite{@recharge5}
CinderSpite{@recharge5}.description: Charmayne creates a magical explosion of fire centered on a point she can see within 120 feet of herself. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A Humanoid reduced to 0 hit points by this damage dies and is transformed into a Tiny charcoal figurine.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The defender doesn't need air, food, drink, or sleep.

ElectrifiedBite.name: ElectrifiedBite
ElectrifiedBite.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) lightning damage. A creature grappled by the defender takes the damage again at the start of each of the defender's turns. The defender can have only one creature grappled in this way at a time, and the defender can't make Electrified Bite attacks while grappling.

Flyby.name: Flyby
Flyby.description: The observer doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

TelepathicBond.name: Telepathic Bond
TelepathicBond.description: While the observer is within 1 mile of its creator, it can magically convey what it sees to its creator, and the two can communicate telepathically.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The observer doesn't need air, food, drink, or sleep.

Shriek.name: Shriek
Shriek.description: The observer emits a mechanical shriek until the start of its next turn or until it drops to 0 hit points. This shriek can be heard within a range of 300 feet.

PsionicRevitalization.name: PsionicRevitalization
PsionicRevitalization.description: The fragment touches one creature that has 0 hit points in the fragment's space. The target regains 10 hit points, and each creature within 10 feet of the healed creature takes 3 (1d6) psychic damage.

SquirmingDodge.name: SquirmingDodge
SquirmingDodge.description: Until the start of the fragment's next turn, any attack roll made against the fragment has disadvantage, and the fragment makes saving throws with advantage.

The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

PsychicOrb.name: PsychicOrb
PsychicOrb.description: rs 5 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. on hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) psychic damage.

AntimagicSusceptibility.description: In an area of antimagic, Prisoner 13's tattoos and reactions don't function, and she suffers the following modifications to her statistics: her AC becomes 13, she loses her immunity to psychic damage and the charmed condition, and her Tattooed Strike becomes a melee attack that deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage on a hit.

MindlinkTattoos.name: Mindlink Tattoos
MindlinkTattoos.description: Prisoner 13 has telepathic links with dozens of agents operating throughout the land. The links allow Prisoner 13 to communicate telepathically with each of these agents while they are both on the same plane of existence.

MountainTattoo.name: Mountain Tattoo
MountainTattoo.description: Prisoner 13's AC includes her Constitution modifier.

ShroudTattoo.name: Shroud Tattoo
ShroudTattoo.description: Prisoner 13 can't be targeted by divination spells or any feature that would read her thoughts, and she can't be perceived through magical scrying sensors. She can't be contacted telepathically unless she allows such contact.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Prisoner 13 makes two Tattooed Strike attacks.

TattooedStrike.name: TattooedStrike
TattooedStrike.description: mw,rw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. on hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) force damage.

Each other creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 13 (3d8) fire damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone.

RiverTattoo.name: RiverTattoo
RiverTattoo.description: Prisoner 13 magically ends any effects causing the grappled or restrained conditions on herself. If she is bound with nonmagical restraints, she slips out of them.

FearofFrogsandToads.name: Fear of Frogs and Toads
FearofFrogsandToads.description: Sythian is frightened while he is within 20 feet of a frog or a toad (of any size) that he can see.

Graz'zt'sGift.name: Graz'zt's Gift
Graz'zt'sGift.description: Sythian's AC includes his Charisma modifier.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Sythian makes two Poisoned Shortsword or Poisoned Dart attacks and uses Whispers of Azzagrat.

PoisonedShortsword.name: PoisonedShortsword
PoisonedShortsword.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage.

PoisonedDart.name: PoisonedDart
PoisonedDart.description: rw 5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage.

WhispersofAzzagrat.name: WhispersofAzzagrat
WhispersofAzzagrat.description: Each creature in a 15-foot cube originating from Sythian must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't incapacitated.

SpecialEquipment.name: Special Equipment
SpecialEquipment.description: The Stranger wears an invisible ring of mind shielding that thwarts magical attempts to read their thoughts. The Stranger also wears dimensional shackles but is eager to be rid of them. One touch from Omid's mace-key causes the shackles to fall off, freeing the Stranger.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The archmage has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

ForceField.name: Force Field
ForceField.description: Tockworth generates a magical force field around herself. This force field has 15 hit points and regains all its hit points at the start of each of Tockworth's turns, but it ceases to function if Tockworth drops to 0 hit points. Any damage Tockworth takes is subtracted from the force field's hit points first. Each time the force field regains hit points, the following conditions end on Tockworth: grappled, restrained, and stunned.

LightCrossbow.description: rw 4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

Unstable.description: If the rig takes damage, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be incapacitated with a speed of 0 until a creature activates it with a successful DC 10 Intelligence (Arcana) check made as an action.

Vine.name: Vine
Vine.description: m 9, reach 20 ft. on hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is the incarnation's size or smaller, it has the Grappled|XPHB condition (escape DC 15) from one of two vines.

RadiantBlast.description: con DC 17, each creature of the incarnation's choice in a 20-foot Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation originating from the incarnation. {@actSaveFail} The creature takes 14 (2d8 + 5) Radiant damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

Mimicry.name: Mimicry
Mimicry.description: The merrow can mimic voices and animal sounds. A creature that hears the mimicries can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Insight|XPHB) check.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The merrow makes three Spined Tail attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with a use of Spellcasting to cast Command|XPHB.

SpinedTail.name: SpinedTail
SpinedTail.description: m,r 6, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. on hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

Amphibious.description: The merrow can breathe air and water.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The merrow makes three attacks, using Coral Scepter and Poisoned|XPHB Longbow in any combination.

CoralScepter.name: CoralScepter
CoralScepter.description: m 7, reach 5 ft. on hit: 14 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

PoisonedLongbow.name: PoisonedLongbow
PoisonedLongbow.description: r 7, range 150/600 ft. on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

Invective.name: Invective
Invective.description: wis DC 15, up to three creatures the merrow can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 14 (4d6) Psychic damage, and the creature has Disadvantage|XPHB on its next attack roll before the end of the merrow's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

SiegeMonster.name: Siege Monster
SiegeMonster.description: The noggle deals double damage to objects and structures.

SabotagingSwipe.name: SabotagingSwipe
SabotagingSwipe.description: m 4, reach 5 ft. on hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage. If the target is wearing armor, it is subjected to the following effect. dex DC 12. {@actSaveFail} The armor takes a -1 penalty to the AC it offers. The target can take an action to remove the penalty from its armor.

BloodiedWildMagic.name: Bloodied Wild Magic
BloodiedWildMagic.description: While Bloodied|XPHB, the noggle has a Fly Speed|XPHB of 30 feet and it can choose for any damage it deals to be Force damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The noggle makes two attacks, using Noggling Stick or Befuddling Ray in any combination.

NogglingStick.name: NogglingStick
NogglingStick.description: m 5, reach 5 ft. on hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) Psychic damage.

BefuddlingRay.name: BefuddlingRay
BefuddlingRay.description: r 5, range 60 ft. on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Psychic damage, and the target subtracts 1d4 from the next saving throw it makes before the end of the noggle's next turn.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The giant makes three attacks, using Tree Club or Boulder in any combination.

TreeClub.name: TreeClub
TreeClub.description: m 9, reach 15 ft. on hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

Boulder.name: Boulder
Boulder.description: r 9, range 60/240 ft. on hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone|XPHB condition.

WildMagicCataclysm{@recharge5}.name: WildMagicCataclysm{@recharge5}
WildMagicCataclysm{@recharge5}.description: dex DC 15, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere centered on a point within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 28 (8d6) damage (roll 1d4 to determine damage type: 1—Acid; 2—Fire; 3—Lightning; 4—Thunder). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

DetectSentience.name: Detect Sentience
DetectSentience.description: The brain in a jar can sense the presence and location of any creature within 300 feet of it that has an Intelligence of 3 or higher, regardless of interposing barriers, unless the creature is protected by a mind blank spell.

魔法抗性.name: 魔法抗性
魔法抗性.description: The brain in a jar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

MindBlast{@recharge5}.name: MindBlast{@recharge5}
MindBlast{@recharge5}.description: The brain in a jar magically emits psychic energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or take 13 (2d8 + 4) psychic damage and be stunned for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

魔法抗性.name: 魔法抗性
魔法抗性.description: The clockwork kraken has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

IndependentTentacles.name: Independent Tentacles
IndependentTentacles.description:
The clockwork kraken has eight tentacles, each of which is treated as a Medium creature, moves independently on the construct's turn, and has a flying speed of 40 feet. The clockwork kraken's senses operate through its tentacles as well as its main body. Each tentacle can be attacked independently, with damage dealt to tentacles applied to the clockwork kraken's hit point total. A tentacle is destroyed if it takes more than 20 damage.
Reducing the construct to three or fewer tentacles reduces its attacks accordingly. A clockwork kraken can regrow any destroyed tentacles at the end of a long rest.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The clockwork kraken makes four tentacle slam attacks.

TentacleSlam.name: TentacleSlam
TentacleSlam.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

ElderMonasteryoftheDistressedBodyMonk.name: Elder Monastery of the Distressed Body Monk
Elder Monastery of the Distressed Body Monk

SpecialEquipment.name: Special Equipment
SpecialEquipment.description: Garret wears a Ring of Warmth (included in his statistics) and wields a Gambler's Blade longsword|LLK.

BardicInspiration(3/Day).name: Bardic Inspiration
BardicInspiration(3/Day).description: As a bonus action, Garret can give one chosen creature (other than him) a d6 inspiration die. The chosen creature must be within 60 feet of Garret and able to hear him. Once within the next 10 minutes, the creature can roll the die and add the number rolled to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes. The creature can use the inspiration die after the roll is made but before the DM says whether it succeeds or fails. Once the inspiration die is rolled, it is lost. A creature can have only one inspiration die at a time.

CunningAction.name: Cunning Action
CunningAction.description: On each of his turns, Garret can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

SneakAttack(1/Turn).name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
SneakAttack(1/Turn).description: Garret deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Garret that isn't incapacitated and Garret doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

Shortsword.name: Shortsword
Shortsword.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

PetrifyingGaze.name: Petrifying Gaze
PetrifyingGaze.description:
When a creature that can see the medusa's eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of the medusa, the medusa can force it to make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw if the medusa isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is instantly petrified. Otherwise, a creature that fails the save begins to turn to glass and is restrained. The restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming petrified on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the  greater restoration spell or other magic.
Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the medusa until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the medusa in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.
If the medusa sees itself reflected on a polished surface within 30 feet of it and in an area of bright light, the medusa is, due to its curse, affected by its own gaze.

SpecialEquipment.name: Special Equipment
SpecialEquipment.description: Mary wears Bracers of Defense and a Ring of Protection, and carries a Deck of Several Things|LLK

FeyPresence(RechargesafteraShortRest).name: Fey Presence (Recharges after a Short Rest)
FeyPresence(RechargesafteraShortRest).description: Mary can cause each creature within 10 feet of her to succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or become charmed or frightened by her (Mary's choice) until the end of her next turn.

FeyAncestry.name: Fey Ancestry
FeyAncestry.description: Mary has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put her to sleep.

Quarterstaff.name: Quarterstaff
Quarterstaff.description: mw 2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

MonasteryoftheDistressedBodyGrandMaster.name: Monastery of the Distressed Body Grand Master
Monastery of the Distressed Body Grand Master

MonasteryoftheDistressedBodyMonk.name: Monastery of the Distressed Body Monk
Monastery of the Distressed Body Monk

Transparent.name: Transparent
Transparent.description: Even when an ooze-folk is in plain sight, it takes a DC 12 Wisdom (Perception) check to spot an ooze-folk that has neither moved nor attacked. A creature that tries to enter the ooze-folk's space while unaware of the ooze-folk is surprised by the ooze-folk.

FragileBones.name: Fragile Bones
FragileBones.description: For each 5 damage it takes, the ooze-folk's walking speed is reduced by 5 feet.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The ooze folk makes one glass longsword attack and one pseudopod attack.

GlassLongsword.name: GlassLongsword
GlassLongsword.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage. If a 1 is rolled on an attack roll with a glass longsword, it shatters and can no longer be used.

Pseudopod.name: Pseudopod
Pseudopod.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) acid damage.

UndeadFortitude.name: Undead Fortitude
UndeadFortitude.description: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5+the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.

AshPuff.name: Ash Puff
AshPuff.description: The first time the zombie takes damage, any living creature within 5 feet of the zombie must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or gain disadvantage on attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on it early with a successful save.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

IncorporealMovement.name: Incorporeal Movement
IncorporealMovement.description: The wraith can move through an object or another creature, but can't stop there.

SunlightSensitivity.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
SunlightSensitivity.description: While in sunlight, the wraith has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
