Shortbow.description: rw 5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) piercing damage. Target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (2d4) poison damage.

Amorphous.name: Amorphous
Amorphous.description: The sludge hag can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

Amphibious.name: Amphibious
Amphibious.description: The sludge hag can breathe air and water.

FalseAppearance.name: FalseAppearance
FalseAppearance.description: The sludge hag collapses into a oily pool of sludge. While motionless, the sludge hag is indistinguishable from any other oily pool of oozy drippiness.

SludgeSlap.name: SludgeSlap
SludgeSlap.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 12 (1d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage, plus 4 (1d8) acid damage. Sludge Slap does both bludgeoning and acid damage

Amphibious.name: Amphibious
Amphibious.description: The spiderfrog can breathe air and water.

SpiderClimb.name: Spider Climb
SpiderClimb.description: The spiderfrog can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

StandingLeap.name: Standing Leap
StandingLeap.description: Spiderfrog's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage. Target is grappled (escape DC 11). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and spiderfrog can't bite another target.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: Coral has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Coral makes two Hoof attacks and uses Tail Thump.

Hoof.name: Hoof
Hoof.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

TailThump.name: TailThump
TailThump.description: Coral slams her tail down, unleashing a burst of magical force toward one creature she can see within 60 feet of her. The target must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 22 (4d10) force damage and has the prone condition. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target dies, and its body is reduced to fine dust.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The dandylion has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

PackTactics.name: Pack Tactics
PackTactics.description: The dandylion has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the dandylion's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The dandylion makes one Bite attack and one Claws attack.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage.

Claws.name: Claws
Claws.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) slashing damage. If the dandylion moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition. If the target has the prone condition, the dandylion can make one Bite attack against it as a bonus action.

RejuvenatingSeedpods(2/Day).name: RejuvenatingSeedpods(2/Day)
RejuvenatingSeedpods(2/Day).description: The dandylion releases a burst of seedpods from its tail, filling a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Each creature of the dandylion's choice in the sphere can immediately end one of the following conditions on itself (creature's choice): blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned. In addition, all soil in the sphere's area is enriched, restoring withered vegetation in the area to full health and causing all crops in the area to produce twice the normal harvest for the next year.

FieryWings.name: Fiery Wings
FieryWings.description: Rain's wings are made of flame, and they shed bright light out to 15 feet and dim light for an additional 15 feet. At the start of each of Rain's turns, each creature of Rain's choice within 5 feet of her takes 3 (1d6) fire damage. A creature that hits Rain with a melee attack takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: Rain has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Rain makes two Hoof attacks.

Hoof.name: Hoof
Hoof.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage.

HaloedHornBurst{@recharge5}.name: HaloedHornBurst{@recharge5}
HaloedHornBurst{@recharge5}.description: Rain uses her haloed horn to produce one of the following magical effects:

Glitterstorm.name: Glitterstorm
Glitterstorm.description: Rain emits a rainbow beam in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) radiant damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one; creatures of evil alignment have disadvantage on this saving throw. If the damage from this effect reduces a creature to 0 hit points, the creature dies, and its body turns into glittery flowers.

HealingRainbows.name: HealingRainbows
HealingRainbows.description: Rain releases a wave of rejuvenating multicolored light in a 30-foot cone. Each creature of Rain's choice in that area regains 18 (4d8) hit points.

ElectrifiedChassis.name: Electrified Chassis
ElectrifiedChassis.description: A creature that hits the scrapper with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 19 (3d12) lightning damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The scrapper makes two Spike Punch attacks. It can replace one of those with a Wires attack.

SpikePunch.name: SpikePunch
SpikePunch.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) piercing damage.

Wires.name: Wires
Wires.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 20 ft., one Large or smaller creature. on hit: The target has the grappled condition (escape DC 16) and must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the scrapper and take 19 (3d12) lightning damage. The scrapper can have only one creature grappled in this way at a time.

EyeBeam{@recharge5}.name: EyeBeam{@recharge5}
EyeBeam{@recharge5}.description: The scrapper shoots a magical beam from its extended eye at one creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Amphibious.name: Amphibious
Amphibious.description: Seth can breathe air and water.

InvisibleinWater.name: Invisible in Water
InvisibleinWater.description: Seth has the invisible condition while fully immersed in water.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Seth makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (1d6 + 7) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage.

RiptideBreath{@recharge5}.name: RiptideBreath{@recharge5}
RiptideBreath{@recharge5}.description: Seth exhales a torrent of frigid water in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 36 (8d8) cold damage and has the incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

SpaceDweller.name: Space Dweller
SpaceDweller.description: Sheldon can breathe normally in a vacuum.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Sheldon makes either two Bite attacks, two Blueberry Fling attacks, or one of each.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) psychic damage.

BlueberryFling.name: BlueberryFling
BlueberryFling.description: rw 7 to hit, range 30 ft., one creature. on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) blueberry damage.

JetstreamBreath{@recharge5}.name: JetstreamBreath{@recharge5}
JetstreamBreath{@recharge5}.description: Sheldon exhales a line of magical wind that is 60 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 21 (6d6) force damage, is pushed 15 feet away from Sheldon, and has the prone condition. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

DiveAttack.name: Dive Attack
DiveAttack.description: If the aarakocra is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack deals an extra 3 (1d6) damage to the target.

Talon.name: Talon
Talon.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

Javelin.name: Javelin
Javelin.description: mw,rw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

SummonAirElemental.name: SummonAirElemental
SummonAirElemental.description: Five aarakocra within 30 feet of each other can magically summon an air elemental. Each of the five must use its action and movement on three consecutive turns to perform an aerial dance and must maintain concentration while doing so (as if concentration||concentrating on a spell). When all five have finished their third turn of the dance, the elemental appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of them. It is friendly toward them and obeys their spoken commands. It remains for 1 hour, until it or all its summoners die, or until any of its summoners dismisses it as a bonus action. A summoner can't perform the dance again until it finishes a short rest. When the elemental returns to the Elemental Plane of Air, any aarakocra within 5 feet of it can return with it.

Amphibious.name: Amphibious
Amphibious.description: The aboleth can breathe air and water.

EldritchRestoration.name: Eldritch Restoration
EldritchRestoration.description: If destroyed, the aboleth gains a new body in 5d10 days, reviving with all its Hit Points|XPHB in the Far Realm or another location chosen by the DM.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day,or4/DayinLair).name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
LegendaryResistance(3/Day,or4/DayinLair).description: If the aboleth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

MucusCloud.name: Mucus Cloud
MucusCloud.description:
While underwater, the aboleth is surrounded by mucus. con DC 14, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation originating from the aboleth at the end of the aboleth's turn. {@actSaveFail} The target is cursed. Until the curse ends, the target's skin becomes slimy, the target can breathe air and water, and it can't regain Hit Points|XPHB unless it is underwater.
While the cursed creature is outside a body of water, the creature takes 6 (1d12) Acid damage at the end of every 10 minutes unless moisture is applied to its skin before those minutes have passed.

ProbingTelepathy.name: Probing Telepathy
ProbingTelepathy.description: If a creature the aboleth can see communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns the creature's greatest desires.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The aboleth makes two Tentacle attacks and uses either Consume Memories or Dominate Mind if available.

Tentacle.name: Tentacle
Tentacle.description: m 9, reach 15 ft. on hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled|XPHB condition (escape DC 14) from one of four tentacles.

ConsumeMemories.name: ConsumeMemories
ConsumeMemories.description: int DC 16, one creature within 30 feet that is Charmed|XPHB or Grappled|XPHB by the aboleth. {@actSaveFail} 10 (3d6) Psychic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The aboleth gains the target's memories if the target is a Humanoid and is reduced to 0 Hit Points|XPHB by this action.

DominateMind(2/Day).name: DominateMind(2/Day)
DominateMind(2/Day).description:
wis DC 16, one creature the aboleth can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the Charmed|XPHB condition until the aboleth dies or is on a different plane of existence from the target. While Charmed|XPHB, the target acts as an ally to the aboleth and is under its control while within 60 feet of it. In addition, the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance.
The target repeats the save whenever it takes damage as well as after every 24 hours it spends at least 1 mile away from the aboleth, ending the effect on itself on a success.

FearofFire.name: Fear of Fire
FearofFire.description: If the yeti takes Fire damage, it has Disadvantage|XPHB on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The yeti can use its Chilling Gaze and makes two attacks, using Claw or Ice Throw in any combination.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: m 11, reach 5 ft. on hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Cold damage.

IceThrow.name: IceThrow
IceThrow.description: r 11, range 60/240 ft. on hit: 12 (2d4 + 7) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Cold damage.

ChillingGaze.name: ChillingGaze
ChillingGaze.description: con DC 18, one creature the yeti can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 21 (6d6) Cold damage, and the target has the Paralyzed|XPHB condition until the start of the yeti's next turn unless the target has Immunity|XPHB to Cold damage. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to this yeti's Chilling Gaze for 1 hour.

ColdBreath{@recharge}.description: con DC 18, each creature in a 30-foot Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone. {@actSaveFail} 45 (10d8) Cold damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

Claw.name: Claw

Tail.name: Tail
Tail.description: mw 13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

FrightfulPresence.name: FrightfulPresence
FrightfulPresence.description: Each creature of the dracolich's choice that is within 120 feet of the dracolich and aware of it must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dracolich's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

LightningBreath{@recharge5}.name: LightningBreath{@recharge5}
LightningBreath{@recharge5}.description: The dracolich exhales lightning in a 90-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 66 (12d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day,or4/DayinLair).description: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.description: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Shatter|XPHB.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day,or4/DayinLair).name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
LegendaryResistance(3/Day,or4/DayinLair).description: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Rend.description: m 11, reach 10 ft. on hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Fire damage.

This effect ends for the target if it takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day,or4/DayinLair).description: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

This effect lasts until the end of its next turn.

AxiomaticMind.description: The duodrone can't be compelled to act in a manner contrary to its nature or its instructions.

Disintegration.name: Disintegration
Disintegration.description: If the duodrone dies, its body disintegrates into dust, leaving behind its weapons and anything else it was carrying.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The duodrone makes two fist attacks or two javelin attacks.

Fist.name: Fist
Fist.description: mw 2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

Javelin.name: Javelin
Javelin.description: mw,rw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

DeathBurst.name: Death Burst
DeathBurst.description: The mephit explodes when it dies. dex DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation originating from the mephit. {@actSaveFail} 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: m 4, reach 5 ft. on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

BlindingBreath{@recharge}.name: BlindingBreath{@recharge}
BlindingBreath{@recharge}.description: dex DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone. {@actSaveFail} The target has the Blinded|XPHB condition until the end of the mephit's next turn.

Talons.name: Talons
Talons.description: m 4, reach 5 feet. on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

EarthGlide.name: Earth Glide
EarthGlide.description: The elemental can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the elemental doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

SiegeMonster.name: Siege Monster
SiegeMonster.description: The elemental deals double damage to objects and structures.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The elemental makes two attacks, using Slam or Rock Launch in any combination.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: m 8, reach 10 ft. on hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

RockLaunch.name: RockLaunch
RockLaunch.description: r 8, range 60 ft. on hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone|XPHB condition.

ElementalRestoration.name: Elemental Restoration
ElementalRestoration.description: If the efreeti dies outside the Elemental Plane of Fire, its body dissolves into ash, and it gains a new body in 1d4 days, reviving with all its Hit Points|XPHB somewhere on the Plane of Fire.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The efreeti has Advantage|XPHB on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Wishes.name: Wishes
Wishes.description: The efreeti has a 30 percent chance of knowing the Wish|XPHB spell. If the efreeti knows it, the efreeti can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the efreeti can understand. If the efreeti casts the spell for the creature, the efreeti suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the efreeti has cast it three times, the efreeti can't do so again for 365 days.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The efreeti makes three attacks, using Heated Blade or Hurl Flame in any combination.

HeatedBlade.name: HeatedBlade
HeatedBlade.description: m 10, reach 5 ft. on hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) Slashing damage plus 13 (2d12) Fire damage.

HurlFlame.name: HurlFlame
HurlFlame.description: r 8, range 120 ft. on hit: 24 (7d6) Fire damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The elephant makes two Gore attacks.

Gore.name: Gore
Gore.description: m 8, reach 5 ft. on hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature and the elephant moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the Prone|XPHB condition.

Ram.name: Ram
Ram.description: m 5, reach 5 ft. on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the elk moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage and has the Prone|XPHB condition.

LegendaryResistance(4/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(4/Day).description: If the empyrean fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The empyrean has Advantage|XPHB on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The empyrean makes two attacks, using Sacred Weapon or Divine Ray in any combination.

SacredWeapon.name: SacredWeapon
SacredWeapon.description: m 17, reach 10 ft. on hit: 31 (6d6 + 10) Force damage, and the target has the Stunned|XPHB condition until the start of the empyrean's next turn. The target can choose not to be Stunned|XPHB, in which case it takes an extra 21 Force damage that bypasses Resistance|XPHB or Immunity|XPHB.

DivineRay.name: DivineRay
DivineRay.description: r 15, range 600 ft. on hit: 35 (6d8 + 8) Necrotic or Radiant damage (empyrean's choice).

DiabolicalRestoration.name: Diabolical Restoration
DiabolicalRestoration.description: If the erinyes dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points|XPHB somewhere in the Nine Hells.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The erinyes has Advantage|XPHB on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

MagicRope.name: Magic Rope
MagicRope.description: The erinyes has a magic rope. While bearing it, the erinyes can use the Entangling Rope action. The rope has AC 20, HP 90, and Immunity|XPHB to Poison and Psychic damage. The rope turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points|XPHB, if it is 5+ feet away from the erinyes for 1 hour or more, or if the erinyes dies. If the rope is damaged or destroyed, the erinyes can fully restore it when finishing a Short Rest|XPHB|Short or Long Rest|XPHB.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The erinyes makes three Withering Sword attacks and can use Entangling Rope.

WitheringSword.name: WitheringSword
WitheringSword.description: m 8, reach 5 ft. on hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage.

EntanglingRope(RequiresMagicRope).name: EntanglingRope(RequiresMagicRope)
EntanglingRope(RequiresMagicRope).description: str DC 16, one creature the erinyes can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 14 (4d6) Force damage, and the target has the Restrained|XPHB condition until the rope is destroyed, the erinyes uses a Bonus Action|XPHB to release the target, or the erinyes uses Entangling Rope again.

SpiderClimb.name: Spider Climb
SpiderClimb.description: The ettercap can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

WebWalker.name: Web Walker
WebWalker.description: The ettercap ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the ettercap knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The ettercap makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: m 4, reach 5 ft. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned|XPHB condition until the start of the ettercap's next turn.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: m 4, reach 5 ft. on hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

WebStrand{@recharge5}.name: WebStrand{@recharge5}
WebStrand{@recharge5}.description: dex DC 12, one Large or smaller creature the ettercap can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the Restrained|XPHB condition until the web is destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; Vulnerability|XPHB to Fire damage; Immunity|XPHB to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage).

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The ettin makes one Battleaxe attack and one Morningstar attack.

Battleaxe.name: Battleaxe
Battleaxe.description: m 7, reach 5 ft. on hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone|XPHB condition.

Morningstar.name: Morningstar
Morningstar.description: m 7, reach 5 ft. on hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage, and the target has Disadvantage|XPHB on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

TheColorsofAge.name: The Colors of Age
TheColorsofAge.description:
A faerie dragon's scales change hue as it ages, moving through all the colors of the rainbow. All faerie dragons have innate spellcasting ability, gaining new spells as they mature.
Red—5 years or less
Orange—6–10 years
Yellow—11–20 years
Green—21–30 years
Blue—31–40 years
Indigo—41–50 years
Violet—51 years or more
A green or older faerie dragon's CR increases to 2.

SuperiorInvisibility.name: Superior Invisibility
SuperiorInvisibility.description: As a bonus action, the dragon can magically turn invisible until its concentration ends (as if concentration||concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the dragon wears or carries is invisible with it.

LimitedTelepathy.name: Limited Telepathy
LimitedTelepathy.description: Using telepathy, the dragon can magically communicate with any other faerie dragon within 60 feet of it.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The faerie dragon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 1 piercing damage.

EuphoriaBreath{@recharge5}.name: EuphoriaBreath{@recharge5}
EuphoriaBreath{@recharge5}.description:
The dragon exhales a puff of euphoria gas at one creature within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw, or for 1 minute, the target can't take reactions and must roll a d6 at the start of each of its turns to determine its behavior during the turn:
1–4. The target takes no action or bonus action and uses all of its movement to move in a random direction.
5–6. The target doesn't move, and the only thing it can do on its turn is make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

FireAura.name: Fire Aura
FireAura.description: At the end of each of the elemental's turns, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation originating from the elemental takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage. Creatures and flammable objects in the Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation start burning|XPHB.

FireForm.name: Fire Form
FireForm.description: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so, and it can enter a creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

Illumination.name: Illumination
Illumination.description: The elemental sheds Bright Light|XPHB in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light|XPHB for an additional 30 feet.

WaterSusceptibility.name: Water Susceptibility
WaterSusceptibility.description: The elemental takes 3 (1d6) Cold damage for every 5 feet the elemental moves in water or for every gallon of water splashed on it.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The elemental makes two Burn attacks.

Burn.name: Burn
Burn.description: m 6, reach 5 ft. on hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it starts burning|XPHB.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The giant makes two attacks, using Flame Sword or Hammer Throw in any combination.

FlameSword.name: FlameSword
FlameSword.description: m 11, reach 10 ft. on hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

HammerThrow.name: HammerThrow
HammerThrow.description: r 11, range 60/240 ft. on hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Fire damage, and the target is pushed up to 15 feet straight away from the giant and has Disadvantage|XPHB on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

HeatedBody.name: Heated Body
HeatedBody.description: A creature that touches the snake or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The snake makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

Tail.name: Tail
Tail.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

Illumination.name: Illumination
Illumination.description: The flameskull sheds Bright Light|XPHB in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light|XPHB for an additional 15 feet.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The flameskull has Advantage|XPHB on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

UndeadRestoration.name: Undead Restoration
UndeadRestoration.description: If the flameskull is destroyed, it regains all its Hit Points|XPHB in 1 hour unless Holy Water is sprinkled on its remains or the Dispel Evil and Good|XPHB spell is cast on them.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The flameskull makes two Fire Ray attacks.

FireRay.name: FireRay
FireRay.description: m,r 5, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. on hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Fire damage.

AversiontoFire.name: Aversion to Fire
AversiontoFire.description: If the golem takes Fire damage, it has Disadvantage|XPHB on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

Berserk.name: Berserk
Berserk.description:
Whenever the golem starts its turn Bloodied|XPHB, roll 1d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object. Once the golem goes berserk, it remains so until it is destroyed or it is no longer Bloodied|XPHB.
The golem's creator, if within 60 feet of the berserk golem, can try to calm it by taking an action to make a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion|XPHB) check; the golem must be able to hear its creator. If this check succeeds, the golem ceases being berserk until the start of its next turn, at which point it resumes rolling for the Berserk trait again if it is still Bloodied|XPHB.

ImmutableForm.name: Immutable Form
ImmutableForm.description: The golem can't shape-shift.

LightningAbsorption.name: Lightning Absorption
LightningAbsorption.description: Whenever the golem is subjected to Lightning damage, it regains a number of Hit Points|XPHB equal to the Lightning damage dealt.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The golem has Advantage|XPHB on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The golem makes two Slam attacks.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: m 7, reach 5 ft. on hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Lightning damage.

AdvancedTelepathy.name: Advanced Telepathy
AdvancedTelepathy.description: The flumph perceives the content of any telepathic communication within 60 feet of it.

ProneDeficiency.name: Prone Deficiency
ProneDeficiency.description: If the flumph receives the Prone|XPHB condition, roll a die. On an odd number, it has the Incapacitated|XPHB condition. At the end of each of its turns, the flumph makes a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, ending the Incapacitated|XPHB condition on a success.

TelepathicShroud.name: Telepathic Shroud
TelepathicShroud.description: The flumph's thoughts can't be read by any means, and magic can't detect its location or observe it remotely.

Tentacle.name: Tentacle
Tentacle.description: m 4, reach 5 feet. on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Acid damage.

StenchSpray(1/Day).name: StenchSpray(1/Day)
StenchSpray(1/Day).description: dex DC 10, one creature the flumph can see within 15 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target is coated in a foul-smelling liquid, exudes a stench for 1d4 hours, and has the Poisoned|XPHB condition while the stench lasts. Other creatures have the Poisoned|XPHB condition while in a 5-foot Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation originating from the coated target. The target can remove the stench on itself if it bathes during a Short Rest|XPHB|Short or Long Rest|XPHB.

Flyby.name: Flyby
Flyby.description: The snake doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: m 4, reach 5 ft. on hit: 1 Piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) Poison damage.

AntimagicSusceptibility.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
AntimagicSusceptibility.description: The sword is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the sword must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

FalseAppearance.name: False Appearance
FalseAppearance.description: While the sword remains motionless and isn't flying, it is indistinguishable from a normal sword.

Longsword.name: Longsword
Longsword.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The fomorian makes two Stone Club attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Warping Hex if available.

StoneClub.name: StoneClub

Shapechanger.name: Shapechanger
Shapechanger.description:
If the vampire isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form.
While in bat form, the vampire can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.
While in mist form, the vampire can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

MistyEscape.name: Misty Escape
MistyEscape.description:
When it drops to 0 hit points outside its resting place, the vampire transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling unconscious, provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed.
While it has 0 hit points in mist form, it can't revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then paralyzed until it regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 hit points, it regains 1 hit point.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: The vampire regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under the vampire's control.

Charm.name: Charm
Charm.description:
The vampire targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see the vampire, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed by the vampire. The charmed target regards the vampire as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under the vampire's control, it takes the vampire's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for the vampire's bite attack.
Each time the vampire or the vampire's companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until the vampire is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

DiscordantSong.name: DiscordantSong

Each humanoid within 120 feet of her must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of her until the song ends. A frightened creature takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage at the start of its turn while Aphemia is singing. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Aphemia's Discordant Song for the next 24 hours. Aphemia must take a bonus action on her subsequent turns to continue singing. She can stop singing at any time. The song ends if Aphemia is incapacitated or dies.

GraveCallingSong.name: GraveCallingSong
GraveCallingSong.description: Aphemia intones a low, growling magical melody. Every undead within 300 feet of her must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or fall under her control until the song ends. Aphemia must take a bonus action on her subsequent turns to continue singing, and she can mentally command the undead under her control as part of the same bonus action. She can stop singing at any time. The song ends if Aphemia is incapacitated or dies.

While mounted and not incapacitated, the archon can't be surprised, and both it and its mount have advantage on Dexterity saving throws. Bite.name: Bite

Claws.name: Claws

Charge.description: If Antigonos moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked prone.

LabyrinthineRecall.name: Labyrinthine Recall
LabyrinthineRecall.description: Antigonos can perfectly recall any path he has traveled.

Reckless.name: Reckless
Reckless.description: At the start of his turn, Antigonos can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls he makes during that turn, but attack rolls against him have advantage until the start of his next turn.

DecrepitState.name: Decrepit State
DecrepitState.description: Antigonos has disadvantage on his attack rolls.

Greataxe.name: Greataxe
Greataxe.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) slashing damage.

Gore.name: Gore
Gore.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

Amphora.name: Amphora
Amphora.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If there is not already a creature inside the amphora, the target is restrained inside. As an action, the restrained creature can make a DC 14 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, escaping from the amphora on a success. The effect also ends if the amphora is destroyed. The amphora has AC 8, 20 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.

FalseAppearance.name: False Appearance
FalseAppearance.description: While the sable remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal statue.

PackTactics.name: Pack Tactics
PackTactics.description: The sable has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the sable's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

SurpriseAttack.name: Surprise Attack
SurpriseAttack.description: If the sable surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage from the attack.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The sable makes two bite attacks.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

Charge.name: Charge
Charge.description: If the hart moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with an antlers attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

HeatedBody.name: Heated Body
HeatedBody.description: A creature that touches the hart or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.

Sure-Footed.name: Sure-Footed
Sure-Footed.description: The hart has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The hart makes two attacks: one with its antlers and one with its hooves.

Antlers.name: Antlers
Antlers.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

Hooves.name: Hooves
Hooves.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) fire damage.

CrumblingDestruction.name: Crumbling Destruction
CrumblingDestruction.description: When the colossus drops to 0 hit points, it crumbles and is destroyed. Any creature on the ground within 30 feet of the crumbling statue must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) bludgeoning damage and 22 (4d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

FireAbsorption.name: Fire Absorption
FireAbsorption.description: Whenever the colossus is subjected to fire damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the fire damage dealt.

ImmutableForm.name: Immutable Form
ImmutableForm.description: The colossus is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

MagicWeapons.name: Magic Weapons
MagicWeapons.description: The colossus's weapon attacks are magical.

SiegeMonster.name: Siege Monster
SiegeMonster.description: The colossus deals double damage to objects and structures.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The colossus of Akros makes two melee attacks.

Spear.name: Spear
Spear.description: mw,rw 16 to hit, reach 15 ft., or range 200/600 ft., one target. on hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) piercing damage, or 27 (4d8 + 9) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack. If the colossus makes a ranged attack with this spear, the spear magically returns to its hand after the attack.

Sword.name: Sword
Sword.description: mw 16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 36 (6d8 + 9) slashing damage.

FlamesofAkros{@recharge}.name: FlamesofAkros{@recharge}
FlamesofAkros{@recharge}.description: Magical flames issue from the colossus toward up to three creatures the colossus can see within 90 feet of it. Each target must make a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, a target also magically catches fire for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns thereafter, the burning target repeats the saving throw. It takes 18 (4d8) fire damage on a failed save, and the effect ends on a successful one.

AuraofErebos.name: Aura of Erebos
AuraofErebos.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the giant must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, or it takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage and can't regain hit points until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the giant's Aura of Erebos for 24 hours.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The giant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The giant makes two slam attacks.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

NoxiousGust{@recharge5}.name: NoxiousGust{@recharge5}
NoxiousGust{@recharge5}.description: The giant exhales a mighty gust that creates a blast of deadly mist in a 60-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 36 (8d8) necrotic damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone.

InsatiableGreed.name: Insatiable Greed
InsatiableGreed.description: The eater of hope can sense the presence of gold within 1,000 feet of itself. It can determine which location has the greatest amount of gold and can sense the direction to that site. If the gold is being moved, it knows the direction of the movement. It can't locate gold if any thickness of clay or lead, even a thin sheet, blocks a direct path between it and the gold.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The eater of hope has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The eater of hope makes two attacks with its claws.

Claws.name: Claws
Claws.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

BreathofHopelessness{@recharge5}.name: BreathofHopelessness{@recharge5}
BreathofHopelessness{@recharge5}.description: The eater of hope exhales a miasma of Underworld winds in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 26 (4d12) necrotic damage and is cursed for 1 minute. While cursed in this way, the target takes an extra 6 (1d12) necrotic damage whenever the eater of hope hits it with an attack. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't cursed.

KeenSmell.name: Keen Smell
KeenSmell.description: The lion has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

Pounce.name: Pounce
Pounce.description: If the lion moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the lion can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

RunningLeap.name: Running Leap
RunningLeap.description: With a 10-foot running start, the lion can long jump up to 25 feet.

SpellTurning.name: Spell Turning
SpellTurning.description: The lion has advantage on saving throws against any spell that targets only the lion (not an area). If the lion's saving throw succeeds and the spell is of 4th level or lower, the spell has no effect on the lion and instead targets the caster.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack

Evasion.description: If the eidolon is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the eidolon instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it's incapacitated.

IncorporealMovement.name: Incorporeal Movement
IncorporealMovement.description: The eidolon can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain||3. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

TurnResistance.name: Turn Resistance
TurnResistance.description: The eidolon has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The eidolon makes two melee attacks. Immediately before or after one of its attacks, it can use Flitterstep if it is available.

Flitterstep{@recharge5}.description: The eidolon magically teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet of it. If it makes an attack immediately after teleporting, it has advantage on the attack roll.

BlurredForm.name: Blurred Form
BlurredForm.description: Attack rolls against the eidolon are made with disadvantage unless the eidolon is incapacitated.

Charge.name: Charge
Charge.description: If the sentinel moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

SpellTurning.name: Spell Turning
SpellTurning.description: The sentinel has advantage on saving throws against any spell that targets only the sentinel (not an area). If the sentinel's saving throw succeeds and the spell is of 4th level or lower, the spell has no effect on the sentinel and instead targets the caster.

Multiattack.description: The sentinel makes two ram attacks.

FireBreath{@recharge5}.description: The sentinel exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Amphibious.name: Amphibious
Amphibious.description: The hippocamp can breathe air and water.

Charge.name: Charge
Charge.description: If the hippocamp moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

Hooves.name: Hooves

Reactive.description: The giant can take one reaction on every turn in a combat.

Multiattack.description: The giant makes four longsword attacks or two rock attacks.

Longsword.name: Longsword
Longsword.description: mw 13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) slashing damage.

Rock.name: Rock

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If Hythonia fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

PetrifyingGaze.name: Petrifying Gaze
PetrifyingGaze.description: When a creature that can see Hythonia's eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of her, Hythonia can force it to make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw if she isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is instantly petrified. Otherwise, on a failed save the creature begins to turn to stone and is restrained. The restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming petrified on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic. Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see Hythonia until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at Hythonia in the meantime, it must immediately make the save. If Hythonia sees herself reflected on a polished surface within 30 feet of her and in an area of bright light, she is affected by her own gaze.

ShedSkin(MythicTrait;RechargesafteraShor.name: Shed Skin (Mythic Trait; Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
ShedSkin(MythicTrait;RechargesafteraShor.description: If Hythonia is reduced to 0 hit points, she doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, she sheds her skin, regains 199 hit points, and moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Hythonia makes three attacks: one with her claws, one to constrict, and one with her snaky hair.

Claws.name: Claws
Claws.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.

Constrict.name: Constrict
Constrict.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. on hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 19). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and takes 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns, and Hythonia can't constrict another target.

SnakyHair.name: SnakyHair
SnakyHair.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 31 (4d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and Hythonia can pull the target up to 5 feet closer to her if it is a Large or smaller creature.

AcidicBlood.name: Acidic Blood
AcidicBlood.description: When the hydra takes piercing or slashing damage, each creature within 5 feet of the hydra takes 9 (2d8) acid damage.

HoldBreath.name: Hold Breath
HoldBreath.description: The hydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.

MultipleHeads.name: Multiple Heads
MultipleHeads.description: The hydra has five heads. While it has more than one head, the hydra has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious. Whenever the hydra takes 35 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the hydra dies. At the end of its turn, it grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken fire damage since its last turn. The hydra regains 10 hit points for each head regrown in this way.

ReactiveHeads.name: Reactive Heads
ReactiveHeads.description: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for opportunity attacks.

Wakeful.name: Wakeful
Wakeful.description: While the hydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The hydra makes as many bite attacks as it has heads.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage.

CorpseStride.description: Once on its turn, the lampad can use 10 feet of its movement to step magically into one creature's corpse within its reach and emerge from a second creature's corpse within 60 feet of the first corpse, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second corpse. Both corpses must be Medium or bigger.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance

If the target is undead, it has disadvantage on attack rolls against the lampad until the end of the lampad's next turn.

Evasion.name: Evasion

UnarmoredDefense.name: Unarmored Defense
UnarmoredDefense.description: While the leonin is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack

RayofFrost(Cantrip).description: rs 5 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. on hit: 4 (1d8) cold damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of the hoplite's next turn.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance

Multiattack.description: The shepherd makes two attacks: one with its claws and one with its staff.

HeartsoftheKraken(MythicTrait;Rechargesa.name: Hearts of the Kraken (Mythic Trait; Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
HeartsoftheKraken(MythicTrait;Rechargesa.description: When Tromokratis is reduced to 0 hit points, it doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, the damage creates cracks in its carapace, revealing its hearts. Tromokratis has four hearts: two on its chest, one on its back, and one at the base of its tail. A heart has an AC of 22 and 100 hit points. It is immune to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks, and it is immune to all conditions. If it is forced to make a saving throw, treat its ability scores as 10 (+0). If it finishes a short or long rest, the carapace heals, any destroyed hearts regenerate, and the hearts are covered again. Tromokratis dies when all the hearts are destroyed.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If Tromokratis fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

MagicWeapons.description: Tromokratis's weapon attacks are magical.

SiegeMonster.description: Tromokratis deals double damage to objects and structures.

Spell-ResistantCarapace.name: Spell-Resistant Carapace

Pincer.description: mw 18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 20 (3d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 26). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained, and Tromokratis can't use this attack on anyone else.

TentacleGrasp.name: TentacleGrasp

If the target doesn't escape by the end of its next turn, Tromokratis throws the target up to 60 feet in a straight line. The target lands prone and takes 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 18 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 29 (3d12 + 10) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature grappled by Tromokratis, that creature is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has Cover||3||total cover against attacks and other effects outside Tromokratis, and it takes 42 (12d6) acid damage at the start of each of Tromokratis's turns. If Tromokratis takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, Tromokratis must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of Tromokratis. If Tromokratis dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

AversiontoFire.name: Aversion to Fire
AversiontoFire.description: If the oblex takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

SulfurousImpersonation.name: Sulfurous Impersonation
SulfurousImpersonation.description: As a bonus action, the oblex can extrude a piece of itself that assumes the appearance of one Medium or smaller creature whose memories it has stolen. This simulacrum appears, feels, and sounds exactly like the creature it impersonates, though it smells faintly of sulfur. The oblex can impersonate 1d4 + 1 different creatures, each one tethered to its body by a strand of slime that can extend up to 120 feet away. For all practical purposes, the simulacrum is the oblex, meaning that the oblex occupies its space and the simulacrum's space simultaneously. The slimy tether is immune to damage, but it is severed if there is no opening at least 1 inch wide between the oblex's main body and the simulacrum. The simulacrum disappears if the tether is severed.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The oblex makes one pseudopod attack and uses Eat Memories.

Pseudopod.name: Pseudopod
Pseudopod.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) psychic damage.

EatMemories.name: EatMemories
EatMemories.description:
The oblex targets one creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 18 (4d8) psychic damage and become memory drained until it finishes a short or long rest or until it benefits from the greater restoration or heal spell. Constructs, oozes, plants, and undead succeed on the save automatically.
While memory drained, the target must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from any ability check or attack roll it makes. Each time the target is memory drained beyond the first, the die size increases by one: the d4 becomes a d6, the d6 becomes a d8, and so on until the die becomes a d20, at which point the target becomes unconscious for 1 hour. The effect then ends.
When an oblex causes a target to become memory drained, the oblex learns all the languages the target knows and gains all its proficiencies, except for any saving throw proficiencies.
