MagicResistance.description: The archon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

OneBeing.name: One Being
OneBeing.description: Though it appears as a humanoid creature riding a mount, an archon is a single being. The "rider" can't be dismounted, and no other means can separate the two portions of the archon's being short of its death.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The archon makes two attacks: one with its sword and one with its claws.

Sword.name: Sword
Sword.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage.

Claws.name: Claws
Claws.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage.

DesignSpecialization.name: Design Specialization
DesignSpecialization.description: When the android is created, it gains one of six possible designs suited for its role (choose or roll a d6): 1, aerialist; 2, diplomat; 3, diver; 4, duelist; 5, medic; 6, sentry. This design determines certain traits in this stat block.

LightningOverload.name: Lightning Overload
LightningOverload.description: When the android takes lightning damage, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or have the stunned condition until the start of its next turn.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The android makes two Force Strike attacks.

ForceStrike.name: ForceStrike
ForceStrike.description: mw,rw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 40/120 ft., one target. on hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) force damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

FalseAppearance.name: False Appearance
FalseAppearance.description: If the barkburr is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the barkburr move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the barkburr is animate.

SpringingLeap.name: Springing Leap
SpringingLeap.description: With or without a running start, the barkburr's high jump is up to 15 feet, and its long jump is up to 30 feet. The barkburr's jumps can exceed its speed if its speed isn't 0.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The barkburr makes two Poison Barb attacks and uses Lignify if able.

PoisonBarb.name: PoisonBarb
PoisonBarb.description:
mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage, and the barkburr attaches to the target. While the barkburr is attached, it can't make Poison Barb attacks, and the target has the restrained condition as its body begins to transform into wood.
An attached barkburr can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement on its turn. A creature that can reach the barkburr, including the target, can use its action to detach the barkburr by making a successful DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check.

Lignify.name: Lignify
Lignify.description: The barkburr targets the creature it is attached to, and the target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the petrified condition until freed by the Greater Restoration spell or another effect, except it turns into a tree instead of stone. Any equipment the target is wearing or carrying is absorbed into the tree's bark.

Brave.name: Brave
Brave.description: The champion has advantage on saving throws against the frightened condition.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The champion makes two Lightning Mace attacks or three Handaxe attacks.

LightningMace.name: LightningMace
LightningMace.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) lightning damage.

Handaxe.name: Handaxe
Handaxe.description: mw,rw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The champion makes three Longsword attacks.

Longsword.name: Longsword
Longsword.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage if used with two hands.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The champion makes two Arcane Burst attacks or makes one Arcane Burst attack and uses Spellcasting.

ArcaneBurst.name: ArcaneBurst
ArcaneBurst.description: ms,rs 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) force damage.

LightningOverload.name: Lightning Overload
LightningOverload.description: When the robot takes lightning damage, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or have the stunned condition until the start of its next turn.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The robot makes two Tentacle attacks or three Laser Beam attacks.

Tentacle.name: Tentacle
Tentacle.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 16). While grappled, the target also has the restrained condition. The robot has two tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

LaserBeam.name: LaserBeam
LaserBeam.description: rw 5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 16 (4d6 + 2) radiant damage.

GrenadeLauncher{@recharge5}.name: GrenadeLauncher{@recharge5}
GrenadeLauncher{@recharge5}.description: The robot fires a grenade at a point it can see within 120 feet of itself. The grenade explodes in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point, creating one of the following effects (robot's choice):

ConcussionGrenade.name: ConcussionGrenade
ConcussionGrenade.description: Each creature in the sphere must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

SleepGrenade.name: SleepGrenade
SleepGrenade.description: Each creature in the sphere must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the unconscious condition for 1 hour. The condition ends on a creature early if the creature takes damage or if another creature uses an action to shake it awake.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The derro has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

SunlightSensitivity.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
SunlightSensitivity.description: While in sunlight, the derro has disadvantage on attack rolls.

ChaosBlast.name: ChaosBlast
ChaosBlast.description: ms,rs 3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (3d6) damage. Roll a d4 to determine the damage type: 1, acid; 2, cold; 3, fire; 4, lightning.

ForceBurst{@recharge4}.name: ForceBurst{@recharge4}
ForceBurst{@recharge4}.description: Raw arcane magic bursts out from the derro. Each creature within 10 feet of it must make a DC 11 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 7 (2d6) force damage and has the prone condition. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The derro has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

SunlightSensitivity.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
SunlightSensitivity.description: While in sunlight, the derro has disadvantage on attack rolls.

HookedSpear.name: HookedSpear
HookedSpear.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the derro can choose to deal no damage, and instead the target has the prone condition.

ThrowingHammer.name: ThrowingHammer
ThrowingHammer.description: mw,rw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

TreeShape(2/Day).name: Tree Shape
TreeShape(2/Day).description: Over the course of 1 minute, Derwyth can magically transform into a Huge or smaller tree and remain in that form for 24 hours or until she ends this transformation early (no action required). Her equipment melds into her new form. While in this form, her Armor Class is 16, she has the incapacitated condition, and she can't move or speak.

Quarterstaff.name: Quarterstaff
Quarterstaff.description: mw 2 to hit (4 to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If Drelnza fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

SpecialEquipment.name: Special Equipment
SpecialEquipment.description: Drelnza wields Heretic|QftIS.

SpiderClimb.name: Spider Climb
SpiderClimb.description: Drelnza can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

SunlightHypersensitivity.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
SunlightHypersensitivity.description: Drelnza takes 20 radiant damage when she starts her turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, she has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Drelnza makes one Bite attack and one Heretic attack.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Drelnza regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A Humanoid slain in this way and then buried rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Drelnza's control.

Heretic.name: Heretic
Heretic.description: mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft. one target. on hit: 40 (6d10 + 7) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or have the paralyzed condition until the start of Drelnza's next turn. Celestials have disadvantage on the saving throw.

Charm.name: Charm
Charm.description:
Drelnza targets one Humanoid she can see within 30 feet of herself. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or have the charmed condition. While charmed in this way, the target regards Drelnza as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. The target isn't under Drelnza's control, but it takes her requests and actions in the most favorable way.
Each time Drelnza or her allies do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Drelnza is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

Amphibious.name: Amphibious
Amphibious.description: The froghemoth can breathe air and water.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the froghemoth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

ShockSusceptibility.name: Shock Susceptibility
ShockSusceptibility.description: If the froghemoth takes lightning damage, it suffers two effects until the end of its next turn: its speed is halved, and it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The froghemoth makes one Bite attack and two Tentacle attacks, and it can use Tongue.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description:
mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) piercing damage, and the target is swallowed if it is a Medium or smaller creature. A swallowed creature has the blinded and restrained conditions, has Cover||3||total cover against attacks and other effects outside the froghemoth, and takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the froghemoth's turns.
The froghemoth's gullet can hold up to three creatures at a time. If the froghemoth takes 25 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the froghemoth must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which lands in a space within 10 feet of the froghemoth and has the prone condition. If the froghemoth dies, any swallowed creatures are no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting with the prone condition.

Tentacle.name: Tentacle
Tentacle.description: mw 12 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and the target has the grappled condition (escape DC 20). Until this grapple ends, the froghemoth can't use this tentacle on another target. The froghemoth has four tentacles.

Tongue.name: Tongue
Tongue.description: The froghemoth targets one Large or smaller creature that it can see within 25 feet of it. The target must make a DC 20 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target is pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the froghemoth.

Brave.name: Brave
Brave.description: The guardian has advantage on saving throws against the frightened condition.

LightningMace.name: LightningMace
LightningMace.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) lightning damage.

Handaxe.name: Handaxe
Handaxe.description: mw,rw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

HorridPlantVarieties.name: Horrid Plant Varieties
HorridPlantVarieties.description: A horrid plant comes in one of three varieties (choose or roll a d6): 1-2, dew drinker; 3-4, purple blossom; or 5-6, snapper saw. This form determines certain traits in this stat block.

FalseAppearance.name: False Appearance
FalseAppearance.description: If the horrid plant is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the horrid plant move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Nature) check to discern that the horrid plant isn't an ordinary plant.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The horrid plant makes two Tendril attacks.

Tendril.name: Tendril
Tendril.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 14), and the horrid plant can pull the target up to 25 feet closer to itself. Until the grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition, and the horrid plant can't use the same tendril on another target. The horrid plant has two tendrils.

Industrious.name: Industrious
Industrious.description: The leprechaun is proficient with all artisan's tools and adds double its proficiency bonus to ability checks made with them.

ReluctantRefusal.name: Reluctant Refusal
ReluctantRefusal.description: When a creature offers the leprechaun the chance to partake in merriment or revelry such as a song, a dance, or a good meal, the leprechaun must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the charmed condition for 24 hours. While charmed in this way, the leprechaun partakes of the offering, treats the creature as a trusted friend, and seeks to defend it from harm. The charmed condition ends if the creature or any of its allies damage the leprechaun, force the leprechaun to make a saving throw, or steal from the leprechaun.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The leprechaun makes two Cobbler's Hammer attacks and can use Spellcasting.

Cobbler'sHammer.name: Cobbler'sHammer
Cobbler'sHammer.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) force damage. If the target is a creature, its speed is halved until the start of the leprechaun's next turn.

GiftofLuck(1/Day).name: GiftofLuck(1/Day)
GiftofLuck(1/Day).description: The leprechaun touches a creature and magically gifts the target a measure of luck. The creature gains the leprechaun's Astonishing Luck reaction. The creature can use the reaction three times, after which this gift goes away. The leprechaun can revoke this gift from a creature at any time (no action required). A creature can benefit from only one leprechaun's Gift of Luck at a time.

ArcaneBurst.name: ArcaneBurst
ArcaneBurst.description: ms,rs 4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) force damage.

Overheat.name: Overheat
Overheat.description: When the maschin-i-bozorg is reduced to 0 hit points, its power source overloads, briefly superheating its outer shell. Each creature within 10 feet of the maschin-i-bozorg must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The maschin-i-bozorg makes two Poison Jab attacks.

PoisonJab.name: PoisonJab
PoisonJab.description: mw,rw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (4d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

SteamJet{@recharge5}.name: SteamJet{@recharge5}
SteamJet{@recharge5}.description: The maschin-i-bozorg emits scalding steam in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

DamageTransfer.name: Damage Transfer
DamageTransfer.description: While it is grappling a creature, the memory web takes only half the damage dealt to it, and the creature grappled by the web takes the other half.

FalseAppearance.name: False Appearance
FalseAppearance.description: If the memory web is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the memory web move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the memory web is animate.

MemoryFlood.name: Memory Flood
MemoryFlood.description: When the memory web is reduced to 0 hit points, it discharges any memories it consumed over the past 24 hours in a telepathic deluge. Hazy, dreamlike visions of these discharged memories lodge in the minds of creatures up to 120 feet from the memory web.

Ensnare.name: Ensnare
Ensnare.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. on hit: The target has the grappled condition (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition and takes 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. The memory web can grapple only one creature at a time.

DimensionallyBound.name: Dimensionally Bound
DimensionallyBound.description: Nafas can't leave the Infinite Staircase or be trapped within a container (such as an Iron Flask). Attempts to transport Nafas to another plane are wasted.

LastWish.name: Last Wish
LastWish.description:
When Nafas drops to 0 hit points, his body disintegrates into a whirl of multiversal dust that surrounds one creature responsible for his demise. That creature then hears Nafas's last wish: for the creature to take his place.
If the creature accepts, it is transformed into a noble djinni. The creature's game statistics are replaced by those of Nafas (including this trait), though it retains its name, alignment, and personality. The creature also inherits Nafas's palace and all it contains.
If the creature refuses, Nafas gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all his hit points and appearing in a random safe location on the Infinite Staircase.

LegendaryResistance(5/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(5/Day).description: If Nafas fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: Nafas has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

NobleGenie.name: Noble Genie
NobleGenie.description: Nafas doesn't suffer any of the penalties that normally follow casting the Wish spell to produce an effect other than duplicating another spell.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Nafas makes three Storm Shamshir attacks and uses Create Vortex.

StormShamshir.name: StormShamshir
StormShamshir.description: mw 13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) lightning or thunder damage (Nafas's choice).

CreateVortex.name: CreateVortex
CreateVortex.description:
A 10-foot-radius, 60-foot-tall cylinder of swirling cosmic dust forms on a point Nafas can see within 120 feet of him. The vortex lasts as long as Nafas maintains concentration (as if concentration||concentrating on a spell). When the vortex appears, each creature other than Nafas in the vortex's area must make a DC 22 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 36 (8d8) force damage and has the restrained condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only and moves to the nearest unoccupied space outside the vortex.
On subsequent turns, Nafas can use this action to move the vortex up to 60 feet. When the vortex enters a creature's space for the first time on a turn, the creature must make the same saving throw as when the vortex first appeared. Creatures restrained by the vortex move with it.
A creature restrained by the vortex, or another creature that can reach it, can use its action to make a DC 22 Strength check. On a successful check, the restrained creature is no longer restrained and moves to the nearest unoccupied space outside the vortex.

LegendaryResistance(2/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(2/Day).description: If Nafik fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: Nafik has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description: When he is destroyed, Nafik gains a new body in 24 hours if his heart is intact, regaining all his hit points. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of Nafik's heart.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Nafik can use his Dreadful Glare and makes one Rotting Fist or Unholy Beam attack.

RottingFist.name: RottingFist
RottingFist.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with mummy rot. The cursed target can't regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) for every 24 hours that elapse. If the curse reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies and its body turns to dust. The curse lasts until removed by the Remove Curse spell or other magic.

UnholyBeam.name: UnholyBeam
UnholyBeam.description: rs 6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 28 (8d6) necrotic damage, and the next attack roll made against this target before the end of Nafik's next turn has advantage.

DreadfulGlare.name: DreadfulGlare
DreadfulGlare.description: Nafik targets one creature he can see within 60 feet of himself. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition until the end of Nafik's next turn. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to Nafik's Dreadful Glare for the next 24 hours.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: Sion has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects if he is in dim light or darkness.

Shadesight.name: Shadesight
Shadesight.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede Sion's darkvision.

ShadowyDemise.name: Shadowy Demise
ShadowyDemise.description: If Sion dies, his body melts into shadow, leaving behind only equipment he was wearing or carrying.

SunlightWeakness.name: Sunlight Weakness
SunlightWeakness.description: While in sunlight, Sion has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Sion makes one Shadow Sword attack and uses Affix Shadow or Spellcasting.

ShadowSword.name: ShadowSword
ShadowSword.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) necrotic damage.

AffixShadow.name: AffixShadow
AffixShadow.description: Sion targets a creature within 60 feet of himself that he can see. That target must make a DC 13 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the grappled condition (escape DC 13) as its shadow wraps around it. Once the target escapes the grapple, its shadow returns to normal.

AversiontoFire.name: Aversion to Fire
AversiontoFire.description: If the swarm takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

IncessantGibberish.name: Incessant Gibberish
IncessantGibberish.description: Any non-gibberling that is within 60 feet of the swarm and doesn't have the deafened condition has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration on spells and similar effects.

Swarm.name: Swarm
Swarm.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough to accommodate a Small gibberling. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The swarm makes two Gnashing Teeth attacks.

GnashingTeeth.name: GnashingTeeth
GnashingTeeth.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. on hit: 14 (4d4 + 4) piercing damage, or 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

FeyRebirth.name: Fey Rebirth
FeyRebirth.description: If the Gardener dies in the Eternal Garden, they revive with all their hit points 1d4 days later in a safe location within the garden.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the Gardener fails a saving throw, they can choose to succeed instead.

UnfetteredSteps.name: Unfettered Steps
UnfetteredSteps.description: The Gardener is unaffected by difficult terrain.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The Gardener makes two Vine attacks and can use Breath of Tranquility if available.

Vine.name: Vine
Vine.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) psychic damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, the vine wraps around the target, and the target has the grappled condition (escape DC 17). The vine vanishes when the target is no longer grappled, or when the Gardener wills it to (no action required). A creature reduced to 0 hit points by the vine has the unconscious condition but is stable instead of dying.

BreathofTranquility{@recharge5}.name: BreathofTranquility{@recharge5}
BreathofTranquility{@recharge5}.description: The Gardener exhales soporific vapor in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition. A poisoned creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a failed save, it has the unconscious condition, and on a successful save, the effect ends on it. An unconscious creature is no longer poisoned and remains unconscious for 1 hour, until it takes damage, or until a creature uses an action to shake it awake.

UnarmoredDefense.name: Unarmored Defense
UnarmoredDefense.description: While the tower hand is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The tower hand makes two Unarmed Strike attacks, two Dart attacks, or one of each.

UnarmedStrike.name: UnarmedStrike
UnarmedStrike.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

Dart.name: Dart
Dart.description: rw 4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The tower sage makes two Arcane Burst attacks and can use Starry Radiance if available.

ArcaneBurst.name: ArcaneBurst
ArcaneBurst.description: ms,rs 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) radiant damage.

StarryRadiance{@recharge5}.name: StarryRadiance{@recharge5}
StarryRadiance{@recharge5}.description: Dazzling light bursts from the tower sage's fingertips in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or have the blinded condition until the end of the tower sage's next turn.

PlantCamouflage.name: Plant Camouflage
PlantCamouflage.description: The vegepygmy has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring vegetation.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: The vegepygmy regains 7 hit points at the start of its turn. If it takes cold, fire, or necrotic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vegepygmy's next turn. The vegepygmy dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The vegepygmy makes two Claw attacks.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) slashing damage.

ToxicMold(2/Day).name: ToxicMold(2/Day)
ToxicMold(2/Day).description:
The vegepygmy targets a creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. If the target isn't a vegepygmy, it must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 13 (3d8) poison damage and has the blinded and deafened conditions for 1 minute as it becomes covered in a thick layer of mold. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.
The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

PlantCamouflage.name: Plant Camouflage
PlantCamouflage.description: The vegepygmy has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring vegetation.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: The vegepygmy regains 3 hit points at the start of its turn. If it takes cold, fire, or necrotic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vegepygmy's next turn. The vegepygmy dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

Sling.name: Sling
Sling.description: rw 4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

PackTactics.name: Pack Tactics
PackTactics.description: The vegepygmy has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the vegepygmy's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

PlantCamouflage.name: Plant Camouflage
PlantCamouflage.description: The vegepygmy has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring vegetation.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: The vegepygmy regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn. If it takes cold, fire, or necrotic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vegepygmy's next turn. The vegepygmy dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

ThornyBody.name: Thorny Body
ThornyBody.description: At the start of its turn, the vegepygmy deals 2 (1d4) piercing damage to any creature grappling it.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

Spear.name: Spear
Spear.description: mw,rw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

FalseAppearance.name: False Appearance
FalseAppearance.description: If the wolf-in-sheep's-clothing is motionless (except for its lure) at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the wolf-in-sheep's-clothing move or act (except for the lure), that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the wolf-in-sheep's-clothing is animate.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The wolf-in-sheep's-clothing makes one Bite attack and two Root Tentacle attacks.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

RootTentacle.name: RootTentacle
RootTentacle.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 16). While grappled in this way, the target has the restrained condition, and at the start of each of the wolf-in-sheep's-clothing's turns, the wolf-in-sheep's-clothing can pull the target up to 10 feet toward itself (no action required). The wolf-in-sheep's-clothing has four root tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

LightningOverload.name: Lightning Overload
LightningOverload.description: When the robot takes lightning damage, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or have the stunned condition until the start of its next turn.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The robot makes two Cargo Tentacle attacks.

CargoTentacle.name: CargoTentacle
CargoTentacle.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 15). The robot has two cargo tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

TractorBeam.name: TractorBeam
TractorBeam.description: The robot casts Telekinesis, targeting only creatures with the incapacitated condition or objects. It requires no spell components and uses Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

LegendaryResistance(4/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(4/Day).description: If Zargon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: Zargon regains 20 hit points at the start of each of its turns. If Zargon takes cold or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of Zargon's next turn. Zargon dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

ShroudedBeing.name: Shrouded Being
ShroudedBeing.description: Zargon can't be targeted by divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

SlimyDemise.name: Slimy Demise
SlimyDemise.description: When Zargon dies, its body dissolves into foul slime, leaving only its horn behind. Zargon re-forms in 1d10 days, regrowing from the horn. The horn is immune to all damage and can be destroyed only by submerging it in a cleansing waterfall on one of the Upper Planes for 101 days. While the horn is submerged in this way, Zargon doesn't re-form, and the horn slowly dissolves, sending corrupting slime downriver that permanently fouls the water for 10 miles from the place where the horn dissolved. The fouled water is unfit to drink, chokes aquatic wildlife, and withers plants.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Zargon makes two Barbed Tentacle attacks, one Bite attack, and one Gore attack.

BarbedTentacle.name: BarbedTentacle
BarbedTentacle.description: mw 12 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 20), and Zargon can pull the creature up to 20 feet straight toward itself. Zargon has six tentacles, each of which can grapple one creature. Zargon can move at its full speed while dragging creatures it is grappling.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

Gore.name: Gore
Gore.description: mw 12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) force damage, and a 10-foot-radius invisible sphere of antimagic, like that created by an Antimagic Field spell, surrounds the target. The sphere is centered on the target, moves with the target, and lasts until the end of Zargon's next turn.

SlimeWave{@recharge5}.name: SlimeWave{@recharge5}
SlimeWave{@recharge5}.description:
Zargon spews slime in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area that isn't an Aberration or Ooze must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 38 (7d10) acid damage and has the poisoned condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
A creature reduced to 0 hit points by the acid damage dies and dissolves into a puddle of slime that rises as a gibbering mouther at the start of Zargon's next turn. The creature obeys Zargon's commands and takes its turn immediately after Zargon's. Only a Wish spell can reverse this transformation and restore the creature to life.

KeenSightandSmell.name: Keen Sight and Smell
KeenSightandSmell.description: Billy Beaver has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

Beak.name: Beak
Beak.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

SurpriseAttack.name: Surprise Attack
SurpriseAttack.description: If Buster the Bear surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage from the attack.

Bashin'Banjo.name: Bashin'Banjo
Bashin'Banjo.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage.

Claws.name: Claws
Claws.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

FalseAppearance.name: False Appearance
FalseAppearance.description: While the lycanthropickle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a pickle.

Aggressive.name: Aggressive
Aggressive.description: As a bonus action, Piggy Wiggle Butt can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

ClayJug.name: ClayJug
ClayJug.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

WebbyHands.name: WebbyHands
WebbyHands.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

DragonFanatic.name: Dragon Fanatic
DragonFanatic.description: The dragonfang has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. While the dragonfang can see a dragon or higher-ranking Cult of the Dragon cultist friendly to it, the dragonfang ignores the effects of being charmed or frightened.

FanaticAdvantage.name: Fanatic Advantage
FanaticAdvantage.description: Once per turn, if the dragonfang makes a weapon attack with advantage on the attack roll and hits, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage.

LimitedFlight.name: Limited Flight
LimitedFlight.description: The dragonfang can use a bonus action to gain a flying speed of 30 feet until the end of its turn.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The Dragonfang attacks twice with its shortsword.

Shortsword.name: Shortsword
Shortsword.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) damage of the type to which the dragonfang has resistance.

OrbofDragon'sBreath(2/Day).name: OrbofDragon'sBreath(2/Day)
OrbofDragon'sBreath(2/Day).description: rs 5 to hit, range 50 ft., one target. on hit: 22 (5d8) damage of the type to which the dragonfang has damage resistance.

DragonFanatic.name: Dragon Fanatic
DragonFanatic.description: The dragonsoul has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. While the dragonsoul can see a dragon or higher-ranking Cult of the Dragon cultist friendly to it, the dragonsoul ignores the effects of being charmed or frightened.

FanaticAdvantage.name: Fanatic Advantage
FanaticAdvantage.description: Once per turn, if the dragonsoul makes a weapon attack with advantage on the attack roll and hits, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage.

LimitedFlight.name: Limited Flight
LimitedFlight.description: The dragonsoul can use a bonus action to gain a flying speed of 30 feet until the end of its turn.

PackTactics.name: Pack Tactics
PackTactics.description: The dragonsoul has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the dragonclaw's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The Dragonsoul attacks twice with its shortsword.

Shortsword.name: Shortsword
Shortsword.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) damage of the type to which the dragonsoul has resistance.

OrbofDragon'sBreath(3/Day).name: OrbofDragon'sBreath(3/Day)
OrbofDragon'sBreath(3/Day).description: rs 7 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. on hit: 27 (6d8) damage of the type to which the dragonsoul has damage resistance.

兩棲.name: 兩棲
兩棲.description: The toad can breathe air or water.

ColdAura.name: Cold Aura
ColdAura.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the toad takes 3 (1d6) cold damage.

StandingLeap.name: Standing Leap
StandingLeap.description: The toad's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d8) cold damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature it is grappled (escape DC 11). Until this grapple ends, the toad can't bite another target.

SunlightSensitivity.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
SunlightSensitivity.description: While in sunlight, Naergoth has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

bludgeoningfromnonmagicalattacksthataren.name: bludgeoning from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

slashingfromnonmagicalattacksthataren'ts.name: slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Naergoth makes three attacks, either with his longsword or longbow. He can use Life Drain in place of one longsword attack.

LifeDrain.name: LifeDrain
LifeDrain.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 20 (5d6 + 3) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

Longsword.name: Longsword
Longsword.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage, or 10 (1d10 + 5) if used with two hands, plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

Longbow.name: Longbow
Longbow.description: rw 5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

DraconicMajesty.name: Draconic Majesty
DraconicMajesty.description: Neronvain adds his Charisma bonus to his AC (included).

FeyAncestry.name: Fey Ancestry
FeyAncestry.description: Magic can't put Neronvain to sleep.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Neronvain makes two attacks, either with his shortsword or Eldritch Arrow.

Shortsword.name: Shortsword
Shortsword.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) poison damage.

EldritchArrow.name: EldritchArrow
EldritchArrow.description: rs 7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (2d10) force damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.

PoisonousCloud(2/Day).name: PoisonousCloud(2/Day)
PoisonousCloud(2/Day).description: Poison gas fills a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point Neronvain can see within 50 feet of him. The gas spreads around corners and remains until the start of Neronvain's next turn. Each creature that starts its turn in the gas must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

SpecialEquipment.name: Special Equipment
SpecialEquipment.description: Severin has the Mask of the Dragon Queen|rot.

DraconicMajesty.name: Draconic Majesty
DraconicMajesty.description: Severin adds his Charisma bonus to his AC (included).

IgniteEnemy.name: Ignite Enemy
IgniteEnemy.description: If Severin deals fire damage to a creature while wearing the Mask of the Dragon Queen, the target catches fire. At the start of each of its turns, the burning target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. A creature within reach of the fire can use an action to extinguish it.

LegendaryResistance(5/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(5/Day).description: While wearing the Mask of the Dragon Queen, if Severin fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

While.name: While
While.value: wearing the Mask of the Dragon Queen: darkvision 60 ft.

BurningTouch.name: BurningTouch
BurningTouch.description: ms 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 18 (4d8) fire damage.

FlamingOrb.name: FlamingOrb
FlamingOrb.description: rs 5 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. on hit: 40 (9d8) fire damage.

ScorchingBurst.name: ScorchingBurst
ScorchingBurst.description: Severin chooses a point he can see within 60 feet of him. Each creature within 5 feet of that point must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Discorporation.name: Discorporation
Discorporation.description: When Tiamat drops to 0 hit points or dies, her body is destroyed but her essence travels back to her domain in the Nine Hells, and she is unable to take physical form for a time.

LegendaryResistance(5/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(5/Day).description: If Tiamat fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

LimitedMagicImmunity.name: Limited Magic Immunity
LimitedMagicImmunity.description: Unless she wishes to be affected, Tiamat is immune to spells of 6th level or lower. She has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

MagicWeapons.name: Magic Weapons
MagicWeapons.description: Tiamat's weapon attacks are magical.

MultipleHeads.name: Multiple Heads
MultipleHeads.description: Tiamat can take one reaction per turn, rather than only one per round. She also has advantage on saving throws against being knocked unconscious. If she fails a saving throw against an effect that would stun a creature, one of her unspent legendary actions is spent.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: Tiamat regains 30 hit points at the start of her turn.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Tiamat can use her Frightful Presence. She then makes three attacks: two with her claws and one with her tail.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 19 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 24 (4d6 + 10) slashing damage.

Tail.name: Tail
Tail.description: mw 19 to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. on hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) piercing damage.

FrightfulPresence.name: FrightfulPresence
FrightfulPresence.description: Each creature of Tiamat's choice that is within 240 feet of Tiamat and aware of her must succeed on a DC 26 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Tiamat's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

DarkOne'sOwnLuck(RechargesafteraShortorL.name: Dark One's Own Luck (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
DarkOne'sOwnLuck(RechargesafteraShortorL.description: When the warlock makes an ability check or saving throw, it can add a d10 to the roll. It can do this after the roll is made but before any of the roll's effects occur.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: Dirt-Under-Nails regains 10 hit points at the start of his turn if he is in contact with the ground. If Dirt-Under-Nails takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Dirt-Under-Nails dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

SharedSenses.name: Shared Senses
SharedSenses.description: Dirt-Under-Nails can see and hear what any plant within 120 ft can see and hear. In addition, Dirt-Under- Nails can communicate telepathically with any plant within this range.

SpecialEquipment(+2RodofthePactKeeper).name: Special Equipment (+2 Rod of the Pact Keeper)
SpecialEquipment(+2RodofthePactKeeper).description: While holding this +2 Rod of the Pact Keeper||rod, Dirt-Under-Nails gains a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and to the saving throw DCs of his warlock spells (included in modifications, below). In addition, he can regain 1 warlock spell slot as an action while holding the rod. He can't use this property again until he finishes a long rest.

TreeStride.name: Tree Stride
TreeStride.description: Once on each of its turns, Dirt-Under-Nails can use 10 feet of his movement to step magically into one copse of mushrooms within 5 feet of him and emerge from a second copse of mushrooms within 60 feet of it, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second copse. Both copses of mushrooms must be Large or bigger. Dirt-Under-Nails doesn't need to be able to see the second copse to use this ability.

bludgeoningfromnonmagicalattacksthataren.name: bludgeoning from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

piercingfromnonmagicalattacksthataren'ts.name: piercing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

slashingfromnonmagicalattacksthataren'ts.name: slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

Mace.name: Mace
Mace.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.

MagicClub.name: Magic Club
MagicClub.description: In the rotter's hand, its club is magical and deals 7 (3d4) extra damage (included in its attacks).

PlantCamouflage.name: Plant Camouflage
PlantCamouflage.description: The rotter has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in terrain with ample obscuring plant life.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: The rotter regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it is in contact with the ground. If the rotter takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the rotter's next turn. The rotter dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

SharedSenses.name: Shared Senses
SharedSenses.description: The rotter can see and hear what any plant within 120 ft can see and hear. In addition, the rotter can communicate telepathically with any plant within this range.

TreeStride.name: Tree Stride
TreeStride.description: Once on each of its turns, the rotter can use 10 feet of its movement to step magically into one copse of mushrooms within 5 feet of it and emerge from a second copse of mushrooms within 60 feet of it, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second copse. Both copses of mushrooms must be Large or bigger. The rotter doesn't need to be able to see the second copse to use this ability.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The rotter makes two attacks with its club.

Club.name: Club
Club.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (4d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

EnigmaticMind.name: Enigmatic Mind
EnigmaticMind.description: The archaic's mind can't be read, creatures can communicate telepathically with the archaic only if it allows, and magic can't determine whether the archaic is lying.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the archaic fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The archaic doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The archaic makes two Force Strike attacks. It can also use Gravity Shift, if available.

ForceStrike.name: ForceStrike
ForceStrike.description: ms,rs 14 to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) force damage, and the target is pulled up to 10 feet toward the archaic or pushed 10 feet away from it, as the archaic chooses.

GravityShift{@recharge5}.name: GravityShift{@recharge5}
GravityShift{@recharge5}.description: The archaic reverses gravity for one creature it can see within 100 feet of itself. The creature must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or fall 100 feet upward. If the falling creature encounters a solid object (such as a ceiling) in this fall, it strikes the object just as it would during a downward fall. If the creature reaches the top of the area without striking anything, it hovers there until the start of the archaic's next turn, at which time gravity returns to normal and the creature falls.

Teleport.name: Teleport
Teleport.description: The archaic teleports to an unoccupied space that it can see within 120 feet of itself.

DeathBurst.name: Death Burst
DeathBurst.description: When the elemental dies, it explodes in a burst of colored light. Each creature within 5 feet of the elemental must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. A blinded creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

JoyfulFlare.name: JoyfulFlare
JoyfulFlare.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) fire damage.

MelancholicBolt.name: MelancholicBolt
MelancholicBolt.description: rw 3 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) cold damage.

CaptivatingArtistry(1/Day).name: CaptivatingArtistry(1/Day)
CaptivatingArtistry(1/Day).description: The elemental targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute. The charmed target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If Beledros fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: Beledros doesn't require air, food, or drink.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Beledros makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (1d10 + 9) piercing damage plus 6 (1d12) necrotic damage.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 12 (1d6 + 9) slashing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is knocked prone.

DecayingBreath{@recharge5}.name: DecayingBreath{@recharge5}
DecayingBreath{@recharge5}.description: Beledros exhales decaying energy in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 23 Constitution saving throw, taking 39 (6d12) necrotic damage and 39 (6d12) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that takes damage from the breath can't regain hit points until the start of Beledros's next turn.

MiasmalFlow.name: MiasmalFlow
MiasmalFlow.description: Beledros becomes a swirling cloud of green mist and can move up to half her flying speed without provoking opportunity attacks, then resumes her true form. During this movement, she can move through creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain||3. If she moves through a creature, it must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned until the end of its next turn. If Beledros ends this move inside an object, she takes 5 (1d10) force damage and is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space.

FungalFortitude.name: Fungal Fortitude
FungalFortitude.description: If damage reduces the trudge to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the trudge drops to 1 hit point instead.

Tusk.name: Tusk
Tusk.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The archivist has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The archivist makes two Grasping Limb attacks.

GraspingLimb.name: GraspingLimb
GraspingLimb.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). The archivist can have no more than two targets grappled at a time.

PactofPain.name: Pact of Pain
PactofPain.description:
Using a 10-minute ritual, the daemogoth can forge a magical bond with a willing creature it touches throughout the ritual. The creature becomes bound by the pact until it dies, the daemogoth dies, or the pact is broken by any effect that can remove a curse.
The daemogoth chooses one spell from the necromancy or enchantment school that is 3rd level or lower|spells|level=0;1;2;3|school=N;E. The bound creature can cast that spell using this pact, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability. When it casts the spell, the creature takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage, which can't break the creature's concentration on a spell. Once the bound creature casts the spell in this way, it can't do so again until it finishes a long rest.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The daemogoth makes three Agonizing Burst attacks. It can use Terrify, if available, in place of one of the attacks.

AgonizingBurst.name: AgonizingBurst
AgonizingBurst.description: ms,rs 9 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (2d10) force damage. If the target is a creature, the daemogoth regains 5 hit points.

Terrify{@recharge4}.name: Terrify{@recharge4}
Terrify{@recharge4}.description: The daemogoth targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 33 (6d10) psychic damage and is frightened of the daemogoth until the end of the daemogoth's next turn, and the daemogoth regains 5 hit points. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't frightened, and the daemogoth doesn't heal.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the titan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

PactofSuffering.name: Pact of Suffering
PactofSuffering.description:
Using a 10-minute long ritual, the titan can forge a magical bond with a willing creature it touches throughout the ritual. The creature becomes bound by the pact until it dies, the titan dies, or the pact is broken by a wish spell.
The titan chooses one spell from the necromancy or enchantment school that is 8th level or lower|spells|level=0;1;2;3;4;5;6;7;8|school=N;E. The bound creature can cast that spell using this pact, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability. When it casts the spell, the creature takes 21 (6d6) psychic damage, which can't break the creature's concentration on a spell. Once the bound creature casts the spell in this way, it can't do so again until it finishes a long rest.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack

AgonizingBurst.name: AgonizingBurst
AgonizingBurst.description: ms,rs 12 to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) force damage. If the target is a creature, the titan regains 5 hit points.

Teleport.name: Teleport
Teleport.description: The titan teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 120 feet of itself.

ExcitedtoBeHere.name: Excited to Be Here
ExcitedtoBeHere.description: The student has advantage on initiative rolls.

MagicFlare.name: MagicFlare
MagicFlare.description: ms,rs 3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d12 + 1) force damage.

RelativeDensity.name: Relative Density
RelativeDensity.description: The fractal can move through creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain||3. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

QuantumStrike.name: QuantumStrike
QuantumStrike.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) force damage, or 6 (2d4 + 1) force damage if the fractal is Medium or bigger.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If Galazeth fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Galazeth makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (1d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) lightning damage.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (1d6 + 8) slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is knocked prone.

DancingElementsBreath{@recharge5}.name: DancingElementsBreath{@recharge5}
DancingElementsBreath{@recharge5}.description: Galazeth exhales a blast of flames and ice in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw, gaining no benefit from cover (other than Cover||3||total cover) and taking 38 (7d10) fire damage and 38 (7d10) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

FalseAppearance.name: False Appearance
FalseAppearance.description: If the groff is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the groff move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the groff isn't an ordinary moss-covered bog patch.

HoldBreath.name: Hold Breath
HoldBreath.description: The groff can hold its breath for up to 1 hour.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The groff makes one Bite attack and one Swamp Claw attack.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

SwampClaw.name: SwampClaw
SwampClaw.description:
mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or become engulfed by the groff. While engulfed, the target can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 10 (3d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. When the groff moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The groff can have only one target engulfed at a time.
An engulfed target can repeat the saving throw at the end of its turns. On a success, the target escapes and enters the nearest unoccupied space.

Amorphous.name: Amorphous
Amorphous.description: The inkling can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

Blot.name: Blot
Blot.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) psychic damage.

InkSpray(1/Day).name: InkSpray(1/Day)
InkSpray(1/Day).description: The inkling sprays viscous ink at one creature within 15 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the inkling's next turn.

ScrollBash.name: ScrollBash
ScrollBash.description: ms 4 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) thunder damage.

ReducetoMemory{@recharge}.name: ReducetoMemory{@recharge}
ReducetoMemory{@recharge}.description: Thundering golden energy erupts around a creature the apprentice can see within 90 feet of it. The creature must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 33 (6d10) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A Construct has disadvantage on the saving throw.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The pledgemage makes two Scroll Bash attacks.

ScrollBash.name: ScrollBash
ScrollBash.description: ms 5 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) thunder damage.

ReducetoMemory{@recharge5}.name: ReducetoMemory{@recharge5}
ReducetoMemory{@recharge5}.description: Thundering golden energy erupts around a creature the pledgemage can see within 90 feet of it. The creature must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A Construct has disadvantage on the saving throw.

VoicefromthePast(1/Day).name: Voice from the Past
VoicefromthePast(1/Day).description: The professor can cast the contact other plane spell to contact a long-dead spirit, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The professor makes two Spectral Scroll attacks. It can also use Weight of History, if available.

SpectralScroll.name: SpectralScroll
SpectralScroll.description: ms 7 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. on hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) force damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

WeightofHistory{@recharge5}.name: WeightofHistory{@recharge5}
WeightofHistory{@recharge5}.description: The professor magically compresses time around up to six creatures of its choice that it can see within 30 feet of itself. Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be restrained for 1 minute, but the restrained target's speed is halved instead of being reduced to 0. At the start of each of its turns, the restrained target takes 4 (1d8) force damage. A restrained target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

VoicefromthePast(1/Day).name: Voice from the Past
VoicefromthePast(1/Day).description: The professor can cast the contact other plane spell to contact a long-dead spirit, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The professor makes two Repelling Burst attacks. It can also use Force Barrier, if available.

RepellingBurst.name: RepellingBurst
RepellingBurst.description: ms 7 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) force damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet directly away from the professor and become restrained until the start of professor's next turn.

ForceBarrier{@recharge5}.name: ForceBarrier{@recharge5}
ForceBarrier{@recharge5}.description: The professor magically creates a wall of translucent, golden force within 90 feet of itself. The wall lasts for 1 minute or until the professor uses this action again. The barrier can be a vertical or horizontal plane up to 30 feet on a side or a 10-foot-radius hemispherical dome with a floor. The wall provides Cover||3||total cover. It has AC 17, 30 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.

MagicSense.name: Magic Sense
MagicSense.description: The hunter knows the location of every spellcaster, active spell, and magic item within 120 feet of itself.

SpiderClimb(HunterFormOnly).name: Spider Climb (Hunter Form Only)
SpiderClimb(HunterFormOnly).description: The hunter can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Multiattack(HunterFormOnly).name: Multiattack(HunterFormOnly)
Multiattack(HunterFormOnly).description: The hunter makes two Claw attacks.

Claw(HunterFormOnly).name: Claw(HunterFormOnly)
Claw(HunterFormOnly).description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage.

Tail.name: Tail
Tail.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the hunter can't make a Tail attack against another target.

MageTracker(SentryFormOnly).name: MageTracker(SentryFormOnly)
MageTracker(SentryFormOnly).description:
The hunter emits a pulse of energy that helps it better locate its magical quarry. Each creature within 120 feet of the hunter that has the ability to cast spells must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be mystically marked by the hunter for 1 hour.
While marked, a creature can't become hidden from the hunter and gains no benefit from the invisible condition against the hunter. Additionally, while a marked creature is on the same plane of existence as the hunter, the hunter always knows the distance and direction to the creature.

BloodAegis.name: Blood Aegis
BloodAegis.description: The AC of Murgaxor includes his Constitution modifier while he isn't wearing armor or wielding a shield.

OriqMask.name: Oriq Mask
OriqMask.description: Murgaxor wears an Oriq mask. While wearing the mask, Murgaxor can't be targeted by any divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors, and he adds double his proficiency bonus to Charisma (Deception) checks (included above).

SanguineSense.name: Sanguine Sense
SanguineSense.description: While Murgaxor isn't blinded, he can see any creature that isn't an Undead or a Construct within 60 feet of himself, even through Cover||3||total cover, heavily obscured areas, invisibility, or any other phenomena that would prevent sight.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Murgaxor makes two Blood Lash attacks.

BloodLash.name: BloodLash
BloodLash.description: ms 9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it can't regain hit points until the start of Murgaxor's next turn.

BloodBoil{@recharge4}.name: BloodBoil{@recharge4}
BloodBoil{@recharge4}.description: Murgaxor chooses a point within 150 feet of himself, and a 20-foot radius sphere centered on that point fills with a burst of searing, blood-red mist. Each creature of Murgaxor's choice that he can see in that area must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 38 (7d10) necrotic damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't incapacitated. A creature dies if reduced to 0 hit points by this necrotic damage.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the Oracle fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The Oracle makes two Magic Flare attacks. She can also use Paradoxy, if available.

MagicFlare.name: MagicFlare
MagicFlare.description: ms,rs 10 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. on hit: 24 (3d12 + 5) force damage.

Paradoxy{@recharge4}.name: Paradoxy{@recharge4}
Paradoxy{@recharge4}.description: Momentary warps in reality appear at three different points the Oracle can see within 120 feet of her. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on each point must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 33 (6d10) force damage and is pulled up to 15 feet in a straight line toward the center of the sphere. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't pulled. A creature caught in the area of multiple warps is affected by only one, which the Oracle chooses.

Teleport.name: Teleport
Teleport.description: The Oracle teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space she can see within 60 feet of herself.

BloodAegis.name: Blood Aegis
BloodAegis.description: The AC of the blood mage includes its Constitution modifier while it isn't wearing armor or wielding a shield.

SanguineSense.name: Sanguine Sense

BloodLash.name: BloodLash
BloodLash.description: ms 9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it can't regain hit points until the start of the blood mage's next turn.

BloodBoil{@recharge4}.name: BloodBoil{@recharge4}
BloodBoil{@recharge4}.description: The blood mage chooses a point within 150 feet of itself, and a 20-foot radius sphere centered on that point fills with a burst of searing, blood-red mist.
