A creature dies if reduced to 0 hit points by this necrotic damage.

MisdirectingDefense.name: Misdirecting Defense
MisdirectingDefense.description: The AC of the recruiter includes its Charisma modifier while it isn't wearing armor or wielding a shield.

OriqMask.name: Oriq Mask
OriqMask.description: The recruiter wears an Oriq mask. While wearing the mask, the recruiter can't be targeted by any divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors, and it adds double its proficiency bonus to Charisma (Deception) checks (included above).

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The recruiter makes two Psychic Knife attacks. It can use Spellcasting in place of one of the attacks.

PsychicKnife.name: PsychicKnife
PsychicKnife.description: ms,rs 6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one creature. on hit: 21 (5d6 + 4) psychic damage.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: The pest regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point. If it takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the pest's next turn.

SpinyHide.name: Spiny Hide
SpinyHide.description: At the start of each of its turns, the pest deals 2 (1d4) piercing damage to any creature grappling it or that it is grappling.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

ElementalStrike.name: ElementalStrike
ElementalStrike.description: ms,rs 4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (3d6) fire or cold damage (the apprentice's choice).

Evasion.name: Evasion
Evasion.description: If the pledgemage is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the pledgemage instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw and only half damage if it fails, provided it isn't incapacitated.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The pledgemage makes two Elemental Strike attacks.

ElementalStrike.name: ElementalStrike
ElementalStrike.description: ms,rs 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. on hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) fire or cold damage (the pledgemage's choice).

Showstopper(1/Day).name: Showstopper(1/Day)
Showstopper(1/Day).description: The pledgemage shines with elemental magic, targeting one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 28 (8d6) fire or cold damage (the pledgemage's choice) and is stunned until the start of the pledgemage's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't stunned.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The professor makes three Cinder Strike attacks.

CinderStrike.name: CinderStrike
CinderStrike.description: ms 7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) fire damage.

LightningFlourish{@recharge}.name: LightningFlourish{@recharge}
LightningFlourish{@recharge}.description: The professor unleashes arcs of magical lightning at up to two creatures it can see within 60 feet of itself. Each target must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

WaterWalking.name: Water Walking
WaterWalking.description: The professor can walk across water and other liquids as if they were solid ground.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The professor makes three Tidal Strike attacks.

TidalStrike.name: TidalStrike
TidalStrike.description: ms,rs 7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) cold damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The apprentice makes two Exponential Lash attacks.

ExponentialLash.name: ExponentialLash
ExponentialLash.description: ms,rs 4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) force damage, and the apprentice can cause one creature it can see within 30 feet of the target to take 9 (2d6 + 2) force damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The pledgemage makes two Exponential Lash attacks.

ExponentialLash.name: ExponentialLash
ExponentialLash.description: ms,rs 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) force damage, and the pledgemage can cause one creature it can see within 30 feet of the target to take 10 (2d6 + 3) force damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The professor makes two Spatial Blade attacks.

SpatialBlade.name: SpatialBlade
SpatialBlade.description: ms,rs 7 to hit (the target can't benefit from cover less than Cover||3||total cover), reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) force damage, or 22 (4d8 + 4) force damage if the professor is Large or larger, and the professor can push the target horizontally up to 10 feet away.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The professor makes two Heuristic Lance attacks. It can also use Overriding Theorem, if available.

HeuristicLance.name: HeuristicLance
HeuristicLance.description: ms,rs 7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one creature. on hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) psychic damage, and the target is poisoned until the end of its next turn.

OverridingTheorem{@recharge4}.name: OverridingTheorem{@recharge4}
OverridingTheorem{@recharge4}.description: The professor magically influences the mind of up to two creatures it can see within 60 feet of itself. Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or become charmed by the professor until the start of the professor's next turn. The charmed creature must immediately use its reaction, if available, to move up its speed toward another creature of the professor's choice and make one melee attack against that other creature.

Claws.name: Claws
Claws.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). The relic sloth can grapple no more than two targets at a time.

FireAbsorption.name: Fire Absorption
FireAbsorption.description: Whenever the ruin grinder is subjected to fire damage, it regains a number of hit points equal to half the fire damage dealt.

SiegeMonster.name: Siege Monster
SiegeMonster.description: The ruin grinder deals double damage to objects and structures.

Tunneler.name: Tunneler
Tunneler.description: The ruin grinder can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The ruin grinder makes two Excavator attacks.

Excavator.name: Excavator
Excavator.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) force damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked prone.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 3 (1d3 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If Shadrix fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Shadrix makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 12 (1d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) radiant damage.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (1d6 + 7) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it is wracked with despair and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

IlluminatingShadowBreath{@recharge5}.name: IlluminatingShadowBreath{@recharge5}
IlluminatingShadowBreath{@recharge5}.description: Shadrix exhales an entwined burst of blinding radiance and unnerving shadow in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 31 (7d8) radiant damage and 31 (7d8) psychic damage and is blinded until the start of Shadrix's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't blinded.

InkBlade.name: InkBlade
InkBlade.description: ms,rs 4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) psychic damage.

InkBlade.name: InkBlade
InkBlade.description: ms,rs 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The professor makes two Radiant Strike attacks. The professor can replace one of the attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

RadiantStrike.name: RadiantStrike
RadiantStrike.description: ms,rs 7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) radiant damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw be blinded until the end of its next turn.

Devil'sSight.name: Devil's Sight
Devil'sSight.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the professor's darkvision.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The professor makes two Ink Lance attacks. The professor can replace one of the attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

InkLance.name: InkLance
InkLance.description: ms,rs 7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw be blinded until the end of its next turn.

DeathBurst.name: Death Burst
DeathBurst.description: When the spirit statue is reduced to 0 hit points, the statue crumbles, and the spirit returns to the afterlife in a burst of ghostly white flame. Each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 3 (1d6) radiant damage.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

CounselofthePast(2/Day).name: CounselofthePast(2/Day)
CounselofthePast(2/Day).description: The spirit statue touches one creature. Once within the next 10 minutes, that creature can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice, immediately after rolling the d20.

CampusKnowledge.name: Campus Knowledge
CampusKnowledge.description: While at Strixhaven, the guide can't become lost by magical or nonmagical means. The guide also has advantage on ability checks made to locate creatures or objects at Strixhaven.

UnivocalSpeech.name: Univocal Speech
UnivocalSpeech.description: When the guide speaks, any creature that knows at least one language and can hear the guide understands what it says.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The guide doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The guide makes two Slam attacks.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

SmileandWave.name: SmileandWave
SmileandWave.description:
Each creature of the guide's choice that is within 30 feet of the guide must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the guide for 1 hour.
A charmed target must move on its turn toward the guide, trying to get within 5 feet of the guide. The target doesn't move into obviously dangerous ground, such as a fire or a pit. Whenever the charmed target takes damage, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.
A target that successfully saves is immune to any guide's Smile and Wave ability for the next 24 hours.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If Tanazir fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Tanazir makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (1d10 + 9) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) force damage.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 16 (2d6 + 9) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it is addled by recursive thoughts, reducing its speed to 0 until the start of Tanazir's next turn.

DiminutionBreath{@recharge5}.name: DiminutionBreath{@recharge5}
DiminutionBreath{@recharge5}.description: Tanazir exhales a weakening equation in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 23 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 45 (13d6) force damage and 45 (13d6) psychic damage and is weakened until the start of Tanazir's next turn. While weakened, it has disadvantage on the following rolls that rely on Strength: attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't weakened.

Teleport.name: Teleport
Teleport.description: Tanazir teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 100 feet of herself.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If Velomachus fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

Claw.name: Claw

BattleTideBreath{@recharge5}.description: Velomachus exhales thunderous sound in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 25 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 45 (7d12) force damage and 45 (7d12) thunder damage and is pushed up to 20 feet in a horizontal direction of Velomachus' choice. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed. Objects that aren't being worn or carried take the damage and are pushed as if they were creatures that failed the saving throw.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: The apprentice regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

VerdantTalisman.name: Verdant Talisman
VerdantTalisman.description: At the end of a 10-minute ritual, the apprentice can touch one willing creature (including itself) and bestow upon it a small talisman imbued with magic. Upon receiving the talisman, the creature gains 10 temporary hit points, and it can add 1d6 to its initiative rolls while it wears the talisman. These benefits last for 1 hour or until the apprentice conducts another ritual to bestow another talisman. When the benefits expire, the talisman crumbles to dust.

BriarVine.name: BriarVine
BriarVine.description: ms 4 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the apprentice can pull it up to 10 feet closer to itself.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: As long as the pledgemage has at least 1 hit point remaining, the pledgemage regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn.

VerdantTalisman.name: Verdant Talisman
VerdantTalisman.description: At the end of a 10-minute ritual, the pledgemage can touch one willing creature (including itself) and bestow upon it a small talisman imbued with magic. Upon receiving the talisman, the creature gains 10 temporary hit points, and it can add 1d6 to its initiative rolls while it wears the talisman. These benefits last for 1 hour or until the pledgemage conducts another ritual to bestow another talisman. When the benefits expire, the talisman crumbles to dust.

BriarVine.name: BriarVine

EssenceTransfer(1/Day).name: Essence Transfer
EssenceTransfer(1/Day).description: The professor can cast the animate dead spell, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The professor makes two Mortality Spear attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

MortalitySpear.name: MortalitySpear
MortalitySpear.description: ms,rs 7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) necrotic damage, and the target can't regain hit points until the start of the professor's next turn.

EssencePulse{@recharge5}.name: EssencePulse{@recharge5}
EssencePulse{@recharge5}.description: The professor creates a life-draining vortex in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Each creature of the professor's choice that it can see within that area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 23 (5d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The professor then regains 10 hit points. An affected creature's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest. The creature dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The professor makes two Verdant Lash attacks.

VerdantLash.name: VerdantLash
VerdantLash.description: ms 7 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 10 feet closer to the professor.

value.value: Summon Nature's Avatar (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)

SummonNature'sAvatar(RechargesafteraShor.description: The professor magically summons a Groff. The groff appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of the professor, acts as the professor's ally, and takes its turns immediately after the professor's. The professor can communicate telepathically with this groff while it remains. The groff remains for 10 minutes, until it or the professor dies, or until the professor dismisses it as an action.

BloodAegis.name: Blood Aegis
BloodAegis.description: The AC of Y'demi includes her Constitution modifier while she isn't wearing armor or wielding a shield.

OriqMask.name: Oriq Mask
OriqMask.description: Y'demi wears an Oriq mask. While wearing the mask, Y'demi can't be targeted by any divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors, and she adds double her proficiency bonus to Charisma (Deception) checks (included above).

SanguineSense.name: Sanguine Sense
SanguineSense.description: While Y'demi isn't blinded, she can see any creature that isn't an Undead or a Construct within 60 feet of itself, even through Cover||3||total cover, heavily obscured areas, invisibility, or any other phenomena that would prevent sight.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Y'demi makes two Blood Lash attacks.

BloodLash.name: BloodLash
BloodLash.description: ms 9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it can't regain hit points until the start of the Y'demi's next turn.

BloodBoil{@recharge4}.name: BloodBoil{@recharge4}
BloodBoil{@recharge4}.description: Y'demi chooses a point within 150 feet of itself, and a 20-foot radius sphere centered on that point fills with a burst of searing, blood-red mist. Each creature of Y'demi's choice that she can see in that area must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 38 (7d10) necrotic damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't incapacitated. A creature dies if reduced to 0 hit points by this necrotic damage.

BloodFrenzy.name: Blood Frenzy
BloodFrenzy.description: The giant shark skeleton has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) piercing damage.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage.

Tail.name: Tail
Tail.description: mw 12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

FrightfulPresence.name: FrightfulPresence
FrightfulPresence.description: Each creature of Lhammaruntosz's choice that is within 120 feet of her and aware of her must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Lhammaruntosz's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

BreathWeapons{@recharge5}.name: BreathWeapons{@recharge5}
BreathWeapons{@recharge5}.description: Lhammaruntosz uses one of the following breath weapons.

LightningBreath.name: LightningBreath
LightningBreath.description: Lhammaruntosz exhales lightning in a 90-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 66 (12d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

RepulsionBreath.name: RepulsionBreath
RepulsionBreath.description: Lhammaruntosz exhales repulsion energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is pushed 60 feet away from the dragon.

ChangeShape.name: ChangeShape
ChangeShape.description:
Lhammaruntosz magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating no higher than her own, or back into her true form. She reverts to her true form if she dies. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (Lhammaruntosz's choice).
In a new form, Lhammaruntosz retains her alignment, hit points, Hit Dice, ability to speak, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, lair actions, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. Her statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features or legendary actions of that form.

DiveAttack.name: Dive Attack
DiveAttack.description: If the aarakocra is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack deals an extra 3 (1d6) damage to the target.

Simulacra.name: Simulacra
Simulacra.description: When a simulacrum drops to 0 hit points or is subjected to a successful dispel magic spell (DC 17), it reverts to ice and snow and is destroyed.

Talon.name: Talon
Talon.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

Javelin.name: Javelin
Javelin.description: mw,rw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

SummonAirElemental.name: SummonAirElemental
SummonAirElemental.description: Five aarakocra within 30 feet of each other can magically summon an air elemental. Each of the five must use its action and movement on three consecutive turns to perform an aerial dance and must maintain concentration while doing so (as if concentration||concentrating on a spell). When all five have finished their third turn of the dance, the elemental appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of them. It is friendly toward them and obeys their spoken commands. It remains for 1 hour, until it or all its summoners die, or until any of its summoners dismisses it as a bonus action. A summoner can't perform the dance again until it finishes a short rest. When the elemental returns to the Elemental Plane of Air, any aarakocra within 5 feet of it can return with it.

Club.name: Club
Club.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

DwarvenResilience.name: Dwarven Resilience
DwarvenResilience.description: Augrek has advantage on saving throws against poison.

RoleplayingInformation.name: Roleplaying Information
RoleplayingInformation.description:
Sheriff's deputy Augrek guards the southwest gate of Bryn Shander and welcomes visitors to town. She has a good heart.
Ideal: "You'll get farther in life with a kind word than an axe"
Bond: "Bryn Shander is my home. It's my job to protect her."
Flaw: "I'm head over heels in love with Sheriff Southwell. One day I hope to marry him."

Warhammer.name: Warhammer
Warhammer.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

HeavyCrossbow.name: HeavyCrossbow
HeavyCrossbow.description: rw 2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d10) piercing damage. Augrek carries ten crossbow bolts.

RoleplayingInformation.name: Roleplaying Information
RoleplayingInformation.description:
Beldora is a member of the harpers who survives using her wits and wiles. She looks like a homeless waif, but she's a survivor who shies away from material wealth.
Ideal: "We should all strive to help one another"
Bond: "I'll risk my life to protect the powerless."
Flaw: "I like lying to people. Makes life more interesting, no?"

Shortsword.name: Shortsword
Shortsword.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

HandCrossbow.name: HandCrossbow
HandCrossbow.description: rw 4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. Beldora carries ten crossbow bolts.

Multiattack.description: The giant makes two greatclub attacks or two unarmed attacks.

Greatclub.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

KeenSmell.description: Sansuri has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

Fling.name: Fling
Fling.description: Sansuri tries to throw a Small or Medium creature within 10 feet of her. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or be hurled up to 60 feet horizontally in a direction of Sansuri's choice and land prone, taking 1d8 bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown.

WindAura.name: WindAura
WindAura.description: A magical aura of wind surrounds Sansuri. The aura is a 10-foot-radius sphere that lasts as long as Sansuri maintains concentration on it (as if concentrating on a spell). While the aura is in effect, Sansuri gains a +2 bonus to its AC against ranged weapon attacks, and all open flames within the aura are extinguished unless they are magical.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Sansuri makes two spear attacks.

Morningstar.name: Morningstar
Morningstar.description: mw 12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) piercing damage.

Nondetection.description: The cat cannot be targeted or detected by any divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

Pounce.name: Pounce
Pounce.description: If the cat moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the cat can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

SpellTurning.name: Spell Turning
SpellTurning.description: The cat has advantage on saving throws against any spell that targets only the cat (not an area). If the cat's saving throw succeeds and the spell is of 7th level or lower, the spell has no effect on the cat and instead targets the caster.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

SneakAttack(1/Turn).name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
SneakAttack(1/Turn).description: Darz deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Darz that isn't incapacitated and Darz doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

RoleplayingInformation.name: Roleplaying Information
RoleplayingInformation.description:
In his youth, Darz was a member of the Xanathar Thieves' Guild in Waterdeep. After serving ten years in prison for his crimes, he cut all ties to the city and moved north to be a campground caretaker.
Ideal: "You can run from your past, but you can't hide from it."
Bond: "I've made a new life in Triboar. I'm not gonna run away this time. "
Flaw: "I have no regrets. I do whatever it takes to survive."

Shortsword.name: Shortsword
Shortsword.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

Sling.name: Sling
Sling.description: rw 4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. Darz carries twenty sling stones.

Tackle.description: When Zalto enters any enemy's space for the first time on a turn, the enemy must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

RoleplayingInformation.name: Roleplaying Information
RoleplayingInformation.description:
The daughter of a Waterdhavian trader and a tavern server, Duvessa has her mother's talent for negotiation and her father's charm. As the first woman to serve as Town Speaker of Bryn Shander, and a young one at that, she has much to prove.
Ideal: "The people of Icewind Dale are survivors. They can weather any storm."
Bond: "My mother taught me what it means to be a good leader. I won't disappoint her."
Flaw: "I don't give an inch in any argument of conflict."

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.description: mw,rw 2 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage. Duvessa carries only one dagger.

DwarvenResilience.name: Dwarven Resilience
DwarvenResilience.description: Ghelryn has advantage on saving throws against poison.

GiantSlayer.name: Giant Slayer
GiantSlayer.description: Any weapon attack that Ghelryn makes against a giant deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage on a hit.

RoleplayingInformation.name: Roleplaying Information
RoleplayingInformation.description:
The blacksmith Ghelryn has a good heart, but he hates orcs and giants—hates them with a fiery passion. He considers it the solemn duty of all dwarves to cave in their skulls!
Ideal: "It is incumbent upon every dwarf to forge a legacy."
Bond: "I stand for Clan Foehammer and all dwarvenkind."
Flaw: "I never run from a fight, especially if it involves killing orcs or giants."

Multiattack.description: Ghelryn makes two battleaxe attacks.

FalseAppearance.name: False Appearance
FalseAppearance.description: While Lifferlas remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree.

RoleplayingInformation.name: Roleplaying Information
RoleplayingInformation.description:
A druid of the Emerald Enclave awakened the tree Lifferlas with a spell. Goldenfields is his home, its people his friends. Children like to carve their name and initials into his body and hang from his boughs, and he's happy with that.
Ideal: "I exist to protect the people and plants of Goldenfields."
Bond: "Children are wonderful. I would do anything to make them feel happy and safe."
Flaw: "I can't remember people's names and often get them mixed up."

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Lifferlas makes two slam attacks.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

EmpoweredAttacks.name: Empowered Attacks
EmpoweredAttacks.description: Maegera's slam attacks are treated as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to damage from nonmagical attacks.

FireAura.name: Fire Aura
FireAura.description: At the start of each of Maegera's turns, each creature within 30 feet of it takes 35 (10d6) fire damage, and flammable objects in the aura that aren't being worn or carried ignite. A creature also takes 35 (10d6) fire damage from touching Maegera or from hitting it with a melee attack while within 10 feet of it, and a creature takes that damage the first time on a turn that Maegera moves into its space. Nonmagical weapons that hit Maegera are destroyed by fire immediately after dealing damage to it.

FireForm.name: Fire Form
FireForm.description: Maegera can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing if fire could pass through that space.

照明.name: 照明
照明.description: Maegera sheds bright light in a 120-foot radius and dim light in an additional 120 ft..

魔法抗性.name: 魔法抗性
魔法抗性.description: Maegera has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Maegera makes three slam attacks.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 35 (10d6) fire damage

RoleplayingInformation.name: Roleplaying Information
RoleplayingInformation.description:
Sheriff Markham of Bryn Shander is a brawny, likable man of few words. Nothing is more important to him than protecting Icewind Dale. He judges others by their actions, not their words.
Ideal: "All people deserve to be treated with dignity."
Bond: "Duvessa is a natural leader, but she needs help. That's my job."
Flaw: "I bury my emotions and have no interest in small talk."

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Markham makes two melee attacks.

Longsword.name: Longsword
Longsword.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage if used with two hands.

HeavyCrossbow.name: HeavyCrossbow
HeavyCrossbow.description: rw 3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage. Markham carries twenty crossbow bolts.

RoleplayingInformation.name: Roleplaying Information
RoleplayingInformation.description:
Innkeeper Miros is a retired carnival attraction, dubbed "the Yeti" because of his barrel-shaped body and the thick, white hair covering his arms, chest, back, and head. When Goldenfields suffers, so does his business, so he takes strides to protect the compound.
Ideal: "As does the Emerald Enclave, I believe that civilization and the wilderness need to learn to coexist."
Bond: "Make fun of me all you like, but don't speak ill of my inn or my employees."
Flaw: "When something upsets me, I have a tendency to fly into a rage."

BearHug.name: BearHug
BearHug.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target grappled (escape DC 13) and takes 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of Miros's turns until the grapple ends. Miros cannot make attacks while grappling a creature.

Club.name: Club
Club.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage

HeavyCrossbow.name: HeavyCrossbow
HeavyCrossbow.description: rw 2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d10) piercing damage. Miros carries ten crossbow bolts.

CunningAction.name: Cunning Action
CunningAction.description: On each of his turns, Narth can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

RoleplayingInformation.name: Roleplaying Information
RoleplayingInformation.description:
Narth sells gear to adventurers, and he also has an adventurous spirit. The Lionshield Coster pays him well, but he longs to make a name for himself. At the same time, he runs a business with his partner Alaestra and knows she wouldn't forgive him if he ran off and never returned.
Ideal: "The bigger the risk, the greater the reward."
Bond: "I adore my colleague Alestra, and I'd like to do something to impress her."
Flaw: "I'll risk life and limb to become a legend.-"

Shortsword.name: Shortsword
Shortsword.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

HandCrossbow.name: HandCrossbow
HandCrossbow.description: rw 4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. Narth carries twenty crossbow bolts.

RoleplayingInformation.name: Roleplaying Information
RoleplayingInformation.description:
Goldenfields' crops are vital Waterdeep's survival, which is why the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors sent Naxene to make sure the temple-farm is adequately defended. At first she regarded the task as a punishment, but now she appreciates the peace and quiet.
Ideal: "There's no problem that can't be solved with magic."
Bond: "I have great respect for Lady Laeral Silverhand of Waterdeep. She and the Lords' Alliance are going to bring some much-needed order to this lawless land."
Flaw: "I'm too smart to be wrong about anything."

Staff.name: Staff
Staff.description: mw 1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d8 - 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

HalflingNimbleness.name: Halfling Nimbleness
HalflingNimbleness.description: Oren can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than his.

Lucky.name: Lucky
Lucky.description: When Oren rolls a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, he can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

StoutResilience.name: Stout Resilience
StoutResilience.description: Oren has advantage on saving throws against poison

RoleplayingInformation.name: Roleplaying Information
RoleplayingInformation.description:
Oren came to Nurthfurrow's End looking for easy work and found it. He sings for his supper, drinks like a fish, and wanders the fields at night dreaming up new lyrics to entertain the inn's other guests. Oren likes to stir up trouble from time to time, but he doesn't have a mean bone in his body.
Ideal: "Music is food for the soul."
Bond: "You had me at "Can I buy you a drink."
Flaw: "I have a knack for putting myself in harm's way. Good thing I'm lucky!"

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.description: mw,rw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage. Duvessa carries only one dagger.

RoleplayingInformation.name: Roleplaying Information
RoleplayingInformation.description:
Othovir is a gifted harness-maker who doesn't talk about his family or where he came from. He cares about his business, his clients, and his good name.
Ideal: "Find what you do well, and do it to the best of your ability."
Bond: "I won't allow my name to be tarnished."
Flaw: "I get angry when others pry into my private life."

Rapier.name: Rapier
Rapier.description: mw 2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The wormling makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its stinger.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description:
mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a Small or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the worm. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the wormling, and it takes 3 (1d6) acid damage at the start of each of the wormling's turns.
If the wormling takes 10 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the wormling must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the wormling. If the wormling dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

TailStinger.name: TailStinger
TailStinger.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

SneakAttack(1/Turn).name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
SneakAttack(1/Turn).description: Shalvus deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Shalvus that isn't incapacitated and Shalvus doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

RoleplayingInformation.name: Roleplaying Information
RoleplayingInformation.description:
Nalaskur Thaelond of Bargewright Inn has entrusted the shepherd Shalvus with an important assignment: to figure out the best way by which Goldenfields can be brought under the Black Network's control. Shalvus believes that success will ensure his swift rise through the Zhentarim ranks.
Ideal: "I'll do what it takes to prove myself to the Zhentarim."
Bond: "I love animals, and I'm very protective of them."
Flaw: "I can't resist taking risks to feed my ambitions."

Quarterstaff.name: Quarterstaff
Quarterstaff.description: mw 2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage if used with both hands.

HandCrossbow.name: HandCrossbow
HandCrossbow.description: rw 2 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. Shalvus carries ten crossbow bolts.

Warhammer.name: Warhammer
Warhammer.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) bludgeoning damage, or 6 (1d10 + 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

Warhammer.name: Warhammer
Warhammer.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) bludgeoning damage, or 6 (1d10 + 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

Brave.name: Brave
Brave.description: Baric has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

RoleplayingInformation.name: Roleplaying Information
RoleplayingInformation.description:
As a knight of the Order of the Gauntlet, Sir Baric has sworn oaths to catch evildoers and bring them to justice. His current quarry is a dwarf brigand, Worvil "the Weevil" Forkbeard, who is rumored to be hiding in Icewind Dale. In addition to his gear, Sir Baric has an unarmored warhorse, Henry.
Ideal: "Evil must not be allowed to thrive in this world."
Bond: "Tyr is my lord; the order, my family. Through my actions, I shall honor both."
Flaw: "I'm not afraid to die. When Tyr finally calls me, I'll go to him happily."

巨鎚.name: 巨鎚
巨鎚.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

HeavyCrossbow.name: HeavyCrossbow
HeavyCrossbow.description: rw 2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d10) piercing damage. Baric carries twenty crossbow bolts.

RoleplayingInformation.name: Roleplaying Information
RoleplayingInformation.description:
An acolyte of Torm, Sirac grew up on the streets of Suzail, the capital of Cormyr. He came to Icewind Dale to become a knucklehead trout fisher but instead found religion. The misbegotten son of Artus Climber, a renowned human adventurer, Sirac hasn't seen his father since he was a baby.
Ideal: "Without duty or loyalty, a man is nothing."
Bond: "Icewind Dale is where i belong for the rest of my life."
Flaw: "I am honest to a fault."

Shortsword.name: Shortsword
Shortsword.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

Dart.name: Dart
Dart.description: rw 5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. Sirac carries six darts.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If Slarkrethel fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

兩棲.name: 兩棲
兩棲.description: Slarkrethel can breathe air and water.

FreedomofMovement.name: Freedom of Movement
FreedomofMovement.description: Slarkrethel ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce its speed or cause it to be restrained. It can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being grappled.

SiegeMonster.name: Siege Monster
SiegeMonster.description: Slarkrethel deals double damage to objects and structures.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Slarkrethel makes three tentacle attacks, each of which it can replace with one use of Fling.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 17 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 23 (3d8 + 10) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature grappled by Slarkrethel, that creature is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside Slarkrethel, and it takes 42 (12d6) acid damage at the start of each of Slarkrethel's turns. If Slarkrethel takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, Slarkrethel must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of Slarkrethel. If Slarkrethel dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

Tentacle.name: Tentacle
Tentacle.description: mw 17 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. on hit: 20 (3d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. Slarkrethel has ten tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

Fling.name: Fling
Fling.description: One Large or smaller object held or creature grappled by Slarkrethel is thrown up to 60 feet in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

LightningStorm.name: LightningStorm
LightningStorm.description: Slarkrethel magically creates three bolts of lightning, each of which can strike a target Slarkrethel can see within 120 feet of it. A target must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

StoneCamouflage.name: Stone Camouflage
StoneCamouflage.description: The giant has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

OlachMorrah.name: Olach Morrah
OlachMorrah.description:
The giant meditates for 1 hour, during which time it can do nothing else. At the end of the hour, provided the giant's meditation has been uninterrupted, it becomes petrified for 8 hours. At the end of this time, the giant is no longer petrified and gains tremorsense out to a range of 30 feet, as well as a measure of innate spellcasting ability based on Wisdom. For the next 24 hours, it can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
3/day: meld into stone, stone shape
1/day: stoneskin, time stop

Fling.name: Fling
Fling.description: The giant tries to throw a Small or Medium creature within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be hurled up to 60 feet horizontally in a direction of the giant's choice. and land prone, taking 1d6 bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown.

RollingRock.name: RollingRock
RollingRock.description: The giant sends a rock tumbling along the ground in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage and falling prone on a failed save

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The giant makes two adamantine greatclub attacks.

Greatclub.name: Greatclub
Greatclub.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

Rock.name: Rock
Rock.description: rw 9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. on hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., on hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) piercing damage.

Tail.name: Tail
Tail.description: 7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Succeed on a DC14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

GiantSlayer.name: Giant Slayer
GiantSlayer.description: Any weapon attack that Urgala makes against a giant deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage on a hit.

RoleplayingInformation.name: Roleplaying Information
RoleplayingInformation.description:
A retired adventurer, Urgala owns a respectable inn, the North­ shield House, and she doesn't want to see it or her neighbors' homes destroyed. She has no tolerance for monsters or bullies.
Ideal: "We live in a violent world, and sometimes violence is necessary for survival."
Bond: "My home is my life. Threaten it, and I'll hurt you."
Flaw: "I know how treacherous and greedy adventurers can be. I don't trust them—any of them."

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Urgala makes two attacks with her morningstar or her shortbow.

Morningstar.name: Morningstar
Morningstar.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

Shortbow.name: Shortbow
Shortbow.description: rw 3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage. Urgala carries a quiver of twenty arrows.

Spear.name: Spear
Spear.description: mw,rw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if wielded with two hands.

Shortbow.name: Shortbow
Shortbow.description: rw 3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

Possession(Rechargesafterarest).name: Possession (Recharges after a rest)
Possession(Rechargesafterarest).description:
The yakfolk attempts to magically possess a humanoid or giant. The yakfolk must touch the target throughout a short rest or the attempt fails. At the end of the rest, the target must succeed a DC 12 Con saving throw or be possessed by the yakfolk, which disappears with everything its carrying and wearing. Until the possession ends, the target is incapacitated, loses control of its body, and it unaware of its surroundings. The yakfolk now controls the body and cannot be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, and it retains its alignment, its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; and its proficiencies. It otherwise uses the target's statistics, except the target's knowledge, class features, feats, and proficiencies.
The possession lats until either the body drops to 0 hit points, the yakfolk ends the possession as an action, or the yakfolk is forced out of the body by an effect such as dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, the yakfolk appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body and is stunned until the end of its next turn. If the host body dies while it is possessed by the yakfolk, the yakfolk dies as well and its body does not reappear.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The yakfolk makes two melee attacks.

Quarterstaff.name: Quarterstaff
Quarterstaff.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, or 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

SummonEarthElemental(1/Day).name: SummonEarthElemental(1/Day)
SummonEarthElemental(1/Day).description: The yakfolk summons an earth elemental. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of its summoner and acts as an ally of the summoner. It remains for 10 minutes, until it dies, or until its summoner dismisses it as an action.

Possession(Rechargesafterarest).name: Possession (Recharges after a rest)
Possession(Rechargesafterarest).description:
The yakfolk attempts to magically possess a humanoid or giant. The yakfolk must touch the target throughout a short rest or the attempt fails. At the end of the rest, the target must succeed a DC 12 Con saving throw or be possessed by the yakfolk, which disappears with everything its carrying and wearing. Until the possession ends, the target is incapacitated, loses control of its body, and it unaware of its surroundings. The yakfolk now controls the body and cannot be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, and it retains its alignment, its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; and its proficiencies. It otherwise uses the target's statistics, except the target's knowledge, class features, feats, and proficiencies.
The possession lats until either the body drops to 0 hit points, the yakfolk ends the possession as an action, or the yakfolk is forced out of the body by an effect such as dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, the yakfolk appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body and is stunned until the end of its next turn. If the host body dies while it is possessed by the yakfolk, the yakfolk dies as well and its body does not reappear.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The yakfolk makes two attacks, either with its greatsword or its longbow.

Greatsword.name: Greatsword
Greatsword.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage.

Longbow.name: Longbow
Longbow.description: rw 2 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (2d8) piercing damage.

Battleaxe.name: Battleaxe
Battleaxe.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

Javelin.name: Javelin
Javelin.description: mw,rw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

KeenSmell.name: Keen Smell
KeenSmell.description: Zephyros has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

Fling.name: Fling
Fling.description: Zephyros tries to throw a Small or Medium creature within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or be hurled up to 60 feet horizontally in a direction of Zephyros's choice and land prone, taking 1d8 bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown.

WindAura.name: WindAura
WindAura.description: A magical aura of wind surrounds Zephyros. The aura is a 10-foot-radius sphere that lasts as long as he maintains concentration on it (as if concentrating on a spell). While the aura is in effect, Zephyros gains a +2 bonus to his AC against ranged weapon attacks, and all open flames within the aura are extinguished unless they are magical.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Zephyros makes two staff attacks.

StaffoftheMagi.name: StaffoftheMagi
StaffoftheMagi.description: mw 15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 20 (3d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage, or 23 (3d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands. This damage is considered magical..

Rock.name: Rock
Rock.description: rw 12 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. on hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

UnarmoredDefense.name: Unarmored Defense
UnarmoredDefense.description: While Zi is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, her AC includes her Wisdom modifier.

RoleplayingInformation.name: Roleplaying Information
RoleplayingInformation.description:
Zi Liang is a devout worshiper of Chauntea, the Earth Mother. She has considerably less faith in Goldenfields' defenders, so she patrols the temple-farm during her off-duty hours.
Ideal: "If we faithfully tend to our gardens and our fields, Chauntea will smile upon us."
Bond: "Goldenfields is the breadbasket of the North. People depend on its safety and prosperity, and I'll do what must be done to protect it."
Flaw: "I don't trust authority. I do what my heart says is right."

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Zi makes two melee attacks.

Quarterstaff.name: Quarterstaff
Quarterstaff.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) bludgeoning damage if used with both hands.

Sling.name: Sling
Sling.description: rw 4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage. Zi carries twenty sling stones.

Sting.name: Sting
Sting.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

FalseAppearance.name: False Appearance
FalseAppearance.description: While the statue remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate statue.

bludgeoningfromnonmagicalattacksthataren.name: bludgeoning from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

piercingfromnonmagicalattacksthataren'ta.name: piercing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

slashingfromnonmagicalattacksthataren'ta.name: slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The statue makes five attacks: one with its headbutt and four with its lightning bolt blades.

Headbutt.name: Headbutt
Headbutt.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

LightningBoltBlades.name: LightningBoltBlades
LightningBoltBlades.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.

KeenHearingandSmell.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
KeenHearingandSmell.description: Tooth-N-Claw has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

PackTactics.name: Pack Tactics
PackTactics.description: Tooth-N-Claw has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.

FreezingBreath{@recharge5}.name: FreezingBreath{@recharge5}
FreezingBreath{@recharge5}.description: Tooth-N-Claw exhales an icy blast in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Regeneration(SlaadOnly).name: Regeneration (Slaad Only)
Regeneration(SlaadOnly).description: The spirit regains 5 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

WhisperingAura(MindFlayerOnly).name: Whispering Aura (Mind Flayer Only)
WhisperingAura(MindFlayerOnly).description: At the start of each of the spirit's turns, the spirit emits psionic energy if it doesn't have the Incapacitated|XPHB condition. wis DC equals your spell save DC, each creature (other than you) within 5 feet of the spirit. {@actSaveFail} 2d6 Psychic damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The spirit makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (round down).

Claw(SlaadOnly).name: Claw(SlaadOnly)
Claw(SlaadOnly).description: m Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. on hit: 1d10 + 3 + summonSpellLevel Slashing damage, and the target can't regain Hit Points until the start of the spirit's next turn.

EyeRay(BeholderkinOnly).name: EyeRay(BeholderkinOnly)
EyeRay(BeholderkinOnly).description: r Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, range 150 ft. on hit: 1d8 + 3 + summonSpellLevel Psychic damage.

PsychicSlam(MindFlayerOnly).name: PsychicSlam(MindFlayerOnly)

StonyLethargy(StoneOnly).name: Stony Lethargy (Stone Only)

IrrepressibleDance.name: Irrepressible Dance
IrrepressibleDance.description: When any creature starts its turn within 10 feet of the item, the item can increase or decrease (your choice) the walking speed of that creature by 10 feet until the end of the turn, provided the item isn't incapacitated.

Force-EmpoweredSlam.name: Force-EmpoweredSlam
Force-EmpoweredSlam.description: mw {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target you can see. on hit: 1d10 + PB force damage.

AmorphousForm(Air,Fire,andWaterOnly).name: Amorphous Form (Air, Fire, and Water Only)

FeyBlade.description: m Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. on hit: 2d6 + 3 + summonSpellLevel Force damage.

DeathThroes(DemonOnly).description: When the spirit drops to 0 Hit Points or the spell ends, the spirit explodes. dex DC equals your spell save DC, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the spirit. {@actSaveFail} 2d10 plus this spell's level Fire damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

Devil'sSight(DevilOnly).name: Devil's Sight (Devil Only)
Devil'sSight(DevilOnly).description: Magical Darkness doesn't impede the spirit's Darkvision.

Claws(YugolothOnly).description: m Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. on hit: 1d8 + 3 + summonSpellLevel Slashing damage. Immediately after the attack hits or misses, the spirit can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

FieryStrike(DevilOnly).description: m,r Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. or range 150 ft. on hit: 2d6 + 3 + summonSpellLevel Fire damage.

FalseAppearance(ObjectFormOnly).name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
FalseAppearance(ObjectFormOnly).description: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

SpiderClimb.name: Spider Climb
SpiderClimb.description: The mimic can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Bite.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 1 piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) acid damage.

Shape-Shift.name: Shape-Shift
Shape-Shift.description: The mimic polymorphs into an object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

ImmutableExistence.name: Immutable Existence
ImmutableExistence.description: The servant is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form or send it to another plane of existence.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The servant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and spell attacks made against it have disadvantage.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: The servant regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If it is reduced to 0 hit points, this trait doesn't function until an attuned creature spends 24 hours repairing the artifact or until the artifact is subjected to lightning damage.

StandingLeap.name: Standing Leap
StandingLeap.description: The servant's long jump is up to 50 feet and its high jump is up to 25 feet, with or without a running start.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The servant doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

DestructiveFist.name: DestructiveFist
DestructiveFist.description: mw 17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) force damage. Or Ranged Weapon Attack: 17 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) force damage. If the target is an object, it takes triple damage.

CrushingLeap.name: CrushingLeap
CrushingLeap.description: If the servant jumps at least 25 feet as part of its movement, it can then use this action to land on its feet in a space that contains one or more other creatures. Each of those creatures is pushed to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the servant and must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 26 (4d12) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone.

TerrorFrenzy(FuryOnly).name: Terror Frenzy (Fury Only)
TerrorFrenzy(FuryOnly).description: The spirit has advantage on attack rolls against frightened creatures.

WeightofSorrow(DespairOnly).name: Weight of Sorrow (Despair Only)
WeightofSorrow(DespairOnly).description: Any creature, other than you, that starts its turn within 5 feet of the spirit has its speed reduced by 20 feet until the start of that creature's next turn.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The spirit makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (rounded down).

ChillingRend.name: ChillingRend
ChillingRend.description: mw {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 1d12 + 3 + summonSpellLevel cold damage.

DreadfulScream(1/Day).name: DreadfulScream(1/Day)
DreadfulScream(1/Day).description: The spirit screams. Each creature within 30 feet of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or be frightened for 1 minute. The frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

FesteringAura(PutridOnly).name: Festering Aura (Putrid Only)
FesteringAura(PutridOnly).description: con DC equals your spell save DC, any creature (other than you) that starts its turn within a 5-foot Emanation originating from the spirit. {@actSaveFail} The creature has the Poisoned|XPHB condition until the start of its next turn.

IncorporealPassage(GhostlyOnly).name: Incorporeal Passage (Ghostly Only)
IncorporealPassage(GhostlyOnly).description: The spirit can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. If it ends its turn inside an object, it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and takes 1d10 Force damage for every 5 feet traveled.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The spirit makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (round down).

DeathlyTouch(GhostlyOnly).name: DeathlyTouch(GhostlyOnly)
DeathlyTouch(GhostlyOnly).description: m Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. on hit: 1d8 + 3 + summonSpellLevel Necrotic damage, and the target has the Frightened|XPHB condition until the end of its next turn.

GraveBolt(SkeletalOnly).name: GraveBolt(SkeletalOnly)
GraveBolt(SkeletalOnly).description: r Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, range 150 ft. on hit: 2d4 + 3 + summonSpellLevel Necrotic damage.

RottingClaw(PutridOnly).name: RottingClaw(PutridOnly)
RottingClaw(PutridOnly).description: m Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. on hit: 1d6 + 3 + summonSpellLevel Slashing damage. If the target has the Poisoned|XPHB condition, it has the Paralyzed|XPHB condition until the end of its next turn.

FlameSeed.name: FlameSeed
FlameSeed.description: rw {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, range 60 ft., one target you can see. on hit: 1d6 + PB fire damage.

FieryTeleportation.name: FieryTeleportation
FieryTeleportation.description: The spirit and each willing creature of your choice within 5 feet of it teleport up to 15 feet to unoccupied spaces you can see. Then each creature within 5 feet of the space that the spirit left must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC or take 1d6 + PB fire damage.

AntimagicSusceptibility.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
AntimagicSusceptibility.description: The table is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the table must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

FalseAppearance.name: False Appearance
FalseAppearance.description: While the table remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal table.

Charge.name: Charge
Charge.description: If the table moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

Ram.name: Ram
Ram.description: mw +6, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

Quarterstaff.name: Quarterstaff
Quarterstaff.description: mw 2 to hit (4 to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh or if wielded with two hands.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) cold damage.

ColdBreath{@recharge5}.name: ColdBreath{@recharge5}
ColdBreath{@recharge5}.description: The dragon exhales an icy blast of hail in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (5d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Charge.name: Charge
Charge.description: If the centaur mummy moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a pike attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) piercing damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The centaur mummy makes two melee attacks, one with its pike and one with its hooves, or it attacks with its pike and uses Dreadful Glare.

Pike.name: Pike
Pike.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

Hooves.name: Hooves
Hooves.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with mummy rot. The cursed target can't regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) for every 24 hours that elapse. If the curse reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and its body turns to dust. The curse lasts until removed by the remove curse spell or similar magic.

DreadfulGlare.name: DreadfulGlare
DreadfulGlare.description: The centaur mummy targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. If the target can see the mummy, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened until the end of the mummy's next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also paralyzed for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare of all mummies (but not mummy lords) for the next 24 hours.

UndeadFortitude.name: Undead Fortitude
UndeadFortitude.description: If damage reduces the dread warrior to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5+the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the dread warrior drops to 1 hit point instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The dread warrior makes two melee attacks.

Battleaxe.name: Battleaxe
Battleaxe.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage if wielded with two hands.

Javelin.name: Javelin
Javelin.description: mw,rw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

CunningAction.name: Cunning Action
CunningAction.description: On each of its turns, the spy can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

DuergarResilience.name: Duergar Resilience
DuergarResilience.description: The spy has advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, and illusions, as well as to resist being charmed or paralyzed.

SneakAttack.name: Sneak Attack
SneakAttack.description: Once per turn, the spy can deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the spy that isn't incapacitated and the spy doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

SunlightSensitivity.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
SunlightSensitivity.description: While in sunlight, the spy has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The spy makes two shortsword attacks.

Enlarge(RechargesafteraShortorLongRest).name: Enlarge(RechargesafteraShortorLongRest)

value.value: Enlarge (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)

Enlarge(RechargesafteraShortorLongRest).description: For 1 minute, the spy magically increases in size, along with anything it is wearing or carrying. While enlarged, the spy is Large, doubles her damage dice on Strength-based weapon attacks (included in the attacks), and makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage. If the spy lacks the room to become Large, it attains the maximum size possible in the space available.

Shortsword.name: Shortsword
Shortsword.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage while enlarged.

HandCrossbow.name: HandCrossbow
HandCrossbow.description: rw 5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

Invisibility(RechargesafteraShortorLongR.name: Invisibility(RechargesafteraShortorLongRest)

value.value: Invisibility (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)

Invisibility(RechargesafteraShortorLongR.description: The spy magically turns invisible until it attacks, deals damage, casts a spell, or uses its Enlarge, or until its concentration is broken, up to 1 hour (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the spy wears or carries is invisible with it.

MartialAdvantage.name: Martial Advantage
MartialAdvantage.description: Once per turn, the hobgoblin can deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 ft. of an ally of the hobgoblin that isn't incapacitated.

Longsword.name: Longsword
Longsword.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage, or 6 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage if used with two hands.

Longbow.name: Longbow
Longbow.description: rw 4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

Club.name: Club
Club.description: mw 2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

ChannelDivinity:TurnUndead(1/ShortRest).name: ChannelDivinity:TurnUndead(1/ShortRest)
ChannelDivinity:TurnUndead(1/ShortRest).description:
Erky presents his holy Symbol and speaks a prayer censuring the Undead. Each Undead that can see or hear Erky within 30 feet of him must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. If the creature fails its saving throw, it is turned for 1 minute or until it takes any damage.
A turned creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from Erky as it can, and it can't willingly move to a space within 30 feet of him. It also can't take reactions. For its action, it can use only the Dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If there's nowhere to move, the creature can use the Dodge action.

FalseAppearance.name: False Appearance
FalseAppearance.description: While the gargoyle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate statue.

兩棲.description: The toad can breathe air and water.

ColdAura.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the toad takes 5 (1d10) cold damage.

StandingLeap.name: Standing Leap
StandingLeap.description: The toad's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the toad can't bite another target.

Swallow.name: Swallow
Swallow.description:
mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature the toad is grappling. on hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the toad, and it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage and 11 (2d10) cold damage at the start of each of the toad's turns. The toad can have only one target swallowed at a time.
If the toad dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

WaterBreathing.name: Water Breathing
WaterBreathing.description: The eel can breathe only underwater.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The eel makes two bite attacks.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) lightning damage.

LightningJolt{@recharge5}.name: LightningJolt{@recharge5}
LightningJolt{@recharge5}.description: One creature the eel touches within 5 feet of it outside water, or each creature within 15 feet of it in a body of water, must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On failed save, a target takes 13 (3d8) lightning damage. If the target takes any of this damage, the target is stunned until the end of the eel's next turn. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't stunned.

Evasion.name: Evasion
Evasion.description: If the skeleton is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

魔法抗性.name: 魔法抗性
魔法抗性.description: The skeleton has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

TurnImmunity.description: The skeleton is immune to effects that turn undead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The skeleton makes three scimitar attacks.

Scimitar.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage.

Multiattack.description: The lizard makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail. One attack can be replaced by Swallow.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the lizard can't bite another target.

Tail.name: Tail
Tail.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

Swallow.name: Swallow
Swallow.description:
mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature the lizard is grappling. on hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage. The target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the lizard, and it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the lizard's turns. The lizard can have only one target swallowed at a time.
If the lizard dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

Club.name: Club
Club.description: mw 1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 1 (1d4 - 1) bludgeoning damage.

TurnResistance.name: Turn Resistance
TurnResistance.description: The zombie has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

UndeadFortitude.name: Undead Fortitude
UndeadFortitude.description: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.
