The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.
A humanoid slain by this attack rises 24 hours later as a zombie under the Withers's control, unless the humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. Withers can have no more than twelve zombies under its control at one time.

Longsword.name: Longsword
Longsword.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage if used with two hands.

QuickenedSpell(3/Day).name: Quickened Spell
QuickenedSpell(3/Day).description: When she casts a spell that has a casting time of 1 action, Xandala changes the casting time to 1 bonus action for that casting.

Quarterstaff.name: Quarterstaff
Quarterstaff.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage when used with two hands.

FalseAppearance.name: False Appearance
FalseAppearance.description: While the creeper remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary flowering vine.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: The creeper regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the creeper takes fire, necrotic, or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The creeper dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

Touch.name: Touch
Touch.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 13 (3d8) psychic damage. If the target is a humanoid that drops to 0 hit points as a result of this damage, it dies and is implanted with a yellow musk creeper bulb. Unless the bulb is destroyed, the corpse animates as a yellow musk zombie after being dead for 24 hours. The bulb is destroyed if the creature is raised from the dead before it can transform into a yellow musk zombie, or if the corpse is targeted by a remove curse spell or similar magic before it animates.

YellowMusk(3/Day).name: YellowMusk(3/Day)
YellowMusk(3/Day).description: The creeper's flowers release a strong musk that targets all humanoids within 30 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the creeper for 1 minute. A creature charmed in this way does nothing on its turn except move as close as it can to the creeper. A creature charmed by the creeper can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

UndeadFortitude.name: Undead Fortitude
UndeadFortitude.description: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 +the damage taken, unless the damage is fire or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

DragonWings.name: Dragon Wings
DragonWings.description: As a bonus action on his turn, Zindar can sprout a pair of dragon wings from his back, gaining a flying speed of 30 feet until he dismisses them as a bonus action.

Quarterstaff.name: Quarterstaff
Quarterstaff.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage when used with two hands.

BreathWeapon{@recharge5}.name: BreathWeapon{@recharge5}
BreathWeapon{@recharge5}.description: Zindar uses one of the following options:

FireBreath.name: FireBreath
FireBreath.description: Zindar exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

WeakeningBreath.name: WeakeningBreath
WeakeningBreath.description: Zindar exhales gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or have disadvantage on Strength-based attack rolls, Strength checks, and Strength saving throws for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

魔法抗性.name: 魔法抗性
魔法抗性.description: The zorbo has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

天生護甲.name: 天生護甲
天生護甲.description: The zorbo magically absorbs the natural strength of its surroundings, adjusting its Armor Class based on the material it is standing or climbing on: AC 15 for wood or bone, AC 17 for earth or stone, or AC 19 for metal. If the zorbo isn't in contact with any of these substances, its AC is 10.

DestructiveClaws.name: DestructiveClaws
DestructiveClaws.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (2d6 + 1) slashing damage, and if the target is a creature wearing armor, carrying a shield, or in possession of a magic item that improves its AC, it must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, one such item worn or carried by the creature (the target's choice) magically deteriorates, taking a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to the AC it offers, and the zorbo gains a +1 bonus to AC until the start of its next turn. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield or magic item that drops to a 0 AC increase is destroyed.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The decapus makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tentacles.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature grappled by the decapus. on hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.

Tentacles.name: Tentacles
Tentacles.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 24 (9d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage or 14 (5d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage if the decapus is grappling a creature other than the target or if the decapus is on the ground or floor. The target is also grappled (escape DC 14) unless the decapus is already grappling a creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained.

BoulderGuise.name: Boulder Guise
BoulderGuise.description: While fully withdrawn into its shell, the geonid can't see and is indistinguishable from a small boulder

Club.name: Club
Club.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

StoneTell.name: StoneTell
StoneTell.description: The geonid touches a stone object or surface and knows what types of creatures have been within 10 feet of that stone in the past 24 hours. The geonid can also determine the number of creatures of each type, but not their identities.

KeenSmell.name: Keen Smell
KeenSmell.description: The slug has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

SpiderClimb.name: Spider Climb
SpiderClimb.description: The slug can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The slug makes two attacks: one with its tentacles and one with its bite.

Tentacles.name: Tentacles
Tentacles.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. Until this poison ends, the target is paralyzed. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the poison on itself on a success.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.

TurnResistance.name: Turn Resistance
TurnResistance.description: The topi has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

UndeadFortitude.name: Undead Fortitude
UndeadFortitude.description: If damage reduces the topi to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5+the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the topi drops to 1 hit point instead.

VenomousClaws.name: VenomousClaws
VenomousClaws.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of the target's next turn.

LegendaryResistance(5/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(5/Day).description: If Vecna fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

SpecialEquipment.name: Special Equipment
SpecialEquipment.description: Vecna carries a magic dagger named Afterthought. In the hands of anyone other than Vecna, Afterthought is a +2 Dagger.

Undying.name: Undying
Undying.description: If Vecna is slain, his soul refuses to accept its fate and lives on as a disembodied spirit that fashions a new body for itself after 1d100 years. Vecna's new body appears within 100 miles of where he was slain. When the new body is complete, Vecna regains all his hit points and becomes active again.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Vecna uses Flight of the Damned (if available), Rotten Fate, or Spellcasting. He then makes two attacks with Afterthought.

Afterthought.name: Afterthought
Afterthought.description: mw 13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is afflicted by entropic magic, taking 9 (2d8) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. Immediately after taking this damage on its turn, the target must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Until it succeeds on this save, the afflicted target can't regain hit points.

FlightoftheDamned{@recharge5}.name: FlightoftheDamned{@recharge5}
FlightoftheDamned{@recharge5}.description: Vecna conjures a torrent of flying, spectral entities that fill a 120-foot cone and pass through all creatures in that area before dissipating. Each creature in that area must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 36 (8d8) necrotic damage and has the frightened condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

RottenFate.name: RottenFate
RottenFate.description: Vecna causes necrotic magic to engulf one creature he can see within 120 feet of himself. The target must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 96 (8d8 + 60) necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A Humanoid killed by this magic rises as a zombie at the start of Vecna's next turn and acts immediately after Vecna in the initiative order. The zombie is under Vecna's control.

EaroftheChosen.name: Ear of the Chosen
EaroftheChosen.description: Whenever a creature on the same plane of existence as Alustriel speaks Alustriel's name, Alustriel hears her name and the next nine words the speaker utters.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If Alustriel fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

SpecialEquipment.name: Special Equipment
SpecialEquipment.description: Alustriel carries a magic staff known as the Staff of Silverymoon. In the hands of anyone other than Alustriel, the Staff of Silverymoon is a Staff of Power.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Alustriel makes three Staff of Silverymoon attacks or two Reproving Ray attacks.

StaffofSilverymoon.name: StaffofSilverymoon
StaffofSilverymoon.description: mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 38 (7d10) radiant damage.

ReprovingRay.name: ReprovingRay
ReprovingRay.description: rs 14 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 65 (9d12 + 7) force damage, and if the target is a creature, it must make a DC 22 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the incapacitated condition until the start of Alustriel's next turn. On a successful save, the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of Alustriel's next turn.

ArgentBlaze(RequiresSilverFire).name: ArgentBlaze(RequiresSilverFire)
ArgentBlaze(RequiresSilverFire).description: Alustriel summons a 60-foot cone of silver fire. Each creature in that area must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 77 (14d10) radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Additionally, Alustriel or one creature of her choice within 60 feet of her then regains 10 (3d6) hit points.

Berserk.name: Berserk
Berserk.description: Whenever the bearer takes damage or makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, roll a d6. On a 5 or 6, the bearer goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the bearer has advantage on melee attack rolls, it can Dash as a bonus action, and it must attack the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the bearer attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the bearer goes berserk, it remains berserk until it is destroyed or its creator gives it a pristine black rose.

UndeadFortitude.name: Undead Fortitude
UndeadFortitude.description: If damage reduces the bearer to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 plus the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a successful save, the bearer drops to 1 hit point instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The bearer makes two Slam attacks.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

PackTactics.name: Pack Tactics
PackTactics.description: The lieutenant has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the lieutenant's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The lieutenant makes three Longsword or Javelin Launcher attacks.

Longsword.name: Longsword
Longsword.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 20 (3d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.

JavelinLauncher.name: JavelinLauncher
JavelinLauncher.description: rw 8 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage, and the target has the prone condition.

PackTactics.name: Pack Tactics
PackTactics.description: The scout has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the scout's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The scout makes three Armblade or Bolt Launcher attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with a use of Snare Trap.

Armblade.name: Armblade
Armblade.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

BoltLauncher.name: BoltLauncher
BoltLauncher.description: rw 8 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

SnareTrap(1/Day).name: SnareTrap(1/Day)
SnareTrap(1/Day).description: The scout deploys a Tiny mechanical trap on a solid surface within 5 feet of itself. The trap is hidden, requiring a successful DC 17 Intelligence (Investigation) check to find. The trap lasts for 1 minute. Whenever an enemy enters a space within 10 feet of the trap or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) piercing damage and have the prone condition. A creature makes this saving throw only once per turn.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The blazebear has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

MistSight.name: Mist Sight
MistSight.description: The blazebear can see normally through heavily obscured areas created by mist or fog, including areas created by spells such as Fog Cloud.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The blazebear makes two Bite attacks. It can replace one attack with Stunning Gaze if available.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 20 (2d12 + 7) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) force damage.

StunningGaze{@recharge5}.name: StunningGaze{@recharge5}
StunningGaze{@recharge5}.description: The blazebear targets two creatures it can see within 120 feet of itself. Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the stunned condition until the start of the blazebear's next turn.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The bone roc makes one Beak attack and two Talons attacks.

Beak.name: Beak
Beak.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

Talons.name: Talons
Talons.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

GlacialAura.name: Glacial Aura
GlacialAura.description: At the end of the borthak's turn, slippery ice covers surfaces within 10 feet of the borthak. This ice is difficult terrain. When a creature other than the borthak enters the ice's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or have the prone condition. The ice disappears at the start of the borthak's next turn.

WebbedFeet.name: Webbed Feet
WebbedFeet.description: The borthak can move across icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The borthak makes one Bite attack or uses Noxious Regurgitation if available, and it makes two Stomp attacks.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

Stomp.name: Stomp
Stomp.description: mw 12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

NoxiousRegurgitation{@recharge5}.name: NoxiousRegurgitation{@recharge5}
NoxiousRegurgitation{@recharge5}.description: The borthak spews acid at a creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 24 (7d6) acid damage and has the poisoned condition until the start of the borthak's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

DeathThroes.name: Death Throes
DeathThroes.description: Camlash explodes when reduced to 0 hit points, and each creature within 30 feet of Camlash must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The explosion ignites flammable objects in that area that aren't being worn or carried.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: Camlash has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

SpiderAura.name: Spider Aura
SpiderAura.description: Camlash is surrounded by tiny biting spiders that magically appear and disappear from moment to moment. At the start of each of Camlash's turns, each creature within 10 feet of Camlash takes 10 (3d6) poison damage and must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or have the paralyzed condition until the start of Camlash's next turn.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Camlash makes one Flaming Whip attack and one Lightning Blade attack. Camlash can replace one of these attacks with Teleport.

FlamingWhip.name: FlamingWhip
FlamingWhip.description: mw 15 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. on hit: 25 (5d6 + 8) fire damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 25 feet toward Camlash.

LightningBlade.name: LightningBlade
LightningBlade.description: mw 15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) lightning damage.

Teleport.name: Teleport
Teleport.description: Camlash magically teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space she can see.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the spider fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

SpiderClimb.name: Spider Climb
SpiderClimb.description: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

WebWalker.name: Web Walker
WebWalker.description: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The spider makes two Bite attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with a use of Web Bomb.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

WebBomb.name: WebBomb
WebBomb.description: rw 14 to hit, range 300 ft./600 ft., one target. on hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage, and the target and all creatures within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) acid damage and have the restrained condition until the start of the spider's next turn.

BrambleWalk.name: Bramble Walk
BrambleWalk.description: Difficult terrain composed of vegetation, such as foliage or thorns, doesn't cost the dryad extra movement.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The dryad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

SpeakwithBeastsandPlants.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
SpeakwithBeastsandPlants.description: The dryad can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The dryad makes two Poisonous Thorn attacks and one Sapping Vine attack.

PoisonousThorn.name: PoisonousThorn
PoisonousThorn.description: mw,rw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (4d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition until the start of the dryad's next turn.

SappingVine.name: SappingVine
SappingVine.description:
mw 8 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. on hit: The target has the grappled condition (escape DC 16). Until the grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition, and the dryad can't use the same vine on another target. A creature restrained in this way takes 13 (3d8) necrotic damage at the start of its turn.
The dryad has six vines. Each vine can be attacked (AC 20; 10 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage). Destroying a vine deals no damage to the dryad, but any creature grappled by that vine no longer has the grappled condition. All vines immediately wither and disappear when the dryad is reduced to 0 hit points.

LegendaryResistance(2/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(2/Day).description: If the deathwolf fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Moon'sGrace.name: Moon's Grace
Moon'sGrace.description: When the deathwolf falls, it descends at a rate of 60 feet per round and takes no falling damage.

bludgeoningfromnonmagicalattacksthataren.name: bludgeoning from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

piercingfromnonmagicalattacksthataren'ts.name: piercing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

slashingfromnonmagicalattacksthataren'ts.name: slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The deathwolf makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with Phantom Deathwolf if available.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on saving throws against the frightened condition. This curse lasts until removed by the Remove Curse spell or other magic.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

PhantomDeathwolf{@recharge5}.name: PhantomDeathwolf{@recharge5}
PhantomDeathwolf{@recharge5}.description:
The deathwolf creates a terrifying phantom of itself in the mind of a creature the deathwolf can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or have the frightened condition for 1 minute.
While the target is frightened, the phantom deals 21 (6d6) psychic damage to the target at the start of each of the target's turns. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The degloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The degloth makes two Razor Fist attacks.

RazorFist.name: RazorFist
RazorFist.description: mw 10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the target has the grappled condition (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition, and the degloth can't use this fist to grapple another target. The degloth has two fists.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the false lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The false lich has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The false lich makes two Death Rend attacks and uses Bloodcurdling Lament if available.

DeathRend.name: DeathRend
DeathRend.description: ms 14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) necrotic damage.

BloodcurdlingLament{@recharge5}.name: BloodcurdlingLament{@recharge5}
BloodcurdlingLament{@recharge5}.description: The false lich emits a hideous shriek charged with malignant energy. Each creature within 30 feet of the false lich must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition for 1 minute. While frightened in this way, a creature also has the unconscious condition. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Heatsink.name: Heatsink
Heatsink.description: When Glaive takes cold damage, her Overdrive immediately recharges.

PackTactics.name: Pack Tactics
PackTactics.description: Glaive has advantage on attack rolls if at least one ally is within 5 feet of the creature she's attacking and the ally doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Glaive makes two Spiked Glaive attacks and two Serrated Bolt attacks.

SpikedGlaive.name: SpikedGlaive
SpikedGlaive.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing or slashing damage, or 14 (1d10 + 9) piercing or slashing damage if Glaive is in overdrive.

SerratedBolt.name: SerratedBolt
SerratedBolt.description: rw 7 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage. If Glaive has advantage on the attack roll, the serrated bolt lodges in the target, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the serrated bolt is removed. A target's speed can be reduced by only one serrated bolt at a time. A creature can use its action to remove a serrated bolt lodged in itself or another creature within its reach; when the bolt is removed from a creature, that creature takes 5 (2d4) slashing damage.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The juggernaut has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

SiegeMonster.name: Siege Monster
SiegeMonster.description: The juggernaut deals double damage to objects and structures.

bludgeoningfromnonmagicalattacksthataren.name: bludgeoning from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

piercingfromnonmagicalattacksthataren'ta.name: piercing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

slashingfromnonmagicalattacksthataren'ta.name: slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (1d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The hazvongel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The hazvongel makes three Talon attacks.

Talon.name: Talon
Talon.description: mw 10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage.

BloodBarrage{@recharge5}.name: BloodBarrage{@recharge5}
BloodBarrage{@recharge5}.description: The hazvongel launches a spray of blood in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

LegendaryResistances(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistances
LegendaryResistances(3/Day).description: If the hertilod fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The hertilod has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

ShockSusceptibility.name: Shock Susceptibility
ShockSusceptibility.description: If the hertilod takes lightning damage, its speed is halved until the end of its next turn, and it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or immediately regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which lands in a space within 10 feet of the hertilod and has the prone condition.

SpiderClimb.name: Spider Climb
SpiderClimb.description: The hertilod can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The hertilod makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description:
mw 12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 13 (2d12) poison damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be swallowed by the hertilod. A swallowed creature has the blinded and restrained conditions, and it has Cover||3||total cover against attacks and other effects outside the hertilod. At the start of each of the hertilod's turns, each swallowed creature takes 13 (2d12) poison damage from the poisonous secretion in the hertilod's gullet.
The hertilod's gullet can hold up to two creatures at a time. If the hertilod takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from a swallowed creature, the hertilod must succeed on a 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which lands in a space within 10 feet of the hertilod and has the prone condition. If the hertilod dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting with the prone condition.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The kakkuu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

SpiderClimb.name: Spider Climb
SpiderClimb.description: The kakkuu can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

WebSense.name: Web Sense
WebSense.description: When in contact with a web, the kakkuu knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

WebWalker.name: Web Walker
WebWalker.description: The kakkuu ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The kakkuu makes a Web Snare attack, uses Reel, and makes a Bite attack.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

Reel.name: Reel
Reel.description: The kakkuu pulls each creature within 60 feet of itself that is grappled by its Web Snare up to 30 feet straight toward itself.

WebSnare.name: WebSnare
WebSnare.description: rw 6 to hit, reach 30/60 ft., one Large or smaller creature. on hit: The target has the grappled condition (escape DC 13). While grappled, the target also has the restrained condition. A web snare grappling a creature can be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; 10 hit points; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

EagerBetrayer.name: Eager Betrayer
EagerBetrayer.description: Kas adds 1d10 to his initiative rolls. He has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that has the frightened condition.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If Kas fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: Kas regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point. If he takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn.

SpecialEquipment.name: Special Equipment
SpecialEquipment.description: Kas wears the Crown of Lies|VEoR (see the Introduction of Vecna: Eve of Ruin).

SpiderClimb.name: Spider Climb
SpiderClimb.description: Kas can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

StrengthoftheNight.name: Strength of the Night
StrengthoftheNight.description: Kas doesn't require a coffin, and he drinks blood to sow terror rather than for sustenance. If destroyed, Kas revives in 1d100 nights in an unoccupied space in Tovag, his Domain of Dread. He can be permanently destroyed only by having a stake driven through his heart and then being beheaded. The stake must be cut from a tree growing in soil from Oerth, Kas's home world.

SunlightHypersensitivity.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
SunlightHypersensitivity.description: While in sunlight, Kas takes 20 radiant damage at the start of his turn, has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, and can't use his Change Shape bonus action.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Kas makes three Vengeful Sword attacks. He can replace one of these attacks with a Bite attack.

VengefulSword.name: VengefulSword
VengefulSword.description: mw 15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 20 (2d8 + 11) slashing damage. The sword scores a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 11 (1d6 + 8) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Kas regains a number of hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0. A Humanoid slain in this way and then buried rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Kas's control.

FalseAppearance.name: False Appearance
FalseAppearance.description: If the mirror shade is within 5 feet of a reflective surface—such as a mirror, glass pane, or still water—it has advantage on its initiative roll. If a creature hasn't observed the mirror shade move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the mirror shade isn't the creature's own reflection.

MirrorMovement.name: Mirror Movement
MirrorMovement.description: The mirror shade can move along the surface of reflective or translucent objects, such as mirrors, without provoking opportunity attacks. It can move through translucent objects as if they were difficult terrain.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The mirror shade makes two Phantasmal Strike attacks and uses Reflect Fear.

PhantasmalStrike.name: PhantasmalStrike
PhantasmalStrike.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) radiant damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

ReflectFear.name: ReflectFear
ReflectFear.description: The mirror shade targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself and projects an illusion of that creature's greatest fear. The target must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 28 (8d6) psychic damage and has the frightened condition until the start of the mirror shade's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

FoulIchor.name: Foul Ichor
FoulIchor.description: A creature that hits Miska with a melee weapon attack takes 7 (2d6) poison damage.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If Miska fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: Miska has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

SpiderClimb.name: Spider Climb
SpiderClimb.description: Miska can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

WebSense.name: Web Sense
WebSense.description: When in contact with a web, Miska knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

WebWalker.name: Web Walker
WebWalker.description: Miska ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Miska makes one Lupine Bite attack and two Trident of Chaos attacks.

LupineBite.name: LupineBite
LupineBite.description: mw 13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 27 (6d8) poison damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, a creature has the incapacitated condition and can't regain hit points. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

TridentofChaos.name: TridentofChaos
TridentofChaos.description: mw 13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) force damage.

ImmutableForm.name: Immutable Form
ImmutableForm.description: The guardian is immune to any spell or other effect that would alter its form.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The guardian has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

RadiantAbsorption.name: Radiant Absorption
RadiantAbsorption.description: Whenever the guardian is subjected to radiant damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the radiant damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The guardian makes two Moonlight Slam attacks.

MoonlightSlam.name: MoonlightSlam
MoonlightSlam.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) radiant damage.

MoonlightBlast{@recharge5}.name: MoonlightBlast{@recharge5}
MoonlightBlast{@recharge5}.description: The guardian unleashes a magical blast of moonlight in a line 60 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. Creatures that aren't in their true form have disadvantage on the save. On a failed save, a creature takes 22 (5d8) radiant damage, and if it isn't in its true form, it is forced into its true form and can't change forms until the end of the guardian's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: The phisarazu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

SpiderClimb.description: The phisarazu can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

WebWalker.name: Web Walker
WebWalker.description: The phisarazu ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The phisarazu makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with Scintillating Spray if available.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage, and the target has the poisoned condition until the start of the phisarazu's next turn.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) slashing damage.

ScintillatingSpray{@recharge5}.name: ScintillatingSpray{@recharge5}
ScintillatingSpray{@recharge5}.description: The phisarazu expels shimmering webs in a 60-foot cone. Creatures and objects in that area are outlined by the glittering webs for 1 minute, during which time they emit dim light for 10 feet and can't benefit from the invisible condition. Additionally, creatures in that area must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or have the stunned condition for 1 minute. A stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance

A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

DissolvingWeb{@recharge5}.description: The quavilithku expels acid-drenched webs in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) acid damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Nonmagical objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried take 44 (8d10) acid damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The raklupis makes a Bite attack and two Serrated Sword attacks. It can use Venom Globe in place of one of these attacks.

Bite.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) poison damage. SerratedSword.name: SerratedSword
SerratedSword.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) poison damage.

VenomGlobe.name: VenomGlobe
VenomGlobe.description: rw 11 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. on hit: 45 (10d8) poison damage.

BloodheartStake.name: Bloodheart Stake
BloodheartStake.description: The impaler is magically bound to the ceremonial stake and the sacrificed corpse the ritual caster used to create it. If the impaler is reduced to 0 hit points, it disappears, then re-forms 1d8 hours later in the nearest unoccupied space to the stake and regains all its hit points. The impaler dies only if it is reduced to 0 hit points while either the ceremonial stake is removed from the sacrifice's corpse or the impaler is on a different plane of existence from that corpse.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the impaler fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The impaler makes one Spike attack and two Wicked Spear attacks.

Spike.name: Spike
Spike.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage, and the target's speed is halved until the start of the impaler's next turn.

WickedSpear.name: WickedSpear
WickedSpear.description: mw,rw 11 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/40 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

SpikeBurst{@recharge5}.name: SpikeBurst{@recharge5}
SpikeBurst{@recharge5}.description: Twisted, spectral spikes shoot out from the impaler's body. Each creature within 30 feet of the impaler must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 40 (9d8) force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

MagicResistance.description: The spiderdragon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Bite.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 13 (2d12) poison damage.

Claw.name: Claw

Multiattack.description: The plant makes three Vine Lash attacks.

VineLash.name: VineLash
VineLash.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained. The plant has four vines, each of which can grapple one target.

EntrappingPod.name: EntrappingPod
EntrappingPod.description:
mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature grappled by the plant. on hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) acid damage, and the target is pulled into the plant's space and enveloped by the pod, and the grapple ends. While enveloped, the target is restrained, and it has Cover||3||total cover against attacks and effects originating outside the pod. The enveloped target must also immediately succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned by the plant's sapping enzymes until it is removed from the pod or the plant dies. The enveloped target doesn't require air and gains 1 level of exhaustion for each hour it spends in the pod. If the target dies while enveloped, it immediately emerges from the pod as a living podling, wearing or carrying all of the original creature's equipment.
As an action, a creature within 5 feet of the bodytaker plant that is outside the pod can open the pod and pull the target free with a successful 15 Strength check. If the plant dies, the target is no longer restrained and can escape from the pod by spending 10 feet of movement, exiting prone. The plant has one pod, which can envelop one creature at a time.

Compression.name: Compression
Compression.description: The boneless can move through any opening at least 1 inch wide without squeezing. It can also squeeze to fit into a space that a Tiny creature could fit in.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The boneless doesn't require sleep.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The boneless makes two Slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Large or smaller creature, the creature is grappled (escape DC 13), and the boneless can use Crushing Embrace.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

CrushingEmbrace.name: CrushingEmbrace
CrushingEmbrace.description: The boneless wraps its body around a Large or smaller creature grappled by it. While the boneless is attached, the target is blinded and is unable to breathe. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw at the start of each of the boneless' turns or take 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If something moves the target, the boneless moves with it. The boneless can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. A creature, including the target, can use its action to try to detach the boneless and force it to move into the nearest unoccupied space, doing so with a successful DC 13 Strength check. When the boneless dies, it detaches from any creature it is attached to.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The carrion stalker makes three Tentacle attacks. If it is attached to a creature, it can replace one Tentacle attack with Larval Burst, if available.

Tentacle.name: Tentacle
Tentacle.description:
mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the carrion stalker attaches to the target and pulls itself into the target's space. While attached, the carrion stalker moves with the target and has advantage on attack rolls against it.
A creature can use its action to try to detach the carrion stalker and force it to move into the nearest unoccupied space, doing so with a successful DC 11 Strength check. On its turn, the carrion stalker can detach itself from the target by using 5 feet of movement. When it dies, the carrion stalker detaches from any creature it is attached to.

LarvalBurst(1/Day).name: LarvalBurst(1/Day)
LarvalBurst(1/Day).description:
The carrion stalker releases a burst of larvae in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned. A creature poisoned in this way takes 7 (2d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns as larvae infest its body. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Any effect that cures disease or removes the poisoned condition instantly kills the larvae in the creature, ending the effect on it.
If a creature is reduced to 0 hit points by the infestation, it dies. The larvae remain in the corpse, and one survives to become a fully grown carrion stalker in 1d4 weeks. Any effect that cures diseases or removes the poisoned condition that targets the corpse instantly kills the larvae.

FalseObject.name: False Object
FalseObject.description: If the carrionette is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the carrionette move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to discern that the carrionette is animate.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The carrionette doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

SilverNeedle.name: SilverNeedle
SilverNeedle.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 1 piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or become cursed for 1 minute. While cursed in this way, the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet, and it must roll a 1d4 and subtract the number rolled from each ability check or attack roll it makes.

SoulSwap.name: SoulSwap
SoulSwap.description:
The carrionette targets a creature it can see within 15 feet of it that is cursed by its Silver Needle. Unless the target is protected by a protection from evil and good spell, it must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or have its consciousness swapped with the carrionette. The carrionette gains control of the target's body, and the target is unconscious for 1 hour, after which it gains control of the carrionette's body. While controlling the target's body, the carrionette retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. It otherwise uses the controlled body's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.
If the carrionette's body is destroyed, both the carrionette and the target die. A protection from evil and good spell cast on the controlled body drives the carrionette out and returns the consciousness of both creatures to their original bodies. The swap is also undone if the controlled body takes damage from the carrionette's Silver Needle.

BeheadedForm.name: Beheaded Form
BeheadedForm.description: When created, a death's head takes one of three forms: Aberrant Head, Gnashing Head, or Petrifying Head. This form determines the creature's attack.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The death's head doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

GnashingBite(GnashingHeadOnly).name: GnashingBite(GnashingHeadOnly)
GnashingBite(GnashingHeadOnly).description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

Mind-BendingBite(AberrantHeadOnly).name: Mind-BendingBite(AberrantHeadOnly)
Mind-BendingBite(AberrantHeadOnly).description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Intelligence saving throw or it can't take a reaction until the end of its next turn. Moreover, on its next turn, the target must choose whether it gets a move, an action, or a bonus action; it gets only one of the three.

PetrifyingBite(PetrifyingHeadOnly).name: PetrifyingBite(PetrifyingHeadOnly)
PetrifyingBite(PetrifyingHeadOnly).description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be restrained as it begins to turn to stone. The target must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the target is petrified for 10 minutes.

HeadlessSummoning(RechargesafteraShortor.name: Headless Summoning (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
HeadlessSummoning(RechargesafteraShortor.description: If the dullahan is reduced to 0 hit points, it doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, it regains 97 hit points. In addition, it summons three death's head|VRGR|death's heads, one of each type, in unoccupied spaces within 5 feet of it. The death's heads are under the dullahan's control and act immediately after the dullahan in the initiative order. Additionally, the dullahan can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section. Award a party an additional 5,900 XP (11,800 XP total) for defeating the dullahan after it uses Headless Summoning.

LegendaryResistance(2/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(2/Day).description: If the dullahan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The dullahan doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The dullahan makes two attacks.

Battleaxe.name: Battleaxe
Battleaxe.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. If the dullahan scores a critical hit against a creature, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or the dullahan cuts off the target's head. The target dies if it can't survive without the lost head. A creature that doesn't have or need a head, or has legendary actions, instead takes an extra 27 (6d8) slashing damage.

FierySkull.name: FierySkull
FierySkull.description: rs 7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) fire damage.

ImmutableForm.name: Immutable Form
ImmutableForm.description: Elise is immune to any spell or effect that would alter her form.

LightningAbsorption.name: Lightning Absorption
LightningAbsorption.description: Whenever Elise is subjected to lightning damage, she takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

MagicResistance.name: Magic Resistance
MagicResistance.description: Elise has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

MagicWeapons.name: Magic Weapons
MagicWeapons.description: Elise's weapon attacks are magical.

bludgeoningfromnonmagicalattacksthataren.name: bludgeoning from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

piercingfromnonmagicalattacksthataren'ta.name: piercing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

slashingfromnonmagicalattacksthataren'ta.name: slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Elise makes two slam attacks.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

DivinationSenses.name: Divination Senses
DivinationSenses.description: The gallows speaker can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane and vice versa.

IncorporealMovement.name: Incorporeal Movement
IncorporealMovement.description: The gallows speaker can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain||3. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends it turn inside an object.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The gallows speaker doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

ForetellingTouch.name: ForetellingTouch
ForetellingTouch.description: ms 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) psychic damage, and the target must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from the next attack roll or saving throw it makes before the start of the gallows speaker's next turn.

SufferingEchoes.name: SufferingEchoes
SufferingEchoes.description: The gallows speaker targets a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 19 (3d12) psychic damage, and waves of painful memories leap from the target to up to three other creatures of the gallows speaker's choice that are within 30 feet of the target, each of which takes 13 (3d8) psychic damage.

LegendaryResistance(4/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(4/Day).description: If the emissary fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The emissary doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The emissary makes three attacks.

LashingMaw.name: LashingMaw
LashingMaw.description: mw 14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 20 (2d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) acid damage.

PsychicOrb.name: PsychicOrb
PsychicOrb.description: rs 15 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. on hit: 27 (3d12 + 8) psychic damage.

UnearthlyBile{@recharge5}.name: UnearthlyBile{@recharge5}
UnearthlyBile{@recharge5}.description: The emissary expels bile that splashes all creatures in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 120 feet of the emissary. Each creature in that area must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 55 (10d10) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. For each creature that fails the saving throw, a gibbering mouther (see its entry in the Monster Manual) appears in an unoccupied space on a surface that can support it within 30 feet of that creature. The gibbering mouthers act right after the emissary on the same initiative count, gaining a +7 bonus to their attack and damage rolls, and fighting until they are destroyed. They disappear when the emissary dies.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 2 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) force damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The inquisitor attacks twice with its Silver Longsword or uses Mind Fire twice.

SilverLongsword.name: SilverLongsword
SilverLongsword.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) if used with two hands, plus 18 (4d8) force damage.

MindFire.name: MindFire
MindFire.description: The inquisitor targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or take 17 (3d8 + 4) psychic damage and be stunned until the start of the inquisitor's next turn.

Inquisitor'sCommand{@recharge5}.name: Inquisitor'sCommand{@recharge5}
Inquisitor'sCommand{@recharge5}.description: Each creature of the inquisitor's choice that it can see within 60 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the start of the inquisitor's next turn. On the charmed target's turn, the inquisitor can telepathically control the target's move, action, or both. When controlled in this way, the target can take only the Attack (inquisitor chooses the target) or Dash action.

MetabolicControl.name: Metabolic Control
MetabolicControl.description: At the start of each of its turns, the inquisitor regains 10 hit points and can end one condition on itself, provided the inquisitor has at least 1 hit point.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The inquisitor attacks twice with its Silver Longsword. After it hits or misses with an attack, the inquisitor can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

SilverLongsword.name: SilverLongsword
SilverLongsword.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) if used with two hands, plus 18 (4d8) force damage.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The inquisitor attacks twice.

ForceBolt.name: ForceBolt
ForceBolt.description: rs 7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) force damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, the inquisitor can push it up to 10 feet away.

SilverLongsword.name: SilverLongsword
SilverLongsword.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) if used with two hands, plus 18 (4d8) force damage.

Implode{@recharge4}.name: Implode{@recharge4}
Implode{@recharge4}.description: Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the inquisitor can see within 120 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 31 (6d8 + 4) force damage and be knocked prone and moved to the unoccupied space closest to the sphere's center. Large and smaller objects that aren't being worn or carried in the sphere automatically take the damage and are similarly moved.

FiendishBlessing.name: Fiendish Blessing
FiendishBlessing.description: The AC of Isolde includes her Charisma bonus.

MagicResistanceAura.name: Magic Resistance Aura
MagicResistanceAura.description: While holding Nepenthe|VRGR, Isolde creates an aura in a 10-foot radius around her. While this aura is active, Isolde and all creatures friendly to her in the aura have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Isolde makes two melee attacks or uses its Fire Ray twice.

Nepenthe.name: Nepenthe
Nepenthe.description: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft.., one target. on hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) slashing damage, or 12 (1d10 + 7) slashing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack. If the target is a fiend or an undead, it takes an extra 11 (2d10) radiant damage.

FireRay.name: FireRay
FireRay.description: rs 7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 10 (3d6) fire damage.

FiendishCharm.name: FiendishCharm
FiendishCharm.description: One humanoid Isolde can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed for 1 day. The charmed target obeys Isolde's spoken commands. If the target suffers any harm from Isolde or another creature or receives a suicidal command from Isolde, the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful, or if the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Isolde's Fiendish Charm for the next 24 hours.

JiangshiWeaknesses.name: Jiangshi Weaknesses
JiangshiWeaknesses.description:
The jiangshi has the following flaws:
Fear of Its Own Reflection. If the jiangshi sees its own reflection, it immediately uses its reaction, if available, to move as far away from the reflection as possible.
Susceptible to Holy Symbols. While the jiangshi is wearing or touching a holy symbol, it automatically fails saving throws against effects that turn Undead.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The jiangshi doesn't require air.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The jiangshi makes three Slam attacks and uses Consume Energy.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

ConsumeEnergy.name: ConsumeEnergy
ConsumeEnergy.description:
The jiangshi draws energy from a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target makes a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The jiangshi regains hit points equal to the amount of necrotic damage dealt. After regaining hit points from this action, the jiangshi gains the following benefits for 7 days: its walking speed increases to 40 feet, and it gains a flying speed equal to its walking speed and can hover.
A Humanoid slain by this necrotic damage rises as a wight (see its entry in the Monster Manual) at the end of the jiangshi's turn. The wight acts immediately after the jiangshi in the initiative order. If this wight slays a Humanoid with its Life Drain, the wight transforms into a jiangshi 5 days later.

ChangeShape.name: ChangeShape
ChangeShape.description: The jiangshi polymorphs into a Beast, a Humanoid, or an Undead that is Medium or Small or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the jiangshi's choice). It reverts to its true form if it dies.

AberrantRejuvenation.name: Aberrant Rejuvenation
AberrantRejuvenation.description: When the emissary drops to 0 hit points, its body melts away. A greater star spawn emissary instantly appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of where the lesser emissary disappeared. The greater emissary uses the lesser emissary's initiative count.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the emissary fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The emissary doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The emissary makes three attacks.

LashingMaw.name: LashingMaw
LashingMaw.description: mw 11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. on hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) acid damage.

PsychicOrb.name: PsychicOrb
PsychicOrb.description: rs 13 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. on hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) psychic damage.

ChangeShape.name: ChangeShape
ChangeShape.description: The emissary polymorphs into a Small or Medium creature of its choice or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

BloodFrenzy.name: Blood Frenzy
BloodFrenzy.description: The loup garou has advantage on attack rolls against a creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

LegendaryResistance(2/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(2/Day).description: When the loup garou fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: The loup garou regains 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns. If the loup garou takes damage from a silver weapon, this trait doesn't function at the start of the loup garou's next turn. The loup garou dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The loup garou makes two attacks: two with its Longsword (humanoid form) or one with its Bite and one with its Claws (dire wolf or hybrid form).

Bite(DireWolforHybridFormOnly).name: Bite(DireWolforHybridFormOnly)

value.value: Bite (Dire Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)

Bite(DireWolforHybridFormOnly).description: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with loup garou lycanthropy.

Claws(DireWolforHybridFormOnly).name: Claws(DireWolforHybridFormOnly)

value.value: Claws (Dire Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)

Claws(DireWolforHybridFormOnly).description: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

Longsword(HumanoidFormOnly).name: Longsword(HumanoidFormOnly)
Longsword(HumanoidFormOnly).description: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.

walk.value: 30 (40 ft. in hybrid form, 50 ft. in dire wolf form)

LegendaryResistance(2/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(2/Day).description: If the necrichor fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description: Unless its lifeless remains are splashed with holy water or placed in a vessel under the effects of the hallow spell, the destroyed necrichor re-forms in 1d10 days, regaining all its hits points and appearing in the place it died or in the nearest unoccupied space.

SpiderClimb.name: Spider Climb
SpiderClimb.description: The necrichor can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The necrichor doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The necrichor makes two attacks.

Pseudopod.name: Pseudopod
Pseudopod.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the start of the necrichor's next turn.

NecroticBolt.name: NecroticBolt
NecroticBolt.description: rs 6 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. on hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) necrotic damage, and the target can't regain hit points until the start of the necrichor's next turn.

BloodPuppeteering{@recharge}.name: BloodPuppeteering{@recharge}
BloodPuppeteering{@recharge}.description:
The necrichor targets a creature it can see within 5 feet of it that is missing any of its hit points. If the target isn't a Construct or an Undead, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or the necrichor enters the target's space and attaches itself to the target for 1 minute. While attached, the necrichor takes only half damage dealt to it (round down), and the target takes the remaining damage. The necrichor can attach to only one creature at a time.
The attached necrichor can telepathically control the target's move, action, or both. When controlled this way, the target can take only the Attack action (necrichor chooses the target) or the Dash action. The attached target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, detaching from the necrichor and forcing it to move into the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: The nosferatu regains 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight. If the nosferatu takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function until the start of the nosferatu's next turn.

SpiderClimb.name: Spider Climb
SpiderClimb.description: The nosferatu can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

SunlightHypersensitivity.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
SunlightHypersensitivity.description: The nosferatu takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The nosferatu doesn't require air.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The nosferatu makes two Claw attacks followed by one Bite attack. If both Claw attacks hit the same creature, the Bite attack is made with advantage.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description:
mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. If the target is missing any of its hit points, it instead takes 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.
The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the nosferatu regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0. A Humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises as a nosferatu after 1d10 days.

BloodDisgorge{@recharge5}.name: BloodDisgorge{@recharge5}
BloodDisgorge{@recharge5}.description: The nosferatu vomits blood in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage, and it can't regain hit points for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage with no additional effects.

SemblanceofLife.name: Semblance of Life
SemblanceofLife.description: The podling is a physical copy of a creature digested by a bodytaker plant. The podling has the digested creature's memories and behaves like that creature, but with occasional lapses. An observer familiar with the digested creature can recognize the discrepancies with a successful DC 20 Wisdom (Insight) check, or automatically if the podling does something in direct contradiction to the digested creature's established beliefs or behavior. The podling melts into a slurry when it dies, when the bodytaker plant that created it dies, or when the bodytaker plant dismisses it (no action required).

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The podling doesn't require sleep.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

TattooofOsybus.name: Tattoo of Osybus
TattooofOsybus.description:
If the priest drops to 0 hit points, roll on the Boons of Undeath table for the boon the priest receives. The priest dies if it receives a boon it already has. If it receives a new boon, it revives at the start of its next turn with half its hit points restored, and its creature type is now Undead.
To prevent this revival, the Tattoo of Osybus on the priest's body must be destroyed. The tattoo is invulnerable while the priest has at least 1 hit point. The tattoo is otherwise an object with AC 15, and it is immune to poison and psychic damage. It has 15 hit points, but it regains all its hit points at the end of every combatant's turn.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The priest attacks twice.

SoulBlade.name: SoulBlade
SoulBlade.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage, and if the target is a creature, it is paralyzed until the start of the priest's next turn. If this damage reduces a Medium or smaller creature to 0 hit points, the creature dies, and its soul is trapped in the priest's body, manifesting as a shadowy Soul Tattoo on the priest. The soul is freed if the priest dies.

NecroticBolt.name: NecroticBolt
NecroticBolt.description: rs 7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) necrotic damage, and the target can't regain hit points until the start of the priest's next turn.

LegendaryResistance(3/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(3/Day).description: If the juggernaut fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: The juggernaut regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn. If the juggernaut takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The juggernaut dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

UnusualNature.name: Unusual Nature
UnusualNature.description: The juggernaut doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The juggernaut makes two attacks. It can replace one attack with Deadly Shaping if it is ready.

Executioner'sPick.name: Executioner'sPick
Executioner'sPick.description: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage, and if the target is a creature, its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of the juggernaut's next turn.

Fist.name: Fist
Fist.description: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 11 (1d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

DeadlyShaping{@recharge5}.name: DeadlyShaping{@recharge5}
DeadlyShaping{@recharge5}.description: The juggernaut magically shapes a feature of its surroundings into a deadly implement. A creature the juggernaut can see within 60 feet of it must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. If the saving throw fails, the targeted creature is struck by one of the following (juggernaut's choice):

FlyingStone.name: FlyingStone
FlyingStone.description: The target takes 22 (5d8) bludgeoning damage and is incapacitated until the start of the juggernaut's next turn, and the implement vanishes.

ScythingShrapnel.name: ScythingShrapnel
ScythingShrapnel.description: The target takes 14 (4d6) slashing damage, and the implement vanishes. At the start of each of its turns, the target takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage from the wound left by the shrapnel. The wound ends if the target regains any hit points or if a creature uses an action to stanch the wound, which requires a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check.

LegendaryResistance(1/Day).name: Legendary Resistance
LegendaryResistance(1/Day).description: If the slasher fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

ShroudedPresence.name: Shrouded Presence
ShroudedPresence.description: The slasher is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, and it can't be detected by abilities that sense Fiends.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The slasher makes two Slasher's Knife attacks.

Slasher'sKnife.name: Slasher'sKnife
Slasher'sKnife.description: mw,rw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft., one target. on hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it suffers a lingering wound that causes it to take 7 (2d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. Each time the slasher hits the wounded target with this attack, the damage dealt by the wound increases by 3 (1d6). The wound ends if the target regains hit points or if a creature uses an action to stanch the wound, which requires a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check.

StirgeTelepathy.name: Stirge Telepathy
StirgeTelepathy.description: The strigoi can magically command any stirge within 120 feet of it, using a limited form of telepathy.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The strigoi makes one Claw attack and makes one Proboscis attack.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. on hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 6 (1d12) acid damage.

Proboscis.name: Proboscis
Proboscis.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. on hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, and the strigoi regains hit points equal to the amount of necrotic damage dealt. A creature reduced to 0 hit points from this attack dies and leaves nothing behind except its skin and its equipment.

RavenousChildren(1/Day).name: RavenousChildren(1/Day)
RavenousChildren(1/Day).description: The strigoi magically summons 1d4 + 2 stirge||stirges (see their entry in the Monster Manual) in unoccupied spaces it can see within 30 feet of it. The stirges are under the strigoi's control and act immediately after the strigoi in the initiative order. The stirges disappear after 1 hour, when the strigoi dies, or when the strigoi dismisses them (no action required).

LimitedSpellImmunity.name: Limited Spell Immunity
LimitedSpellImmunity.description: The swarm automatically succeeds on saving throws against spells of 3rd level or lower, and the attack rolls of such spells always miss it.

Swarm.name: Swarm
Swarm.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny gremishka. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

Bites.name: Bites
